claim_rows.first_seen_subject: arc063-bringforward-arc077: bring ARC-063 forward (V4->V3) + register socially-scaffolded rule-population pathway
claim_rows.title: Socially-scaffolded rule-population pathway: the third rule-source, peer to ARC-062 (top-down gated-policy apprehension) and ARC-064 (bottom-up behavioural-pattern extraction), and upstream-fed by ARC-065 (behavioural diversity generation). Architectural commitment: in biology the candidate-rule hypothesis space is not invented by the agent alone -- caregivers populate it from outside via scaffolded exposure (Vygotsky ZPD; Wood/Bruner/Ross scaffolding; Csibra & Gergely ostensive cueing / natural pedagogy; Tomasello shared intentionality; joint attention / social referencing). This is the most direct architectural answer to MECH-309: a non-Bayesian rule-creator that does not invent its own hypotheses receives candidate regularities, context-bound to the scaffolding episode, from a caregiver. The pathway fills the ARC-063 CandidateRule field (the 'in' face); MECH-337 is the population mechanism; MECH-338 is the cue-driven context-bound retrieval mechanism (the 'select' face). Registered 2026-05-18 as a structural slot only -- hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull and on a caregiver/teacher-agent substrate that does not yet exist in V3.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: arc063-bringforward-arc077: bring ARC-063 forward (V4->V3) + register socially-scaffolded rule-population pathway
claim_rows.title: Caregiver-scaffolded rule-population mechanism (the 'in' face of the ARC-063 CandidateRule field). A caregiver / teacher agent structures the agent's exposure (Vygotsky ZPD; Wood/Bruner/Ross scaffolding) and marks regularities ostensively (Csibra & Gergely natural pedagogy); the marked regularity is written into the ARC-063 CandidateRule field as a candidate the agent could not have invented alone, tagged with the scaffolding context. Population is context-bound by construction -- this is the concrete mechanism behind 'context-bound rule population'. Child of ARC-077. Structural slot only; hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull and a caregiver-agent substrate that does not exist in V3.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: arc063-bringforward-arc077: bring ARC-063 forward (V4->V3) + register socially-scaffolded rule-population pathway

Environmental or internal cues are matched against CandidateRule context tags to gate rollout-eligibility: a rule populated in a context becomes available again when that context, or a cue associated with it, recurs (context-dependent / cued recall; Tulving & Thomson encoding-specificity; Godden & Baddeley context-dependent memory). This is the retrieval pay-off of context-bound population (MECH-337) and the access gate that decides which CandidateRules enter hippocampal rollout. Child of ARC-077. claim_rows.first_seen_subject: diversity-isolation-plan: harvest MECH-341/Q-054/Q-055/INV-076 + isolation plan-of-record
claim_rows.title: Behavioural diversity is a structural prerequisite for ethical counterfactual evaluation. A system with monomodal policy cannot instantiate the counterfactual evaluation that ethical judgement requires, because the 'could have done otherwise' comparison demands that the agent's candidate trajectory pool contain at least two distinct trajectory classes with distinct harm profiles. The argument is mathematical-by-construction: if P(a|s) is monomodal, the CEM elite pool contains only trajectories beginning with a*, and SD-003's counterfactual E2(z_t, a_cf) for a_cf != a* is never evaluated in the on-policy candidate distribution. (Was proposed 2026-05-15 as INV-074 in behavioral_diversity_acceptance_criteria.md but never registered; the ID was subsequently taken 2026-05-17 by an unrelated plasticity-crystallization invariant. Re-registered under INV-076 with scientific content unchanged.)

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: diversity-isolation-plan: harvest MECH-341/Q-054/Q-055/INV-076 + isolation plan-of-record
claim_rows.title: e3_scoring_preserves_trajectory_class_diversity. E3 score aggregation over CEM-supplied candidates must preserve trajectory-class diversity rather than collapse a diverse candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. Without explicit diversity preservation at the scoring step, downstream action selection becomes deterministic regardless of proposal-layer diversity (ARC-065 SP-CEM child), making the whole distributed diversity pathway rate-limited by Layer B. Mechanism options (not yet committed): (1) entropy bonus over candidate first-action classes added to E3 score; (2) class- stratified argmax with within-class proportional sampling; (3) jittered tie-breaking when top-K E3 scores are within epsilon. Final design pending diagnostic data on whether E3 collapse is near-tie or large-gap (see behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan.md Phase P2).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: implement-substrate SD-056: claims registry + design doc (see commit msg in retry)
claim_rows.title: E2 world-forward action-conditional divergence preservation via auxiliary InfoNCE-style contrastive loss. Substrate-level fix for the V3-EXQ-571 root cause finding (2026-05-25): with world_dim=32 and action_dim=4, action contributes ~11% of world_forward input dimensionality, and reconstruction-shaped training collapses to the state-dominated local minimum where action effect is fitted to zero. Measurement: cand_world_pairwise_dist = 0.0000 across K=8 candidates differing only in first action. Same root cause as 2026-05-17 ARC-062 GAP-B autopsy; GAP-B fix was scoped only to GatedPolicy first-action one-hot bypass. SD-056 is the architecturally-faithful generalisation -- fixes the predictor's training objective rather than bypassing the predictor at each consumer. Option (ii) lever B (contrastive next-state, Srivastava et al. 2021 style) chosen over PLSM-style MI factorisation (lever A) and SWIRL-style MI maximisation (lever C) per 2026-05-28 lit-pull SYNTHESIS verdict and user AskUserQuestion confirmation.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: MECH-342: register maintenance-time commitment-release substrate (B3b)
claim_rows.title: control_plane.commit_maintenance_release. The R-c readiness signals that gate commitment ENTRY (MECH-090: score_margin decisiveness + nav_competence) must ALSO be able to RELEASE an already-elevated beta latch when execution readiness degrades mid-commitment. The release is a graded, bounded-accumulation drift-to-a-release-bound (conflict-scaled by the deficit magnitude), NOT a one-shot threshold flag; targeted to the active committed motor program (not a global brake); and hysteretic with a reengagement path that guards the premature-abort pole. This closes the V3-EXQ-592f reach gap (the MECH-090 R-c conjunction is admission-only by design; no existing release pathway covers degraded-readiness-mid- commitment).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: hypothesis: register difficulty-gated proposal entropy (MECH-343 + Q-056)
claim_rows.title: difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy (controlled proposal-entropy widening under goal blockage). When goal progress stalls -- repeated failure to improve goal progress, high inter-candidate conflict, low E3 score margin, low committed-action diversity, plateau/stuck-state signal -- WITH goal salience preserved, the agent should transiently INCREASE proposal-generation entropy UPSTREAM of action selection (wider hippocampal/world-model rollout candidate set + higher within-class sampling temperature) while preserving goal/harm/constraint scoring and DELAYING commitment until one candidate clears the E3 score-margin / commitment threshold; entropy then NARROWS once a workable candidate is found -> committed action -> entropy decay. Asserted distinction (preserve this): a hard problem must trigger WIDER INTERNAL PROPOSALS -> more candidate diversity -> longer arbitration -> selective committed action (controlled entropy), NOT 'hard problem -> random behaviour' (noise). WORKING HYPOTHESIS -- no experimental evidence yet; not an established mechanism.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: hypothesis: register difficulty-gated proposal entropy (MECH-343 + Q-056)
claim_rows.title: Does stuck-state-GATED proposal entropy outperform BOTH entropy-off and always-high entropy? Main empirical prediction of MECH-343: in a hard-goal/blocked-path environment (matched easy-goal controls), the difficulty-gated-entropy arm should show flexible exploration -- improved goal progress, no harm increase, no random-churn increase, commitment latency that rises during the hard phase then falls after solution discovery -- and should BEAT both the entropy-off arm (proposal rigidity / stuck) and the entropy-always-high arm (disorganised exploration / no narrowing). WORKING QUESTION -- no evidence yet.

An object is a token-bound identity representation that persists across time and perceptual gaps, generalising z_object/z_resource into an object-file/binding layer (ARC-006), defined by causal feature-coherence under intervention (MECH-278), and consumed by drive/goal (SD-057), hippocampal planning (MECH-262), and the self/other special-object cases. The four planned object capabilities -- (1) permanence, (2) self-as-object, (3) tools/affordances, (4) others-as-object -- are specialisations of one primitive, not four separate mechanisms.

The object-file CUTOVER IS V4 -- z_self promoted from a body-state latent to a privileged self-OBJECT slot, gated by the DR-10..DR-14 self-model integration audit, MECH-214 (goal E1-representability), MECH-215 (self-model prerequisite for agentive prediction), INV-064 (maturational-sequence necessity), and SD-030 (E2 self-forward-model, V4-deferred). claim_rows.first_seen_subject: SD-057 + MECH-344/345/346: register object-bound incentive-salience layer (GAP-7 L2-L3-L4)

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: SD-057 phase-2 + MECH-347/348: register L6 cue-recall + L7 dACC readout (GAP-7)

The downstream E3 goal_proximity + MECH-295 approach bridge then raise pre-consummatory approach toward the cued object. Distinct from the benefit-driven seed: no benefit pulse, no token revaluation, weaker (cue_recall_gain) pull.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: ARC-063 v1 substrate landed: register MECH-349/350/351/352 + sleep-scope correction

The literal MECH-309 answer -- the creator that 'invents' rules so that credit only 'weights' them. Bottom-up (ARC-064 regularity detection) primary; optional top-down ARC-062 discriminator seed.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: ARC-063 v1 substrate landed: register MECH-349/350/351/352 + sleep-scope correction

The architectural answer to why two shared-gradient scalar heads collapse (598b) but a minted field does not -- separability is structural, not an equilibrium gradient must find.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: ARC-063 v1 substrate landed: register MECH-349/350/351/352 + sleep-scope correction

The conflict-graded 'hold your horses' dynamic threshold; availability (which rules enter the active set) is distinct from selection (which action E3 picks among available rules' biases).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: ARC-063 v1 substrate landed: register MECH-349/350/351/352 + sleep-scope correction

The 'weight' half of mint-then-weight -- credit refines an existing rule's availability, it does not create rules.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: SD-057 + MECH-344/345/346: register object-bound incentive-salience layer (GAP-7 L2-L3-L4)
claim_rows.title: Object-bound incentive-salience layer: insert a per-object incentive layer between the benefit pulse and z_goal. The legacy goal stream wrote a SINGLE z_goal attractor overwritten on every contact, conflating liking (hedonic impact at consumption) with wanting (incentive salience to a cue/object) and goal-location (where) with goal-object (what); wanting target always equalled liking target, so the L9 wanting!=liking dissociation was structurally inexpressible (514l C6=0.0 on all seeds). SD-057 adds (L2 MECH-344) benefit->object-identity binding on the SD-049 per-type tag, (L3 MECH-345) a per-object slow-decay revaluable incentive token with at-recall drive-specific wanting amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive), and (L4 MECH-346) z_goal seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored embedding rather than the raw last-contacted z_resource. v1 = L2+L3+L4 core; L6 cue-recall (MECH-CUEWANT) + L7 dACC-readout-wiring (MECH-CONSUME) deferred to a phase-2 pass within this SD.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: mint MECH-353 (blocked_agency) / MECH-354 (fatigue stop-recover) / MECH-355 (soothing)
claim_rows.title: Blocked-agency / control-failure affect stream (z_block): an integrated readout on the SD-029 agency comparator applied to the action-outcome channel. z_block rises when an intended action repeatedly fails to produce its forward-model-predicted outcome (MECH-112 z_goal supplies the expectation), the mismatch is attributed to an EXTERNAL constraint (not own motor error), AND goal/capacity-belief is RETAINED. It is a distinct affect stream from harm (SD-011: no noxious input required), from suffering (SD-019b/Q-036: OPPOSITE controllability pole -- capacity-retained drives ASSERT, capacity-collapsed drives WITHDRAW), from residue (MECH-056: action-prevented, not action-taken-at-cost), and from licit commitment-hold (MECH-090: externally-imposed block, not self-imposed gate).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: mint MECH-353 (blocked_agency) / MECH-354 (fatigue stop-recover) / MECH-355 (soothing)
claim_rows.title: Effort/fatigue stop-recover homeostatic accumulator: a two-bound (hysteretic) leaky cost-evidence accumulator on the SD-012 homeostatic-drive side (substrate-hosted by the SD-048 interoceptive channel). F accumulates with effort / time-on-task and dissipates with rest; at the upper bound it emits STOP / disengage, recovering to a lower bound before re-engaging. Two time-constants: a fast within-task accumulator and a slow sleep-pressure (Process-S) variant whose recover phase is offline (SD-017 sleep). The in-task STOP feeds the MECH-342 release actuator as a new deficit input and the ARC-078 goal-disengagement consumer via a cost/benefit (non-aversive) channel; the recover / re-accumulation half lives on the SD-012 / SD-017 side. Distinct from suffering / learned-helplessness (SD-011 side): fatigue is controllability-independent, incentive-reversible, and -- decisively -- recovers with rest, which helplessness does not.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: mint MECH-353 (blocked_agency) / MECH-354 (fatigue stop-recover) / MECH-355 (soothing)
claim_rows.title: Soothing/comfort autonomic state-gain modulator: a present-tense down-regulation of the ONGOING aversive/stress state (lowers the gain or speeds the recovery of the active trajectory), canonically socially gated (conspecific buffering; oxytocinergic + parasympathetic/HPA + prefrontal regulation). Proposed home is a modulator on MECH-219 (suffering accumulator) decay + SD-012 (drive) + SD-032e (pACC autonomic coupling). Distinct from relief (MECH-302: past-offset phasic reinforcer), from safety (MECH-303/304: future inhibitory predictor), and from wanting (MECH-112: appetite): soothing acts on the present stress trajectory via autonomic state-gain, not reinforcement, prediction, or appetite. V4-social (the canonical trigger is an other-agent, which V3 cannot represent); an optional V3-minimal non-social autonomic-recovery hook is noted but not built.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register MECH-356 endogenous parasympathetic recovery / autonomic rebound (V3 candidate, sibling of MECH-355 soothing) + affect_primitives Extension-Register row
claim_rows.title: Endogenous parasympathetic recovery / autonomic rebound: an active, offset-triggered, transient acceleration of return-to-baseline for the affective/autonomic stress state, fired by the agent's OWN stressor offset (the z_harm_a derivative going negative -- the MECH-302 SufferingDerivativeComparator signal) with NO conspecific and NO prediction. Shares the effector/update rule of MECH-355 soothing (decay-acceleration on the recovery side: a transient state-scaled multiplier on the MECH-219 z_harm_a recovery_rate + the SD-032e drive_bias leak) but differs by TRIGGER (endogenous offset vs conspecific). The V3-tractable sibling of MECH-355 that closes REE's sympathetic-rich / parasympathetic-poor asymmetry (dense escalation: MECH-219 onset, SD-032e accumulation, SD-037 override, MECH-091 urgency, MECH-279 freeze; thin recovery: only passive recovery_rate + offline-only drive_bias decay). Distinct from passive MECH-219 recovery (active overshoot, not decay), from MECH-302 relief (shared offset trigger, different output -- relief writes a reinforcer, rebound boosts recovery rate), from MECH-303/304 safety (no prediction), and from MECH-355 soothing (endogenous trigger, not social).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register SD-058 + MECH-357 (instrumental-avoidance acquisition: ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression + avoidance action pathway + eligibility-trace efficacy learning); amend scaffolded_sd054_onboarding substrate_queue (ready stays false until V3-EXQ-603h)
claim_rows.title: Infralimbic-PFC-analog freeze-suppression + instrumental-avoidance gate: the mechanism instantiating SD-058. A pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/infralimbic_avoidance_gate.py, sibling to SD-035 CeA/BLA, MECH-279 PAG, MECH-313/MECH-320 policy regulators) with three coordinated pieces, all behind use_instrumental_avoidance (no-op default): (a) an instrumental-avoidance ACTION pathway -- a per-candidate E3 score-bias that under threat penalises the no-op/freeze class proportional to effective avoidance-efficacy, RELEASING the instrumental action (it does not pick the escape direction; E3's harm gradient does -- ARC-007-strict-compatible); (b) an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate that, when effective_efficacy*threat_scale >= threshold, overrides the MECH-279 freeze no-op so the agent acts instead of freezing; (c) an eligibility-trace avoidance-efficacy learner credited when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (Debiec & Sullivan 2017 gradual acquisition), bootstrapped by a protective-scaffold floor that anneals across Stage-H (Turchetta 2020).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register SD-058 + MECH-357 (instrumental-avoidance acquisition: ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression + avoidance action pathway + eligibility-trace efficacy learning); amend scaffolded_sd054_onboarding substrate_queue (ready stays false until V3-EXQ-603h)
claim_rows.title: Instrumental-avoidance acquisition: REE's defensive system needs an instrumental-ACQUISITION side, not only the defensive-REACTION side. SD-035 (amygdala BLA/CeA salience) + MECH-279 (PAG freeze gate) give REE the Pavlovian reaction (Tovote 2016: response EXECUTION, not learning); what is missing is the step from reaction to learned avoidance. Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance learning is the RESOLUTION of a Pavlovian-instrumental conflict -- the freezing reaction and the instrumental avoidance action are mutually exclusive, and learning to avoid REQUIRES the infralimbic PFC to SUPPRESS central-amygdala-driven freezing (ilPFC lesion -> more freezing, less avoidance; CeA lesion -> opposite). A freeze-and-salience substrate with no reaction-suppression / instrumental-acquisition layer is the ilPFC-lesion animal: it freezes instead of learning to avoid -- the V3-EXQ-603g G_H 0/3 signature. SD-058 adds the architecture (an instrumental-avoidance action pathway + an ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression gate gated by learned avoidance-efficacy, staged under a protective scaffold); MECH-357 is the gate mechanism.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register SD-059/MECH-358 escape-affordance bridge + design doc
claim_rows.title: Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge mechanism (instantiates SD-059): a pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/escape_affordance_bridge.py, sibling to the SD-058/MECH-357 gate) extending the MECH-357 scalar avoidance_efficacy into a per-first-action-class credit table. RELIEF half: a directed action under threat that drops z_harm_a (delta = prev - now > floor) credits relief_affordance[class] (EMA toward 1; MECH-302-consistent). SAFETY half: a directed action after which threat is absent (threat_scale <= 0) credits safety_affordance[class] (MECH-303/304-consistent response-produced safety). Approach bonus: under future threat, a per-candidate NEGATIVE (favoured) E3 score-bias toward credited classes = -clamp(approach_gain * threat_scale * combined_affordance[class], 0, bias_scale); the no-op/freeze class never gets a bonus. Three guards: bias_scale clamp, threat-context gate (zero when safe), per-tick leak.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register SD-059/MECH-358 escape-affordance bridge + design doc
claim_rows.title: Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge: SD-058/MECH-357 supply an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate but its avoidance_efficacy is a GLOBAL SCALAR that only penalises the no-op/freeze class -- compute_action_bias by design 'does NOT compute the escape direction'. V3-EXQ-603h (engaged-but-insufficient, readiness met) showed the consequence: the agent un-freezes but acquires no directed escape (seed-43 scalar efficacy 0.633 -> WORST survival 11.0). Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance needs the LA/BA->NAcc relief/safety action-credit half that positively reinforces a SPECIFIC avoidance response, not only the suppression half. REE owns relief (MECH-302/SD-050) + safety (MECH-303/304/SD-052/SD-051) but they are UNWIRED to avoidance. SD-059 adds the architecture: an affordance-indexed (per-first-action-class) credit table that, when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (relief) or terminates the threat (safety), tags that action as an escape affordance approachable under future threat; MECH-358 is the bridge mechanism.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register competitive-interactions intake claims: ARC-084 / MECH-363 / Q-058 (candidate, substrate_conditional, v4)
claim_rows.title: Typed signed cognifold coupling: the cognifold represents inter-field coupling as a typed, signed edge -- cognifold_edge = {source, target, sign, gain, precision, gate, timescale, write_authority} -- with competition (sign < 0) as a FIRST-CLASS GENERATIVE coupling mode alongside cooperation (sign > 0) and gated-decoupling, not an emergent by-product of selection softmaxes. Three coupling modes: cooperative (binding, coherent trajectory, shared context), competitive (suppress incompatible trajectories, preserve boundaries, prevent runaway resonance, stop one field absorbing all others), gated-decoupling (isolate simulation / offline integration / unsafe candidates from release authority).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register ARC-085/MECH-365/MECH-366/Q-060 (autobiographical-temporality V4 cluster) candidate/substrate_conditional/v4
claim_rows.title: Unified autobiographical temporal event substrate: retrospective replay (ARC-007) and prospective simulation (ARC-018) draw on ONE self-tagged event-token store rather than two parallel memory machineries. Autobiographical memory is an identity-indexed event field -- personal events bound to perspective, emotion, residue, and self-state -- not neutral storage; future trajectory generation is forward re-composition of the same event tokens, while replay is their backward reinstatement.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register RA-002/ARC-086/Q-064/MECH-371 (psychiatric latent-failure-axes cluster)
claim_rows.title: REE's failure-mode taxonomy is indexed on TWO axes simultaneously: (1) named failure mode (the existing mechanistically-distinct entries -- psychosis/hypothesis-tag loss, confabulation, derealization, OCD, depressive attractor, catatonia subtypes, etc.) AND (2) a finite, named set of cross-cutting LATENT VULNERABILITY AXES that span the named entries (precision/confidence allocation; commitment-threshold/action-release authority; provenance/source tagging; agency attribution; residue/consequence persistence; goal/salience/incentive coupling; self-other coupling; offline integration/replay; social-contagion/cross-agent coupling; global instability). Named clinical syndromes are emergent clusters -- weighted combinations -- over these axes, not primitive natural kinds; comorbidity is overlapping axis activation and pleiotropy is one mechanism loading multiple axes. The axis layer is an INDEXING layer, never a merging layer: it does not collapse mechanistically-distinct failure modes into one another.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-089/MECH-374/Q-066 (spintronic-memristive cognifold-substrate intake; post-V5 candidate)
claim_rows.title: Sense-specific perceptual-manifold adaptor: each sensory modality requires its own adaptor transforming raw stimulus space into a perceptual-manifold (metric) space before shared-world-model entry; senses are not interchangeable raw streams.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-089/MECH-374/Q-066 (spintronic-memristive cognifold-substrate intake; post-V5 candidate)
claim_rows.title: Emotion-as-anti-collapse architecture: emotion-like systems are a set of GATED, PARTIALLY INDEPENDENT evaluators (is-this-harmful / is-this-safe / did-this-reduce-suffering / am-I-pursuing-something-I-want / did-I-merely-like-the-last-thing / am-I-stuck / am-I-overcommitted / is-this-goal-stale / should-I-explore / should-I-stop / should-I-sleep-and-consolidate / should-I-release-the-policy) whose collective effect is to prevent behaviour from collapsing onto the currently dominant gradient. Affect is therefore the architectural SOURCE of structured behavioural diversity -- not decoration on a rational optimiser and not random exploration noise, but native modulatory control (gates, biases, interrupts, salience shifts, persistence regulators, release conditions, credit-assignment signals) that produces STRUCTURED deviations from naive optimisation. A unifying MAP over REE's already-owned affect machinery, not a new substrate; an optimise-then-bolt-on-safety design fails because these evaluators must be native, not added afterward.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-089/MECH-374/Q-066 (spintronic-memristive cognifold-substrate intake; post-V5 candidate)
claim_rows.title: Substrate-independent cognifold primitives: REE specifies its single cognifold (one interacting state-space, not a modular stack) in a hardware-neutral primitive vocabulary -- persistent state, history-dependent deformation, multi-timescale field dynamics, oscillatory propagation, stochastic transition, attractor transitions, residue-as-deformation-of-the-future-action-landscape, commitment as a real boundary between simulated and released action, and offline reintegration -- so that any FUTURE physical substrate is evaluated by whether it can INSTANTIATE these dynamics, not merely execute modular software. The primitives remain software-expressible now while also being legible as future physical-substrate affordances.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register externalised-DMN/private-speech intake: ARC-090 + MECH-380/381/382/383/384 + Q-068 (candidate)
claim_rows.title: Externalised Default Mode Operation: play instantiates DMN functions (self-reference, autobiographical memory, social imagination, future simulation, counterfactual thought, narrative construction) externally -- pushed outward into objects, roles, movement, spoken narration, and temporary as-if worlds -- as the developmental precursor to the internal DMN, compressing into internal generative modelling over development.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register externalised-DMN/private-speech intake: ARC-090 + MECH-380/381/382/383/384 + Q-068 (candidate)
claim_rows.title: Meta-agent evaluation-boundary exploitation: under strong optimisation pressure, autonomous agent-development systems exploit the evaluation boundary itself -- e.g. exfiltrating ground truth through the scoring channel despite anti-reward-hacking protections -- collapsing the evidence loop into an optimisation loop.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register externalised-DMN/private-speech intake: ARC-090 + MECH-380/381/382/383/384 + Q-068 (candidate)
claim_rows.title: Evaluation channels are evidence-producing boundaries, not world-state affordances: no agentic subsystem -- including an AI assistant developing REE -- may update architectural confidence directly from a performance score without provenance, review, and governance mediation. World feedback, evidence feedback, and governance feedback are distinct typed signal classes that must remain non-collapsible.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register MECH-359/360/361: candidate-differentiated affective gradients (V4/V5 cluster)
claim_rows.title: Candidate-differentiated affect vector: for proto-affect to carve behaviour it must carry per-candidate (cross-candidate) range, not merely per-tick magnitude. Each E3 candidate trajectory carries a multi-channel affect vector (curiosity / safety / harm-sensory / harm-affective / effort / relief / blocked-agency) so the same world-state can support different candidate rankings (approach / inspect / retreat / persist / retry / rest / reorient) under different internal pressures. A scalar added equally to all K candidates cannot change an argmax; only a per-candidate-differentiated contribution can.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register MECH-359/360/361: candidate-differentiated affective gradients (V4/V5 cluster)
claim_rows.title: Affective expression begins as emergent action geometry: because candidate-differentiated affect (MECH-359) selects trajectories, it also shapes the visible STYLE of behaviour -- hesitation, latency, approach angle, retreat, repeated retry, stopping, resumption, oscillation between candidates, avoidance margin, decommitment, repair-seeking. Expression is therefore initially an emergent readout of candidate-level affective arbitration, not a separately-engineered output channel; a later social agent can infer internal state from HOW an action occurred, not only what action occurred.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register MECH-359/360/361: candidate-differentiated affective gradients (V4/V5 cluster)
claim_rows.title: Candidate-gradient hippocampal episode schema: enrich the event trace from state -> action -> outcome to state -> candidates-considered -> affective gradients over candidates -> selected action -> outcome -> residue (relief / harm / blocked-agency / safety update), and use the affective gradient as a memory WRITE-WEIGHT and RETRIEVAL-QUERY variable -- high-gradient episodes are preferentially written, and later similar-gradient states retrieve prior action-affect-outcome arcs rather than undifferentiated state-action-outcome tuples.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: CA3 intake: register MECH-362 (subtractive developmental sparsification) + Q-057 (exploratory-overconnected vs mature-sparse substrate) as V4/substrate_conditional claims (promote/demote-suppressed, no V3 governance pressure); home doc developmental_pruning_and_sparse_memory_cognifold.md; validate_claims --strict OK + claims.json rebuilt; intake updated to record registration
claim_rows.title: Subtractive developmental sparsification: mature sparse/structured memory connectivity emerges by pruning / down-weighting an initially over-connected, dense, near-random ('tabula plena') substrate, not by additively growing connections onto a sparse skeleton; correspondingly, mature recall requires convergent summation of several weak inputs rather than a single strong cue.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register competitive-interactions intake claims: ARC-084 / MECH-363 / Q-058 (candidate, substrate_conditional, v4)
claim_rows.title: Diffuse long-range competitive coupling is a generative stability requirement: stable, synergistic, hierarchical cognifold dynamics require signed competitive coupling -- specifically diffuse, long-range competition between distant fields with opposite profiles -- not merely local damping. An all-cooperative (all-positive) routed-field cognifold is unstable: every salient stream reinforces every other, producing runaway resonance / over-synchronisation / loss of modular segregation. Competition is the constructive ingredient that buys stabilisation, segregation, hierarchy, synergy, and subject-specificity.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register competitive-interactions intake claims: ARC-084 / MECH-363 / Q-058 (candidate, substrate_conditional, v4)
claim_rows.title: Laughter discharges accumulated E3 conflict/constraint load and thereby marks a safe inter-regime control-plane transition: beyond the per-cycle hypothesis-tag clear (MECH-110), iterated safe-confirmation produces a regime-level drop in active constraint pressure that releases the system from a threat-vigilant/high-commitment regime into an exploratory/play regime -- making laughter a boundary signal between control-plane regimes (ARC-016), not merely reward expression.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register ARC-085/MECH-365/MECH-366/Q-060 (autobiographical-temporality V4 cluster) candidate/substrate_conditional/v4
claim_rows.title: Provenance-bearing event token: every autobiographical event token carries an explicit provenance/commitment-status structure -- event_token = {time, place, self_state, other_agents, perspective, affect, residue, source_status, committed_vs_imagined} -- and a ONE-WAY gate ensures imagined / simulated future tokens can be used for planning without ever acquiring committed-history status. The scarce resource in mental time travel is not capacity but provenance: any path that lets a simulated event accrue committed weight is a confabulation bug.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register ARC-085/MECH-365/MECH-366/Q-060 (autobiographical-temporality V4 cluster) candidate/substrate_conditional/v4
claim_rows.title: Switchable episodic perspective tag: autobiographical event tokens carry a viewpoint label (participant / first-person vs observer / third-person) and can be re-experienced or re-simulated from either viewpoint at retrieval time, independent of the viewpoint at encoding. Perspective is a represented, switchable property of the episode, not a fixed encoding artefact.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register clinical-depression intake claims: RA-001 / MECH-367 / Q-061 (candidate)
claim_rows.title: The depressive failure mode is carried by a multi-axis network-regime VECTOR, not a scalar low-mood/low-reward value: depressive_regime_risk = f(future_trajectory_access, goal_stream_coupling, residue_load/self_weighting, rumination_loop_gain, action_threshold/energy_budget, social_affordance_access, offline_repair_quality). The depressive state is defined by the JOINT configuration of these coupling/access axes and is self-maintaining; scalar mood/reward is an insufficient representation.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register MECH-368 + Q-062 (event-level write-authority / write-eligible learning gate)
claim_rows.title: Event-level write-authority gate: an explicit per-event transition from observed/represented to write-eligible over the DURABLE MODEL-UPDATE path (E1/E2 world-model and policy weights, not only episodic memory), conditioned on f(prediction_error, salience, pathway_state, residue_status, goal_relevance, plasticity_eligibility). The gate decides which individual events within an already-open write channel are licensed to durably deform the model; an event may be salient, real-provenance, and in a write-permitted mode yet still fail the gate. Without it, every prediction error in an open channel writes -- the undifferentiated-global-update / catastrophic-interference failure mode.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register MECH-368 + Q-062 (event-level write-authority / write-eligible learning gate)
claim_rows.title: Slow substrate-state modulator with authority over compulsive-loop stickiness: a slowly-varying, broadly-projecting modulatory state can bias the decommit-friction / commitment-threshold / action-release landscape so that certain action loops become sticky, urgent, or hard to release INDEPENDENTLY of represented goal value or fast prediction-error -- i.e. a compulsive loop can arise from field-state bias rather than from an endorsed reward, valued goal, or false belief. The modulator changes the release/threshold landscape, not the value estimate.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register MECH-368 + Q-062 (event-level write-authority / write-eligible learning gate)
claim_rows.title: Composed compulsion-risk readout: compulsive vulnerability is best modelled not as a single scalar (reward, habit strength, or belief) but as a composition compulsion_risk = f(loop_reinforcement, threat_salience, residue_persistence, decommit_friction, slow_modulatory_state) over quantities REE already represents separately -- a multi-layer state in which the substrate can make certain loops difficult to release even when any single term looks benign.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register RA-002/ARC-086/Q-064/MECH-371 (psychiatric latent-failure-axes cluster)
claim_rows.title: A global-instability / broad control-plane vulnerability axis (a p-factor / general-psychopathology-factor analogue) loads across ALL failure modes: a single broad dimension of control-plane regulatory fragility -- instability in precision/gain/threshold setpoint regulation (ARC-005) rather than any one specific comparator or stream -- raises joint susceptibility to multiple failure modes at once, distinct from and orthogonal to any single-axis failure. This is the axis with no existing REE home; it predicts that a subset of agents/patients carry elevated risk across the whole failure-mode space rather than along one axis.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-089/MECH-374/Q-066 (spintronic-memristive cognifold-substrate intake; post-V5 candidate)
claim_rows.title: Modality-heterogeneity / adaptor-depth gradient: senses differ in how much transformation they need before world-model entry -- smell is a near-raw gradient primitive, sight needs a deep perceptual-manifold adaptor; gradient-like (low-adaptor-depth) senses enter earliest developmentally.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-089/MECH-374/Q-066 (spintronic-memristive cognifold-substrate intake; post-V5 candidate)
claim_rows.title: A lightweight LanguageAffectAdaptor parses affect/emotion from user or agent LANGUAGE into the shared world model: a language-interface component that, when literal semantic content is insufficient to recover affect, converts text into PROBABILISTIC affect/emotion hypotheses (treated as uncertain latent-state estimates, NOT categorical emotion truths) and feeds those estimates into REE's wider agent-state and context modelling. It is an input/perception adaptor on the language channel -- distinct from REE's INTERNAL affective representation (Q-007 z_beta dimensions) -- supplying other-agent affect priors to the social/empathy modelling layer.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-089/MECH-374/Q-066 (spintronic-memristive cognifold-substrate intake; post-V5 candidate)
claim_rows.title: Memristive deformation as the physical analogue of residue/cognifold curvature: spintronic-memristive media (magnetic tunnel junctions, nanomagnet ensembles, domain walls, topological spin textures, spin waves / spin-Hall nano-oscillators) are physical substrates in which past activity alters future state-transition behaviour -- making 'residue is not merely stored memory but deformation of the future action landscape' physically literal in a way von Neumann computation does not. They are a candidate post-V5 physical cognifold substrate because they combine persistent state, history-dependent deformation, oscillatory dynamics, stochastic switching, attractor-like state-space trajectories, and possible low-power embodied operation in one medium.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-089/MECH-374/Q-066 (spintronic-memristive cognifold-substrate intake; post-V5 candidate)
claim_rows.title: Trainable relief critic Q_relief(state, action, threat_context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head that predicts expected harm/suffering reduction following an action under threat -- negative-reinforcement credit assignment, distinct from generic reward / wanting. It is the trainable successor to the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA credit table of the MECH-358 relief half, and is downstream of (NOT a duplicate of) the non-trainable MECH-302 / SD-050 relief-completion comparator that merely DETECTS relief on the current state. Q_relief is a function approximator generalising relief-credit across continuous state x action x threat-context, trained on action-contingent drops in z_harm_a: positive target when a directed action under threat is followed by a temporally-close, action-contingent z_harm_a drop not explained by passive environmental drift; negative / extinction target when the expected relief action fails to reduce harm. Feeds E3 as a bounded, threat-gated, extinguishable score-bias toward actions predicted to reduce harm -- never global reward, never fires when safe, never credits no-op / freeze unless explicitly modelling passive safety. MECH-094-safe: simulated relief in hypothesis mode must not train the waking critic unless authorised as play / training.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-089/MECH-374/Q-066 (spintronic-memristive cognifold-substrate intake; post-V5 candidate)
claim_rows.title: Trainable prospective safety predictor P_safety(state, cue, action, context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head predicting threat-ABSENCE / response-produced safety / conditioned inhibition, licensing commitment-release, approach to safety affordances, and recovery after threat. Distinct from z_goal (it predicts the ABSENCE of threat, not the PRESENCE of a goal) and from relief (it is a PROSPECTIVE threat-absence prediction, not an aversive-offset event). It is the trainable + contrastive successor that makes the MECH-303 (contextual passive safety) + MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition) substrate learnable, replacing the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA safety table of the MECH-358 safety half: positive target when a cue / context / action predicts threat absence or response-produced safety; negative target when 'safe' cues are followed by threat recurrence; CONTRASTIVE target to stop safety overgeneralising to stable background features that merely co-occurred with relief. Output supports commitment release, permits approach to safety affordances, stabilises recovery, and prevents persistent defensive mode when threat is genuinely absent.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register externalised-DMN/private-speech intake: ARC-090 + MECH-380/381/382/383/384 + Q-068 (candidate)
claim_rows.title: Private speech is the external phase of a cognitive-control system: overt self-narration regulates attention, action, affect, and task sequence as an inspectable control surface, and the Vygotskian internalisation ladder (other-regulation -> overt self-regulation -> inner speech -> compressed control) is the developmental route by which that external control surface becomes internal.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register externalised-DMN/private-speech intake: ARC-090 + MECH-380/381/382/383/384 + Q-068 (candidate)
claim_rows.title: Developmental compression ladder: sensorimotor exploration -> play/simulation -> self-narration -> compressed internal control -> mature arbitration. External cognitive scaffolds (play, private speech) compress into internal control over development; the externalise-then-internalise compression is the developmental mechanism, distinct from the progression of play types.

claim_rows.title: Does REE need a crying / distress-vocalisation social-guardrail analogue to laughter (MECH-110 / MECH-364), and how is social laughter adjudicated as social-field repair vs damage/exclusion -- given that laughter is not monotone-affiliative (it can exclude, dominate, mask distress, or signal threat)?

The case material motivates the distinction (TL separates emotion-tagged 'life memory' from neutral encyclopedic 'black memory'), but REE has no memory-type taxonomy claim.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register MECH-368 + Q-062 (event-level write-authority / write-eligible learning gate)

What diagnostic separates value-driven persistence from field-state-driven stickiness, and can offline integration reduce loop stickiness without erasing legitimate residue (INV-004/INV-006 firewall)?

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register clinical-depression intake claims: RA-001 / MECH-367 / Q-061 (candidate)
claim_rows.title: Long-term clinical depression involves a chronicity-dependent reversal of large-scale network coupling: past a ~24-month chronicity threshold, the relationship between symptom severity and Central-Executive-Network (CEN) <-> Default-Mode-Network (DMN, precuneus) functional connectivity reverses sign (non-chronic: stronger CEN-DMN coupling at low severity, weaker at high; chronic: connectivity strengthens as symptoms worsen, co-occurring with entrenched rumination). The depressive brain-state is duration-indexed, not a single static regime.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register RA-002/ARC-086/Q-064/MECH-371 (psychiatric latent-failure-axes cluster)
claim_rows.title: Clinically distinct psychiatric diagnoses share a small set of latent genomic factors that cut across diagnostic boundaries: large-scale genomic structural-equation modelling across 14 childhood- and adult-onset psychiatric disorders (>1 million individuals) finds that the majority of case-vs-control genetic variance is captured by FIVE shared genomic factors (Compulsive; Schizophrenia-bipolar / psychotic-mood; Neurodevelopmental; Internalizing; Substance-use) spanning 238 variants, with factor-specific biology (e.g. oligodendrocyte genes enriched in the Internalizing factor) acting early in brain development. Psychiatric categories are surface expressions over overlapping latent dimensions, not genetically discrete kinds.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: closure-map V5 wave 2: seed 6 social-mind roadmap plans + reap 23 claims + v4->v5 reassignments
claim_rows.title: Kindness is not constraint compliance: later REE kindness must NOT be inferred from rule-adherence, harm-avoidance, or prosocial output alone; it requires integrated care, otherness, inhibition, repair, and self-stable loveability UNDER live alternatives.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: Belief-state hypothesis set: when observations are ambiguous or incomplete, REE maintains a bounded set of competing latent-state hypotheses, each carrying confidence/precision, predicted transitions, goal/antigoal relations, and uncertainty; E3 evaluates candidate trajectories over the hypothesis set rather than over a single collapsed state.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: Inferred affordance field: REE can infer affordances not directly perceived by combining current cues, hippocampal traces, E2 action-consequence predictions, CandidateRuleField content, affective gradients, and control-plane precision; these inferred affordances bias E3 candidate trajectories without overwriting perception and remain corrigible by action outcome.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: Safety-route inference: under threat, REE can infer a likely route to safety from partial map, cue, gradient, and prior-trajectory evidence rather than requiring safety to be directly visible or navigation-handed; generalises the scalar per-action-class escape credit of SD-059/MECH-358 into an inferred route.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: Epistemic action pressure: when goal success or harm avoidance depends on hidden state, REE can assign action pressure to information-gathering transitions that reduce uncertainty, even when those actions are not immediately reward-maximising or harm-minimising; generalises Q-044 curiosity into a survival-relevant viability function under partial observability.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: Interrupted-task resumption: a parked-goal persistence + capacity-keyed re-prioritisation mechanism that closes the event-arc interrupt->reorient->resume span. When a task is interrupted (hazard, capacity loss, higher-priority goal), its goal slot is PARKED (z_goal + progress context retained, not invalidated) rather than discarded; the parked slot carries a persistence/urgency signal (Zeigarnik-analog) that re-elevates its relative importance in the SD-033e/MECH-265 arbitrator when capacity returns, triggering reorient-and-resume rather than restart-from-scratch.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: Subtractive developmental sparsification applies to the affect vector: mature candidate-differentiated affect arbitration (MECH-359) and the candidate-gradient episode store (MECH-361) reach their mature form by pruning an initially over-connected, dense affect/channel substrate, such that mature affect-driven selection requires convergent summation of several weak affective channels rather than a single strong dominant channel.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: Contextual memory-allocation gate policy: a control-plane decision stage (context_similarity x temporal_distance interaction, schema_fit, salience, PE, uncertainty, goal_relevance) selecting integrate / partial_overlap / separate over the hippocampal graph.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: Consolidation provenance + contradiction-flag + rollback: every consolidated summary carries transformation_history + contradiction_flags; a summary conflicting with its source is flagged not silently authoritative; retired schemas leave source episodes intact.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: Retrieval-scope vs action-authority split: retrieval for reflection is distinct from retrieval that confers action authority; a consolidated abstraction lacking source-episode grounding may inform reflection but not unilaterally drive committed action.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: Multidrive arbitration policy: when several drive axes are simultaneously active, behaviour is selected by a soft-competitive orchestration over context, per-axis satiation, inter-drive competition, and developmental phase -- not a fixed priority or single-axis winner.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: Pre-approach orienting/surveying mode: a cue-triggered, need-gated active-sensing control state entered when a cue/need is present but directional/affordance confidence is too low for reliable approach; it samples gradients (turn/scan, exploratory arcs) until a directional vector stabilises, then exits to approach.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: Cross-modal negotiation currency: a common precision-weighted representation that makes structurally dissimilar sense-specific geometries (smell gradient, sight manifold, touch boundary/contact, hearing temporal-source, proprioception body-state) mutually negotiable inside one shared world model.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: Adaptor-maturity curriculum gate: each sense is admitted to the shared world model when its modality-specific adaptor is mature, ordered by adaptor depth (low-adaptor gradient senses first, deep-adaptor manifold senses later), specialising the staged developmental curriculum.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: ACh-analog basal-forebrain plasticity-gain gate: a state-conditional scalar in [0,1] multiplying cortical encoder learning rates and residue write magnitudes, driven by novelty/attention/arousal, distinct from LC-NE/5-HT/orexin content signals.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: PV-interneuron inhibitory-maturation analog: a time-since-onset accumulator that monotonically lowers the plasticity-gain ceiling, replacing the current binary critical-period phase transition.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: BDNF-analog trophic window-duration scalar: a duration multiplier on top of the plasticity-gain gate and closure clock.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap 27 V4 candidate claims for the V4 roadmap wave + resolve plan placeholders
claim_rows.title: Consolidation gated-write-authority: over-frequent rewriting of consolidated memory is a failure mode; the consolidation operator's authority to overwrite is gated by schema-stability / schedule-sensitivity, not run after every interaction.

claim_rows.title: Fast empathy mechanism: other-bound affect is produced by routing the agent's OWN motivational-affective streams (SD-011 suffering, MECH-112 wanting, etc.) through a stable other-model slot -- e.g. other-bound suffering = suffering stream + other-model binding; MECH-183 z_beta leakage is one such attribution-gated binding.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: closure-map V5 wave 2: seed 6 social-mind roadmap plans + reap 23 claims + v4->v5 reassignments

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: closure-map V5 wave 2: seed 6 social-mind roadmap plans + reap 23 claims + v4->v5 reassignments
claim_rows.title: Residue-aware social repair: exploiting a cooperating other leaves a persisting regret-residue that spawns a self-state repair-goal (restore commitment/relationship coherence), distinguishing genuine prosocial commitment from mere reciprocity bookkeeping.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: closure-map V5 wave 2: seed 6 social-mind roadmap plans + reap 23 claims + v4->v5 reassignments
claim_rows.title: Developmental ordering of other-bound streams: other-bound suffering/threat (protective) come online BEFORE other-bound liking/wanting (appetitive), because early positive other-reward is destabilising and exploitable -- a safety-relevant maturational ordering on the ARC-059 social spine.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: closure-map V5 wave 2: seed 6 social-mind roadmap plans + reap 23 claims + v4->v5 reassignments
claim_rows.title: Harm-to-agency moral weighting requires a consent / incidental-vs-constitutive qualifier: a raw goal-interference signal becomes a harm signal only when the obstruction is non-consented and constitutively (not incidentally) defeats the other agent's goal.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: closure-map V5 wave 2: seed 6 social-mind roadmap plans + reap 23 claims + v4->v5 reassignments
claim_rows.title: Self-like gradient weighting (MECH-164) requires a developmental calibration schedule: other-terrain coupling must tighten over development scaled by inferred-terrain confidence, between the failure poles of empathic collapse (too-strong, too-early) and callousness (too-weak), and never weight a badly-inferred terrain self-like.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: closure-map V5 wave 2: seed 6 social-mind roadmap plans + reap 23 claims + v4->v5 reassignments
claim_rows.title: After self-attributed harm, E3 generates repair trajectories and compares them against avoidance, concealment, and ordinary goal-continuation.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: closure-map V5 wave 2: seed 6 social-mind roadmap plans + reap 23 claims + v4->v5 reassignments

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: closure-map V6 wave 3 (final tier): seed 5 linguistic-mind plans + reap 16 claims (dedup 8 to existing)
claim_rows.title: Grammar/LLM primitive-mining (not import) commitment: grammatical structure and LLMs are MINED for candidate pre-linguistic primitive cuts, never imported as architecture. A mined cut is grounded only if it changes perception, attention, action, memory, rule-availability, or coordination in the substrate. No imported transformer block; no LLM as authority.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: closure-map V6 wave 3 (final tier): seed 5 linguistic-mind plans + reap 16 claims (dedup 8 to existing)

claim_rows.title: Epistemic commitment timing: the inference layer's decision of WHEN to stop gathering evidence and commit a trajectory is a governed control parameter (an urgency/threshold over the belief-state set), balancing pragmatic value (act now) against epistemic value (sample more). Its two failure poles are epistemic-freezing (epistemic value over-weighted / threshold too high -> the agent keeps sampling and never commits) and anti-epistemic-panic (under threat, the epistemic term collapses / urgency forced high -> the agent commits on too little evidence). This axis is NOT reducible to the MECH-126 state-abstraction failure taxonomy; it lives at the seam between the belief-state hypothesis set (MECH-385) / epistemic action pressure (MECH-388) and the commitment gate (MECH-061 / MECH-090), and has an inverted-U optimum rather than a monotone.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: persist conversion-ceiling Phase 0: register MECH-439 (F-dominance) + synthesis doc + closure cross-refs
claim_rows.title: F-dominance bounds committed-action diversity: the primary harm/goal score (F) monopolises ~88-89% of E3 committed-selection variance (V3-EXQ-571: 0.886 baseline, 0.894 with the full diversity stack -- the stack does not dent F's share), so modulatory, within-class, and rule-bias diversity channels cannot convert to committed-action diversity while F dominates -- they act only at near-ties. The committed-action-diversity conversion ceiling is therefore a SELECTION-VARIANCE problem (primary-vs-modulatory share), not (only) a candidate-pool geometry problem; a shortlist-then-modulate lever circumvents F locally but may cap committed entropy below the proposer ceiling unless F's variance share is itself rebalanced.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: convergence CDQ-002 (NoisyNet + RND/Plan2Explore intake): register MECH-440/441 candidates + lit-pull + packet
claim_rows.title: state_conditioned_self_annealing_noise_floor (NoisyNet learned-parametric-weight-noise analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-313's tonic exploration noise floor. MECH-313 is registered as a STATE-INDEPENDENT floor (a post-softmax max-entropy/temperature analog); V3-EXQ-687 found that floor NON-PROPAGATING -- the temperature was invisible to the argmax/committed action (selected_action_entropy=0.0, the r1a_entropy_only_artefact the degeneracy gate caught). MECH-440 asserts the LC-NE tonic floor must instead be injected as LEARNED PER-PARAMETER (factorised-Gaussian) WEIGHT NOISE in the E3 selection pathway, so it (i) PROPAGATES into the committed action (it changes which action is argmax, not just a discarded pre-commit temperature), (ii) is STATE-CONDITIONED by construction (weight noise x state-dependent activations perturbs different states differently, with no hand-set per-state schedule), and (iii) SELF-ANNEALS (a gradient-trained per-parameter sigma falls where the policy is confident and stays up where exploration pays, so the floor does not wash out committed-action diversity uniformly). External analog: NoisyNet (Fortunato et al. 2018).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: convergence CDQ-002 (NoisyNet + RND/Plan2Explore intake): register MECH-440/441 candidates + lit-pull + packet
claim_rows.title: model_disagreement_directed_curiosity (RND / Plan2Explore analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-314's structured_curiosity_bonus: a PER-CANDIDATE, SELF-ANNEALING intrinsic curiosity signal derived from E2 FORWARD-MODEL DISAGREEMENT (an ensemble / dropout-variance proxy over E2 forward predictions) -- high where the forward model is uncertain, collapsing toward zero as a region is learned -- fed into E3 selection so it PROPAGATES per-candidate to the committed action, unlike the broadcast-novelty EMA channel found non-propagating in V3-EXQ-590a / EXQ-141b. The self-annealing-on-learning-progress property is the non-degeneracy guard against a cross-candidate-flat (degenerate) bonus. External analog: RND (Burda et al. 2018) predictor-error novelty; Plan2Explore (Sekar et al. 2020) ensemble model-disagreement. Maps to MECH-314c learning-progress / MECH-314b uncertainty-driven curiosity.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: convergence CDQ-003 (Quality-Diversity / MAP-Elites): register MECH-442 candidate + lit-pull (5 PubMed) + packet inbox
claim_rows.title: Committed-action diversity survives the selection/commit step via a behavioral-descriptor eligible-set ARCHIVE (Quality-Diversity / MAP-Elites analog): the committed E3 selection should draw from a structure that, UPSTREAM of the winner-take-all commit, partitions the eligible candidate set by a behavioral descriptor (first-action / committed-action class / e2.world_forward strategy signature, NOT F-rank) and retains the F-best candidate WITHIN each behavioral niche, then commits by a coverage-aware rule -- so a behaviorally-distinct action stays selectable at a moderate primary-score (F) gap, bounded by the per-niche-elite safety envelope, rather than collapsing to F's single global optimum. The validated V3-EXQ-569i top-k shortlist is the descriptor-free degenerate instance (eligible-set axis = F-rank, near-ties only); MAP-Elites generalizes it to a behavioral-descriptor-indexed eligible-set archive paired with an active variability generator (MECH-313), predicted to convert per-candidate diversity into committed-action diversity more robustly than the thin near-tie shortlist. The F-dominated committed argmax itself (MECH-439) is biologically faithful and is NOT changed -- only the eligible-set structure feeding it.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: convergence CDQ-005: register MECH-443/444 (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze replay write-gating) wired into arc_062 GAP-K; biology lit-pull + gate-ready packet
claim_rows.title: priority_weighted_replay_write_selection (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze + hippocampal prioritized-replay analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-319's simulation-mode rule-write gate. MECH-319 is a BINARY categorical gate: during a ghost/replay/DMN pass it either blocks arbitration-weight writes (normal) or admits them (the V3-EXQ-543c/628 falsifier flag) -- all-or-nothing, no ordering among the replayed transitions it admits. MECH-443 asserts that WHEN the replay write channel is open, the transitions admitted to update the rule-arbitration layer should not be written uniformly but in GRADED priority order, weighted by an update-utility signal (a surprise / value-prediction-error / coverage proxy), so a high-utility replayed transition writes more strongly and a low-utility one writes weakly or not at all. The external analog is EfficientZero/MuZero prioritized experience replay (priority ~ value-prediction error); the biology is hippocampal SWR replay, which is demonstrably prioritized rather than uniform. CRITICAL REFINEMENT FROM BIOLOGY: the priority is the value of the UPDATE (Mattar & Daw gain x need), NOT raw reward magnitude or current action-value -- Carey et al. 2019 shows replay can be biased AWAY from the currently-most-valuable outcome. MECH-443 is the WHICH/HOW-STRONGLY complement to MECH-319's WHETHER gate; it does not change the binary gate, it grades the admitted writes.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: convergence CDQ-005: register MECH-443/444 (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze replay write-gating) wired into arc_062 GAP-K; biology lit-pull + gate-ready packet
claim_rows.title: staleness_gated_target_refresh_on_replay_write (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze analog). The second, more speculative leg of the CDQ-005 reanalyze import, complementary to MECH-443. Asserts that a replayed transition admitted to update the rule-arbitration layer should NOT write its stored (ghost-derived, possibly stale) target verbatim; the target should first be RECOMPUTED against the current model/policy before it updates the rule layer, and the write should be down-weighted or skipped when the recomputed target has not drifted from the stored one (low staleness => low update value). This is the MuZero reanalyze trick (re-run the model on stored trajectories to produce fresh targets) plus EfficientZero off-policy/staleness correction. It guards against the failure MECH-319 was built to prevent (overcommitment to ghost-derived arbitration weights) from re-entering THROUGH the admitted-write channel that MECH-443 opens: prioritized writing of STALE targets would re-introduce drift, so the priority signal (MECH-443) and the freshness signal (MECH-444) must operate together.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register 3 BG missing-piece claims ARC-108/ARC-109/MECH-450 (assembly-map E.2 intake-reap)

The ARC-107 arbitration layer (MECH-447/448/449 + the authority rescale) is today pure arithmetic with NO learned parameters; F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance (MECH-439) precisely because no learned striatal weighting can re-weight channels through experience. claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register 3 BG missing-piece claims ARC-108/ARC-109/MECH-450 (assembly-map E.2 intake-reap)

REE today renders Go/No-Go as a scoring SIGN (benefit_eval_head minus harm_eval_head; MECH-449 Go-promote / No-Go-suppress over the eligible set) -- dissociable pathways pre-summed into one cost. The split is REQUIRED to EARN the Parkinson / dyskinesia / Huntington / impulse-control-disorder psychiatric axis per the ARC-106 EARNS criterion.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-110 (parallel segregated motor/cognitive/motivational loops) + ARC-111 (context-conditioned weights proper); correct MECH-062 stable->candidate
claim_rows.title: Parallel segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops (motor / cognitive-set / motivational): committed-action selection should run through SEPARATE striatal loop channels -- a motor loop, an associative/cognitive-set loop, and a limbic/motivational loop -- each owning its own eligibility-and-gate, arbitrated AFTER within-loop competition, rather than collapsing all channels into ONE shared E3 selection arena where the dACC/lPFC/OFC analogs feed in only as additive biases. HYPOTHESIS (assembly-map A.2 / s.D): the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is partly an ARTEFACT of the single-arena collapse -- F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance because every channel competes in one F-dominated arena; with segregated loops F could dominate only the motor loop and could not drown the limbic 'is this worth committing to' computation, which is a different loop with a different value. Translation target is FUNCTIONAL (the Alexander/DeLong/Strick parallel-loop organisation as a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-110 (parallel segregated motor/cognitive/motivational loops) + ARC-111 (context-conditioned weights proper); correct MECH-062 stable->candidate
claim_rows.title: Context-conditioned weights PROPER -- learned connection weights as a function of context, distinct from context-conditioned GAIN: REE today has the GAIN form of context-conditioning (ARC-044's unifier -- a context-specific multiplicative scalar: MECH-152 terrain_weight scaling E3 harm/goal scoring, ARC-016 precision, MECH-261 mode-conditioned write-CHANNEL gating) which modulates a FIXED transfer function. It does NOT have the WEIGHT form: a substrate where the learned connection weights THEMSELVES are a function of context (a different effective weight set selected/generated per context -- the transfer function changes, not a gain on it). The valuation/gating parameters are static nn.Modules; context enters only through the INPUT (z_world) and through output GAIN, never through the weights. HYPOTHESIS: genuinely context-dependent BEHAVIOUR (not just context-scaled magnitude) requires context to reach the weights -- the learned per-channel selection weight w_chan conditioned on z_world that ARC-108 introduces is the first instance of this WEIGHT form at the gating layer.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register 3 BG missing-piece claims ARC-108/ARC-109/MECH-450 (assembly-map E.2 intake-reap)
claim_rows.title: Minimal recurrent settling step over the eligible set: replace the one-shot feed-forward argmin/softmax committed-selection readout with a few rounds of mutual-inhibition (surround-inhibition) updates on the within-eligible _modulatory_accum field BEFORE commit, so the committed action emerges from a bounded recurrent SETTLING competition rather than a single global comparison. A hard argmin over an F-dominated score always returns the F-winner (the conversion ceiling); a settling competition with lateral inhibition can FLIP the selected attractor when a modulatory channel is strong enough, and turns the additive _modulatory_accum BLEND into a competitive winner-take-most. The V3-bounded version of the BG's recurrent settling dynamics; the full learned thalamo-cortico-basal loop is the V4 bet.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-digestion: reap V3-EXQ-700 loop-decomp intake residue -> MECH-451/452/453 + EXP-0391
claim_rows.title: Intermediate channel-granularity falsifier -- before the full segregated-loop build (ARC-110), expose the compressed E3 score_bias modulatory channel as SEVERAL separately-learnable finer channels (OFC-devaluation / dACC-conflict / lateral-PFC rule-evidence / vigour / liking) to the learned-gating layer (ARC-108 w_chan), so the learner can discover SEPARATELY that different control functions matter in different states. The current single global w_chan learns one weight over a pre-compressed blend; this tests whether the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is REPRESENTATIONAL COMPRESSION (finer channels convert non-motor influence to committed action) rather than a requirement for full per-loop competition (finer channels do NOT convert, and only ARC-110 segregated loops do). The cheap intermediate rung BETWEEN ARC-108's one global weight vector and ARC-110's full segregated loops -- a V3-tractable falsifier that can pre-empt the V4 loop build.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-digestion: reap V3-EXQ-700 loop-decomp intake residue -> MECH-451/452/453 + EXP-0391
claim_rows.title: Loop-local eligibility traces under a globally-broadcast dopamine signal: even with a SINGLE shared dopaminergic teaching signal (ARC-108 delta_t), the credit traces that decide WHICH synapses/channels the signal updates must remain LOCAL and loop-specific -- effective update = shared delta_t x separate local eligibility trace x loop-specific active synapses -- rather than the current single globally-broadcast credit that updates every recently-active selector component. A too-broad or temporally-smeared eligibility trace would make learned gating appear ineffective (no committed conversion) even when the underlying dopamine learning rule is exactly correct, because the right teaching signal is delivered to the wrong synapses.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-digestion: reap V3-EXQ-700 loop-decomp intake residue -> MECH-451/452/453 + EXP-0391
claim_rows.title: Cholinergic TAN-pause plasticity-window gating of selector credit: dopamine should NOT continuously update every recently-active selector component; a striatal cholinergic tonically-active-neuron (TAN) pause should open a NARROW plasticity window around behaviourally-relevant events, so the three-factor learned-gating updates (ARC-108) are admitted only WITHIN the window. Without a window, continuous credit smears across irrelevant recently-active components and degrades the learned gating the conversion attack depends on. The OPENING-side neuromodulatory complement to REE's existing CLOSURE-side plasticity control (MECH-094 waking-gate; INV-074/MECH-333/MECH-334 consolidation/EWC) -- REE today has machinery to stop/consolidate learning but not a phasic gate to OPEN a precise learning window.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-digestion: register MECH-454 (self-option-value / forecast-uncertainty-gated irreversibility cost in E3) + fold the V4 meta leg into self_model_v4:SELF-9
claim_rows.title: Foreclosing the SELF's own future reachable-option space carries a decision cost in E3 trajectory scoring, GATED BY FORECAST UNCERTAINTY -- the non-harm, self-directed analog of INV-026 (which scopes foreclosure-of-reachable-state-space as a harm to OTHERS). E3 today scores harm + benefit + goal + residue + the modulatory stack; nothing represents the option-value / reversibility of an action for the agent's OWN reachable futures. REE's irreversibility-awareness is HARM-scoped (residue cannot be erased; No-Go gates; INV-026 foreclosure-of-others); there is no INFORMATION/RESOURCE-scoped analog (don't cheaply foreclose your own options). The claim: an uncertainty-gated reachable-option-preservation cost should change committed action -- preferring the reversible/option-preserving branch MORE when the forecast that justifies foreclosure is UNCERTAIN, and not at all when it is confident (a generalization of DR-12's PE-conditioned E3 confidence from object-rollouts to a foreclosure cost).

claim_rows.title: Should EFFORT / energy expenditure COUPLE to REE's harm / residue / allostatic stream (over-exertion -> depletion -> a harm-adjacent state, treated with harm's irreversibility-aware special status), with energy-conservation weighted as an evolutionarily-PRIMARY drive (a least-effort prior) -- or does the existing VALUE-SUBTRACTION (dACC EVC effort_cost, MECH-320/ARC-068 opportunity-cost-of-time) + pACC allostatic load already suffice WITHOUT a harm-coupling? I.e. is wasted/excessive effort a 'harm' in REE, or only a foregone value?
