Multi-resource heterogeneity: qualitatively distinct resource types (e.g. food / water / novelty) with per-type identity tags, type-specific spawn distributions, type-specific benefit profiles, and a per-axis homeostatic drive system, plus a curriculum-introduction hook. Provides the goal-identity vocabulary the wanting/liking + identity-distinct-goal cohort (MECH-229/230, MECH-117/216, ARC-030/032, Q-030, SD-015 unblock chain) needs to be honestly tested at substrate level, and the substrate scaffold for downstream developmental-schedule work.

Cue-triggered wanting / cue-recall (L6): a PERCEIVED cue/object type (with no benefit pulse) retrieves its SD-057 incentive token and nudges z_goal toward that object's stored identity embedding BEFORE consumption -- identity-matched (pulls toward the perceived cue's object) and drive-specific (amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive)). hub_targets.title: F-dominance bounds committed-action diversity: the primary harm/goal score (F) monopolises ~88-89% of E3 committed-selection variance (V3-EXQ-571: 0.886 baseline, 0.894 with the full diversity stack -- the stack does not dent F's share), so modulatory, within-class, and rule-bias diversity channels cannot convert to committed-action diversity while F dominates -- they act only at near-ties. The committed-action-diversity conversion ceiling is therefore a SELECTION-VARIANCE problem (primary-vs-modulatory share), not (only) a candidate-pool geometry problem; a shortlist-then-modulate lever circumvents F locally but may cap committed entropy below the proposer ceiling unless F's variance share is itself rebalanced.

Biology-grounding as a standing construction constraint: build REE the agent so each functional component maps to an identified neural substrate at the level of FUNCTION (not homology), with biology as the reference of first resort for underdetermined design forks. Grounding must be load-bearing (a named neural primitive whose defining constraint is validated on a REE falsifier), not decorative naming; divergences from biology are legitimate but must be explicit and tracked, never silent.

Unified dopamine substrate -- signed dopaminergic-RPE teaching signal feeding LEARNED gating weights on the E3 selector: the cortico-striatal weights that decide which channel wins committed-selection authority should themselves be LEARNED via three-factor plasticity (Hebbian co-activation x signed dopaminergic RPE) with the D1-LTP / D2-LTD asymmetry, consolidating the currently-scattered RPE / vigor / incentive functions into one substrate and supplying the GPi->lateral-habenula negative-RPE drain. The ARC-107 arbitration layer (MECH-447/448/449 + the authority rescale) is today pure arithmetic with NO learned parameters; F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance (MECH-439) precisely because no learned striatal weighting can re-weight channels through experience. The single highest-leverage missing BG piece and the proposed next attack on MECH-439.

Closure operator over committed rule_state: on satisfaction of a committed rule_state's completion condition, a 'done' token releases the bistable commitment latch (MECH-090), imposes a temporary No-Go bias (MECH-260) on the just-completed action-class / rule, and discharges the residue associated with that commitment within its domain. The closure token is what turns evaluation off; its absence leaves the governance loop stuck in evaluate-more even when the rule is satisfied. [UMBRELLA NARROWED 2026-06-19: the de-commit-authority sub-property (closure->latch coupling + de-commit magnitude) is decomposed into children MECH-445 (closure->beta coupling engagement) + MECH-446 (de-commit-authority magnitude); see those claims. SD-034 remains the umbrella design_decision -- closure-operator existence + five-part 'done' token firing + No-Go install are retained here and provisional; NOT demoted, NOT superseded.]

dACC-analog bias suppression against recency / monostrategy: the dACC module writes a counter-bias that resists repeating the last-rewarded trajectory when long-term value information demands exploration. Candidate explanation of the monostrategy failure observed in fishtank_viz and earlier queue-diversity results.

Minimal recurrent settling step over the eligible set: replace the one-shot feed-forward argmin/softmax committed-selection readout with a few rounds of mutual-inhibition (surround-inhibition) updates on the within-eligible _modulatory_accum field BEFORE commit, so the committed action emerges from a bounded recurrent SETTLING competition rather than a single global comparison. A hard argmin over an F-dominated score always returns the F-winner (the conversion ceiling); a settling competition with lateral inhibition can FLIP the selected attractor when a modulatory channel is strong enough, and turns the additive _modulatory_accum BLEND into a competitive winner-take-most. The V3-bounded version of the BG's recurrent settling dynamics; the full learned thalamo-cortico-basal loop is the V4 bet.

Is the E3 committed-action conversion ceiling CONSTITUTIONAL (the rules by which candidate actions become eligible to win -- eligibility mask, Go/No-Go pressures, conflict-sensitive hold, threshold/widening, recurrent competition, commitment permission, post-commit latch -- are under-specified) rather than PARAMETRIC (upstream signals too weak / modulatory channels too quiet)? Across mechanistically distinct channels (CRF V3-EXQ-654g, OFC V3-EXQ-485h, SD-037 V3-EXQ-625e, dACC V3-EXQ-445h, modulatory V3-EXQ-569g) a formed-and-measurable signal reaches E3 authority yet committed action does not change reliably -- 'signal strength can exist without lawful access to committed action.' The basal-ganglia action-selection bottleneck (direct/Go, indirect/No-Go, hyperdirect-STN conflict-hold, striatal channel competition, pallidal permission-to-commit) is the functional reference; the open question is whether a BG-like selection CONSTITUTION is required BEYOND MECH-439's F-variance-share rebalance / shortlist levers.

D1/D2 striatal population split with asymmetric dopamine gain: the Go (direct/D1) and No-Go (indirect/D2) pathways should be represented as TWO populations with OPPOSITE dopamine sensitivity (DA potentiates D1/Go via LTP, depresses D2/No-Go via LTD), NOT collapsed into one additive scoring scalar. REE today renders Go/No-Go as a scoring SIGN (benefit_eval_head minus harm_eval_head; MECH-449 Go-promote / No-Go-suppress over the eligible set) -- dissociable pathways pre-summed into one cost. The split is REQUIRED to EARN the Parkinson / dyskinesia / Huntington / impulse-control-disorder psychiatric axis per the ARC-106 EARNS criterion.

created_claims.title: Basal-ganglia-like E3 selector constitution: committed-action selection should be governed by an explicit BG-mirroring eligibility-gating CONSTITUTION -- candidate actions pass through an eligibility mask, bounded Go (direct-pathway promotion) and No-Go (indirect-pathway suppression) pressures, a conflict-sensitive hold / threshold-raise / candidate-set widening (hyperdirect-STN), striatal-like parallel channel competition (rather than one scalar monarch), a pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate (rather than bare argmax), and a stable post-commit latch / de-commit -- so that an upstream signal's STRENGTH is necessary but not sufficient: it also needs LAWFUL ACCESS to committed action. The translation target is functional (a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated BG analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

Relief-completion event reuses goal-achievement / reward-circuit completion machinery. When a comparator on a suffering-stream derivative crosses a downward threshold (sustained suffering-reduction below baseline), the resulting event fires the same downstream tag-and-release pipeline as goal-achievement: MECH-057a (commitment-release / beta-gate-drop), MECH-091 (salient-event phase-reset), and MECH-094 (categorical hypothesis-tag write gate). The polarity of the reinforcement is set at the input -- what counts as the completion is the suffering-derivative crossing, not a reward-onset event -- but the consolidation pipeline is shared. 'Things that just reduced suffering' are tagged in the same approach-attractor structure as 'things liked'.

Context-bound passive safety representation: the agent encodes 'this environment predicts absence of suffering' through sustained non-occurrence of harm, without requiring a discrete teaching event. Substrate is prefrontal-hippocampal (IL for expression gating; vHipp-to-PL-equivalent for contextual store). Update rule is diffuse and slow -- accumulated context exposure without harm drives the store. Output lowers background vigilance threshold: reduces the general avoidance commitment level when the agent is in an environment the store predicts as safe. Parallel to the 'things liked' goal-cue store but tracking suffering-absence rather than reward-presence. Sister claim to MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition pathway).

Instrumental-avoidance acquisition: REE's defensive system needs an instrumental-ACQUISITION side, not only the defensive-REACTION side. SD-035 (amygdala BLA/CeA salience) + MECH-279 (PAG freeze gate) give REE the Pavlovian reaction (Tovote 2016: response EXECUTION, not learning); what is missing is the step from reaction to learned avoidance. Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance learning is the RESOLUTION of a Pavlovian-instrumental conflict -- the freezing reaction and the instrumental avoidance action are mutually exclusive, and learning to avoid REQUIRES the infralimbic PFC to SUPPRESS central-amygdala-driven freezing (ilPFC lesion -> more freezing, less avoidance; CeA lesion -> opposite). A freeze-and-salience substrate with no reaction-suppression / instrumental-acquisition layer is the ilPFC-lesion animal: it freezes instead of learning to avoid -- the V3-EXQ-603g G_H 0/3 signature. SD-058 adds the architecture (an instrumental-avoidance action pathway + an ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression gate gated by learned avoidance-efficacy, staged under a protective scaffold); MECH-357 is the gate mechanism.

PAG-analog gates the freeze response: freeze commit when z_harm_a x duration exceeds threshold; exit requires z_harm_a to fall below an exit_threshold scaled by gaba_tone; failure of exit produces sustained immobility characteristic of stuporous catatonia.

Infralimbic-PFC-analog freeze-suppression + instrumental-avoidance gate: the mechanism instantiating SD-058. A pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/infralimbic_avoidance_gate.py, sibling to SD-035 CeA/BLA, MECH-279 PAG, MECH-313/MECH-320 policy regulators) with three coordinated pieces, all behind use_instrumental_avoidance (no-op default): (a) an instrumental-avoidance ACTION pathway -- a per-candidate E3 score-bias that under threat penalises the no-op/freeze class proportional to effective avoidance-efficacy, RELEASING the instrumental action (it does not pick the escape direction; E3's harm gradient does -- ARC-007-strict-compatible); (b) an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate that, when effective_efficacy*threat_scale >= threshold, overrides the MECH-279 freeze no-op so the agent acts instead of freezing; (c) an eligibility-trace avoidance-efficacy learner credited when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (Debiec & Sullivan 2017 gradual acquisition), bootstrapped by a protective-scaffold floor that anneals across Stage-H (Turchetta 2020).

Cue-specific conditioned safety prediction: a discrete predictive structure encodes 'this stimulus actively predicts that suffering will be omitted', updated by explicit MECH-302 relief-completion events as its teaching signal. Encoding substrate is cortico-striatal (dorsal striatum + dlPFC). Expression/output pathway is IL-to-CeA. This is the conditioned-inhibition mechanism: when a specific cue co-occurs with relief, a separate learned prediction forms that can gate avoidance commitment release when the cue is later present. Sister claim to MECH-303 (contextual passive safety representation).

created_claims.title: Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge: SD-058/MECH-357 supply an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate but its avoidance_efficacy is a GLOBAL SCALAR that only penalises the no-op/freeze class -- compute_action_bias by design 'does NOT compute the escape direction'. V3-EXQ-603h (engaged-but-insufficient, readiness met) showed the consequence: the agent un-freezes but acquires no directed escape (seed-43 scalar efficacy 0.633 -> WORST survival 11.0). Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance needs the LA/BA->NAcc relief/safety action-credit half that positively reinforces a SPECIFIC avoidance response, not only the suppression half. REE owns relief (MECH-302/SD-050) + safety (MECH-303/304/SD-052/SD-051) but they are UNWIRED to avoidance. SD-059 adds the architecture: an affordance-indexed (per-first-action-class) credit table that, when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (relief) or terminates the threat (safety), tags that action as an escape affordance approachable under future threat; MECH-358 is the bridge mechanism.

Clinically distinct psychiatric diagnoses share a small set of latent genomic factors that cut across diagnostic boundaries: large-scale genomic structural-equation modelling across 14 childhood- and adult-onset psychiatric disorders (>1 million individuals) finds that the majority of case-vs-control genetic variance is captured by FIVE shared genomic factors (Compulsive; Schizophrenia-bipolar / psychotic-mood; Neurodevelopmental; Internalizing; Substance-use) spanning 238 variants, with factor-specific biology (e.g. oligodendrocyte genes enriched in the Internalizing factor) acting early in brain development. Psychiatric categories are surface expressions over overlapping latent dimensions, not genetically discrete kinds.

Long-term clinical depression involves a chronicity-dependent reversal of large-scale network coupling: past a ~24-month chronicity threshold, the relationship between symptom severity and Central-Executive-Network (CEN) <-> Default-Mode-Network (DMN, precuneus) functional connectivity reverses sign (non-chronic: stronger CEN-DMN coupling at low severity, weaker at high; chronic: connectivity strengthens as symptoms worsen, co-occurring with entrenched rumination). The depressive brain-state is duration-indexed, not a single static regime.

The gate selects which active E1/E2 content is broadcast to E3 per heartbeat cycle; selection is distinct from (and upstream of) the MECH-089 theta-gamma packaging operation.

Multi-slot GoalState holds N>=2 simultaneously-active goal slots with per-slot z_goal, drive coupling, age, and persistence parameters. Each slot generates its own ghost-goal-bank rank, ghost-probe budget, and proposer trajectories; a dACC-style arbitrator selects which slot's best trajectory commits this tick.

hub_targets.title: Retrieval-time accessibility gating: which stored traces become reinstatable at a given moment is set by two composable READ-side policy layers, not by storage alone. Line A -- a global, slowly-fluctuating, arousal-coupled reinstatement GAIN (content-blind; sets the threshold on whether ANY stored trace crosses into accessibility; stochastic-resonance flavour). Line B -- a content-selective competitive SUPPRESSION that, given what the global gate admits, inhibits specific competitors to keep retrieval clean. The READ-side sibling of MECH-261's mode-conditioned WRITE-gate family: REE owns the gates but not this retrieval-time gating POLICY.

created_claims.title: Does the INTERACTION of retrieval-readiness gain (MECH-425 Line A) and content-selective suppression (MECH-425 Line B) govern the interference-vs-forgetting tradeoff? Predicted regimes: high gain WITHOUT selective suppression -> problematic interference (too many traces accessible at once); low gain -> apparent forgetting; competent retrieval = high gain + sharp competitive suppression.

hub_targets.title: REE's failure-mode taxonomy is indexed on TWO axes simultaneously: (1) named failure mode (the existing mechanistically-distinct entries -- psychosis/hypothesis-tag loss, confabulation, derealization, OCD, depressive attractor, catatonia subtypes, etc.) AND (2) a finite, named set of cross-cutting LATENT VULNERABILITY AXES that span the named entries (precision/confidence allocation; commitment-threshold/action-release authority; provenance/source tagging; agency attribution; residue/consequence persistence; goal/salience/incentive coupling; self-other coupling; offline integration/replay; social-contagion/cross-agent coupling; global instability). Named clinical syndromes are emergent clusters -- weighted combinations -- over these axes, not primitive natural kinds; comorbidity is overlapping axis activation and pleiotropy is one mechanism loading multiple axes. The axis layer is an INDEXING layer, never a merging layer: it does not collapse mechanistically-distinct failure modes into one another.

hub_targets.title: REE developmental training proceeds in three ordered stages: (1) self-as-object — action-space discovery via motor experimentation, producing the substrate SD-003 requires; (2) objects-as-patterns — object-schema formation via experimental action on the world; (3) others-as-special-objects — modelling other agents as objects with their own policies. The ordering is load-bearing: without a self-model the agent cannot distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change; without object-schemas the agent cannot recognise other-agents as a distinguished subclass of objects. Refines the generic ARC-019 curriculum-gates claim.

Developmental ordering of other-bound streams: other-bound suffering/threat (protective) come online BEFORE other-bound liking/wanting (appetitive), because early positive other-reward is destabilising and exploitable -- a safety-relevant maturational ordering on the ARC-059 social spine.

hub_targets.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).

Externalised Default Mode Operation: play instantiates DMN functions (self-reference, autobiographical memory, social imagination, future simulation, counterfactual thought, narrative construction) externally -- pushed outward into objects, roles, movement, spoken narration, and temporary as-if worlds -- as the developmental precursor to the internal DMN, compressing into internal generative modelling over development.
Commit-boundary token reclassifies pre-commit vs post-commit error routing.

created_claims.title: Does REE need an explicit graded action-status vocabulary -- simulated != rehearsed != intended != committed != acted, with a parallel self_reference_frame (first_person / system_state / third_person_model) -- as a first-class annotation, or do MECH-094's simulation/commit write-profiles plus MECH-061's commit-boundary token already suffice to carry the distinction?

hub_targets.title: Relief-completion event reuses goal-achievement / reward-circuit completion machinery. When a comparator on a suffering-stream derivative crosses a downward threshold (sustained suffering-reduction below baseline), the resulting event fires the same downstream tag-and-release pipeline as goal-achievement: MECH-057a (commitment-release / beta-gate-drop), MECH-091 (salient-event phase-reset), and MECH-094 (categorical hypothesis-tag write gate). The polarity of the reinforcement is set at the input -- what counts as the completion is the suffering-derivative crossing, not a reward-onset event -- but the consolidation pipeline is shared. 'Things that just reduced suffering' are tagged in the same approach-attractor structure as 'things liked'.

Context-bound passive safety representation: the agent encodes 'this environment predicts absence of suffering' through sustained non-occurrence of harm, without requiring a discrete teaching event. Substrate is prefrontal-hippocampal (IL for expression gating; vHipp-to-PL-equivalent for contextual store). Update rule is diffuse and slow -- accumulated context exposure without harm drives the store. Output lowers background vigilance threshold: reduces the general avoidance commitment level when the agent is in an environment the store predicts as safe. Parallel to the 'things liked' goal-cue store but tracking suffering-absence rather than reward-presence. Sister claim to MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition pathway).

Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge: SD-058/MECH-357 supply an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate but its avoidance_efficacy is a GLOBAL SCALAR that only penalises the no-op/freeze class -- compute_action_bias by design 'does NOT compute the escape direction'. V3-EXQ-603h (engaged-but-insufficient, readiness met) showed the consequence: the agent un-freezes but acquires no directed escape (seed-43 scalar efficacy 0.633 -> WORST survival 11.0). Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance needs the LA/BA->NAcc relief/safety action-credit half that positively reinforces a SPECIFIC avoidance response, not only the suppression half. REE owns relief (MECH-302/SD-050) + safety (MECH-303/304/SD-052/SD-051) but they are UNWIRED to avoidance. SD-059 adds the architecture: an affordance-indexed (per-first-action-class) credit table that, when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (relief) or terminates the threat (safety), tags that action as an escape affordance approachable under future threat; MECH-358 is the bridge mechanism.

Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge mechanism (instantiates SD-059): a pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/escape_affordance_bridge.py, sibling to the SD-058/MECH-357 gate) extending the MECH-357 scalar avoidance_efficacy into a per-first-action-class credit table. RELIEF half: a directed action under threat that drops z_harm_a (delta = prev - now > floor) credits relief_affordance[class] (EMA toward 1; MECH-302-consistent). SAFETY half: a directed action after which threat is absent (threat_scale <= 0) credits safety_affordance[class] (MECH-303/304-consistent response-produced safety). Approach bonus: under future threat, a per-candidate NEGATIVE (favoured) E3 score-bias toward credited classes = -clamp(approach_gain * threat_scale * combined_affordance[class], 0, bias_scale); the no-op/freeze class never gets a bonus. Three guards: bias_scale clamp, threat-context gate (zero when safe), per-tick leak.

Trainable relief critic Q_relief(state, action, threat_context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head that predicts expected harm/suffering reduction following an action under threat -- negative-reinforcement credit assignment, distinct from generic reward / wanting. It is the trainable successor to the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA credit table of the MECH-358 relief half, and is downstream of (NOT a duplicate of) the non-trainable MECH-302 / SD-050 relief-completion comparator that merely DETECTS relief on the current state. Q_relief is a function approximator generalising relief-credit across continuous state x action x threat-context, trained on action-contingent drops in z_harm_a: positive target when a directed action under threat is followed by a temporally-close, action-contingent z_harm_a drop not explained by passive environmental drift; negative / extinction target when the expected relief action fails to reduce harm. Feeds E3 as a bounded, threat-gated, extinguishable score-bias toward actions predicted to reduce harm -- never global reward, never fires when safe, never credits no-op / freeze unless explicitly modelling passive safety. MECH-094-safe: simulated relief in hypothesis mode must not train the waking critic unless authorised as play / training.

Trainable prospective safety predictor P_safety(state, cue, action, context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head predicting threat-ABSENCE / response-produced safety / conditioned inhibition, licensing commitment-release, approach to safety affordances, and recovery after threat. Distinct from z_goal (it predicts the ABSENCE of threat, not the PRESENCE of a goal) and from relief (it is a PROSPECTIVE threat-absence prediction, not an aversive-offset event). It is the trainable + contrastive successor that makes the MECH-303 (contextual passive safety) + MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition) substrate learnable, replacing the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA safety table of the MECH-358 safety half: positive target when a cue / context / action predicts threat absence or response-produced safety; negative target when 'safe' cues are followed by threat recurrence; CONTRASTIVE target to stop safety overgeneralising to stable background features that merely co-occurred with relief. Output supports commitment release, permits approach to safety affordances, stabilises recovery, and prevents persistent defensive mode when threat is genuinely absent.

created_claims.title: Relief/safety decomposition: when the fixed escape-affordance bridge is insufficient, is the missing structure relief-only (action-contingent escape credit), safety-only (prospective threat-absence prediction), or both-required -- and should a trainable successor (MECH-375 / MECH-376) train only the missing / weak component first?

hub_targets.title: Any agent that builds a model of the world, acts in that world, and learns from experience cannot safely update its world model while using it to navigate the world; it therefore requires periodic offline phases in which action is suspended and the model is reorganised via replay and simulation -- this is not a biological contingency but a general computational necessity for model-building agents.

Substrate-independent cognifold primitives: REE specifies its single cognifold (one interacting state-space, not a modular stack) in a hardware-neutral primitive vocabulary -- persistent state, history-dependent deformation, multi-timescale field dynamics, oscillatory propagation, stochastic transition, attractor transitions, residue-as-deformation-of-the-future-action-landscape, commitment as a real boundary between simulated and released action, and offline reintegration -- so that any FUTURE physical substrate is evaluated by whether it can INSTANTIATE these dynamics, not merely execute modular software. The primitives remain software-expressible now while also being legible as future physical-substrate affordances.

Which REE subsystems require an EXPLICIT signed competitive edge (ARC-084) rather than emergent softmax / winner-take-all / scalar-gating competition alone -- and what are the safety differences between inhibition, competition, decommitment, and residue-based veto across waking action, simulation, and offline integration?

Memristive deformation as the physical analogue of residue/cognifold curvature: spintronic-memristive media (magnetic tunnel junctions, nanomagnet ensembles, domain walls, topological spin textures, spin waves / spin-Hall nano-oscillators) are physical substrates in which past activity alters future state-transition behaviour -- making 'residue is not merely stored memory but deformation of the future action landscape' physically literal in a way von Neumann computation does not. They are a candidate post-V5 physical cognifold substrate because they combine persistent state, history-dependent deformation, oscillatory dynamics, stochastic switching, attractor-like state-space trajectories, and possible low-power embodied operation in one medium.

created_claims.title: Can spintronic-memristive media (or any candidate physical cognifold substrate) scale to embodied REE cognition WITHOUT losing auditability, stability, or the harm/safety boundaries that REE's software cognifold currently enforces -- and which cognifold primitives (ARC-089) does each candidate substrate genuinely instantiate versus merely approximate?

hub_targets.title: Sense-specific perceptual-manifold adaptor: each sensory modality requires its own adaptor transforming raw stimulus space into a perceptual-manifold (metric) space before shared-world-model entry; senses are not interchangeable raw streams.

Modality-heterogeneity / adaptor-depth gradient: senses differ in how much transformation they need before world-model entry -- smell is a near-raw gradient primitive, sight needs a deep perceptual-manifold adaptor; gradient-like (low-adaptor-depth) senses enter earliest developmentally.

created_claims.title: Per-sense adaptor specification and cross-modal negotiability: is each modality's perceptual metric learned or partly defined, and how are heterogeneous sense-specific geometries made mutually negotiable inside one shared world model?

hub_targets.title: difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy (controlled proposal-entropy widening under goal blockage). When goal progress stalls -- repeated failure to improve goal progress, high inter-candidate conflict, low E3 score margin, low committed-action diversity, plateau/stuck-state signal -- WITH goal salience preserved, the agent should transiently INCREASE proposal-generation entropy UPSTREAM of action selection (wider hippocampal/world-model rollout candidate set + higher within-class sampling temperature) while preserving goal/harm/constraint scoring and DELAYING commitment until one candidate clears the E3 score-margin / commitment threshold; entropy then NARROWS once a workable candidate is found -> committed action -> entropy decay. Asserted distinction (preserve this): a hard problem must trigger WIDER INTERNAL PROPOSALS -> more candidate diversity -> longer arbitration -> selective committed action (controlled entropy), NOT 'hard problem -> random behaviour' (noise). WORKING HYPOTHESIS -- no experimental evidence yet; not an established mechanism.

REE's failure-mode taxonomy is indexed on TWO axes simultaneously: (1) named failure mode (the existing mechanistically-distinct entries -- psychosis/hypothesis-tag loss, confabulation, derealization, OCD, depressive attractor, catatonia subtypes, etc.) AND (2) a finite, named set of cross-cutting LATENT VULNERABILITY AXES that span the named entries (precision/confidence allocation; commitment-threshold/action-release authority; provenance/source tagging; agency attribution; residue/consequence persistence; goal/salience/incentive coupling; self-other coupling; offline integration/replay; social-contagion/cross-agent coupling; global instability). Named clinical syndromes are emergent clusters -- weighted combinations -- over these axes, not primitive natural kinds; comorbidity is overlapping axis activation and pleiotropy is one mechanism loading multiple axes. The axis layer is an INDEXING layer, never a merging layer: it does not collapse mechanistically-distinct failure modes into one another.

Derealization, delusion, PTSD flashbacks, anxiety, mania, impulsivity, and commitment paralysis share a common architectural substrate: undertrained real/synthetic frame distinction from insufficient pretend play.

created_claims.title: Should REE represent a clinical syndrome as a weighted VECTOR over the ARC-086 latent vulnerability axes (with comorbidity = axis-overlap and pleiotropy = one mechanism loading multiple axes), rather than as a diagnosis-specific locus mapping -- and if so, how is comorbidity represented without exploding the claim registry, and how is axis-predisposition (which axes are fragile) kept distinct from axis-expression (gated by REE's developmental / plasticity machinery)?

hub_targets.title: Modes are control-plane regimes applied to shared predictive machinery: the precision-to-commitment circuit.

Closure operator over committed rule_state: on satisfaction of a committed rule_state's completion condition, a 'done' token releases the bistable commitment latch (MECH-090), imposes a temporary No-Go bias (MECH-260) on the just-completed action-class / rule, and discharges the residue associated with that commitment within its domain. The closure token is what turns evaluation off; its absence leaves the governance loop stuck in evaluate-more even when the rule is satisfied. [UMBRELLA NARROWED 2026-06-19: the de-commit-authority sub-property (closure->latch coupling + de-commit magnitude) is decomposed into children MECH-445 (closure->beta coupling engagement) + MECH-446 (de-commit-authority magnitude); see those claims. SD-034 remains the umbrella design_decision -- closure-operator existence + five-part 'done' token firing + No-Go install are retained here and provisional; NOT demoted, NOT superseded.]

Slow substrate-state modulator with authority over compulsive-loop stickiness: a slowly-varying, broadly-projecting modulatory state can bias the decommit-friction / commitment-threshold / action-release landscape so that certain action loops become sticky, urgent, or hard to release INDEPENDENTLY of represented goal value or fast prediction-error -- i.e. a compulsive loop can arise from field-state bias rather than from an endorsed reward, valued goal, or false belief. The modulator changes the release/threshold landscape, not the value estimate.

Composed compulsion-risk readout: compulsive vulnerability is best modelled not as a single scalar (reward, habit strength, or belief) but as a composition compulsion_risk = f(loop_reinforcement, threat_salience, residue_persistence, decommit_friction, slow_modulatory_state) over quantities REE already represents separately -- a multi-layer state in which the substrate can make certain loops difficult to release even when any single term looks benign.

created_claims.title: How does REE distinguish a high-value, legitimately-repeated goal from a slow-modulator-trapped compulsive loop -- i.e. a loop that persists because the decommit-friction / threshold landscape is biased (MECH-369) rather than because the goal is valued? What diagnostic separates value-driven persistence from field-state-driven stickiness, and can offline integration reduce loop stickiness without erasing legitimate residue (INV-004/INV-006 firewall)?

hub_targets.title: Mode-conditioned write gating: the operating-mode variable from the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) determines which substrates can write to E3, episodic memory, policy updates, and autonomic coupling. Generalises MECH-094 hypothesis tag to a mode-conditioned family of write gates. Operating mode is implemented as a soft probability vector over {external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation}, not a one-hot categorical.

Sleep-consolidation priority from V_s residuals: during sleep-phase Bayesian aggregation (MECH-275) and sleep-dependent self-model aggregation (MECH-273), the order and weight of replay events is biased by the schema-staleness map produced by MECH-284. Replay is not uniform across schema and is not solely salience-driven (dopaminergic tagging); it is also prioritised by accumulated verisimilitude residuals. Schema regions with the most accumulated 'this is wrong' evidence get replayed first, more often, and with higher schema-update authority during sleep. PTSD-rumination has a clean architectural account here: MECH-285 priority loss co-occurring with MECH-094 hypothesis-tag dysfunction, locking the staleness tag from ever clearing.

Event-level write-authority gate: an explicit per-event transition from observed/represented to write-eligible over the DURABLE MODEL-UPDATE path (E1/E2 world-model and policy weights, not only episodic memory), conditioned on f(prediction_error, salience, pathway_state, residue_status, goal_relevance, plasticity_eligibility). The gate decides which individual events within an already-open write channel are licensed to durably deform the model; an event may be salient, real-provenance, and in a write-permitted mode yet still fail the gate. Without it, every prediction error in an open channel writes -- the undifferentiated-global-update / catastrophic-interference failure mode.

created_claims.title: Is an EXPLICIT event-level write-eligible state (MECH-368) actually needed, or is the existing combination -- MECH-261 mode-conditioned channel gating + MECH-094 provenance gating + MECH-285 consolidation-priority by V_s residual -- already sufficient to prevent undifferentiated global model updates? This is the falsifier for MECH-368: if a substrate that gates only the channel (mode) and prioritises only at consolidation still avoids catastrophic interference on the online world-model/policy path, MECH-368 earns no keep.

hub_targets.title: An agent that only avoids harm but cannot sustain prospective goal-directed motivation cannot exercise genuine agency; goal maintenance is a necessary co-condition for ethical agency alongside harm-avoidance.

When harm-trace salience dominates offline replay content, consolidation selectively amplifies harm predictions, progressively contracting option space -- a distinct failure mode from Q-021 behavioral flatness.

Long-term clinical depression involves a chronicity-dependent reversal of large-scale network coupling: past a ~24-month chronicity threshold, the relationship between symptom severity and Central-Executive-Network (CEN) <-> Default-Mode-Network (DMN, precuneus) functional connectivity reverses sign (non-chronic: stronger CEN-DMN coupling at low severity, weaker at high; chronic: connectivity strengthens as symptoms worsen, co-occurring with entrenched rumination). The depressive brain-state is duration-indexed, not a single static regime.

The depressive failure mode is carried by a multi-axis network-regime VECTOR, not a scalar low-mood/low-reward value: depressive_regime_risk = f(future_trajectory_access, goal_stream_coupling, residue_load/self_weighting, rumination_loop_gain, action_threshold/energy_budget, social_affordance_access, offline_repair_quality). The depressive state is defined by the JOINT configuration of these coupling/access axes and is self-maintaining; scalar mood/reward is an insufficient representation.

created_claims.title: Is a maladaptive depressive network-regime (MECH-367) REVERSIBLE -- reconfigurable by REE's existing repair machinery (offline integration / MECH-124 replay rebalancing, decommitment from ruminative loops, re-access to social affordances, goal-stream re-coupling) -- or does chronicity lock the regime past a threshold (RA-001) such that the repair routes that work early fail or reverse-sign late?

hub_targets.title: The NREM sub-phase of offline mode replays recent episodic content via SWR-equivalent sequences, transferring episodic traces from E3/hippocampal buffer to E1/neocortical schematic representation.

Unified autobiographical temporal event substrate: retrospective replay (ARC-007) and prospective simulation (ARC-018) draw on ONE self-tagged event-token store rather than two parallel memory machineries. Autobiographical memory is an identity-indexed event field -- personal events bound to perspective, emotion, residue, and self-state -- not neutral storage; future trajectory generation is forward re-composition of the same event tokens, while replay is their backward reinstatement.

created_claims.title: Should REE represent autobiographical event memory as a DISTINCT first-class type, separate from semantic (abstract facts/relations) and task/procedural (policies/action schemas) memory -- or is the existing episodic->semantic consolidation pathway (MECH-121) sufficient? The case material motivates the distinction (TL separates emotion-tagged 'life memory' from neutral encyclopedic 'black memory'), but REE has no memory-type taxonomy claim.

hub_targets.title: Laughter is rapid repeated hypothesis-tag cycling — threat activation followed immediately by safe-resolution — predicting incongruity+resolution as the necessary structure of humour.

Laughter discharges accumulated E3 conflict/constraint load and thereby marks a safe inter-regime control-plane transition: beyond the per-cycle hypothesis-tag clear (MECH-110), iterated safe-confirmation produces a regime-level drop in active constraint pressure that releases the system from a threat-vigilant/high-commitment regime into an exploratory/play regime -- making laughter a boundary signal between control-plane regimes (ARC-016), not merely reward expression.

created_claims.title: Does REE need a crying / distress-vocalisation social-guardrail analogue to laughter (MECH-110 / MECH-364), and how is social laughter adjudicated as social-field repair vs damage/exclusion -- given that laughter is not monotone-affiliative (it can exclude, dominate, mask distress, or signal threat)?

hub_targets.title: Typed signed cognifold coupling: the cognifold represents inter-field coupling as a typed, signed edge -- cognifold_edge = {source, target, sign, gain, precision, gate, timescale, write_authority} -- with competition (sign < 0) as a FIRST-CLASS GENERATIVE coupling mode alongside cooperation (sign > 0) and gated-decoupling, not an emergent by-product of selection softmaxes. Three coupling modes: cooperative (binding, coherent trajectory, shared context), competitive (suppress incompatible trajectories, preserve boundaries, prevent runaway resonance, stop one field absorbing all others), gated-decoupling (isolate simulation / offline integration / unsafe candidates from release authority).

Diffuse long-range competitive coupling is a generative stability requirement: stable, synergistic, hierarchical cognifold dynamics require signed competitive coupling -- specifically diffuse, long-range competition between distant fields with opposite profiles -- not merely local damping. An all-cooperative (all-positive) routed-field cognifold is unstable: every salient stream reinforces every other, producing runaway resonance / over-synchronisation / loss of modular segregation. Competition is the constructive ingredient that buys stabilisation, segregation, hierarchy, synergy, and subject-specificity.

created_claims.title: Which REE subsystems require an EXPLICIT signed competitive edge (ARC-084) rather than emergent softmax / winner-take-all / scalar-gating competition alone -- and what are the safety differences between inhibition, competition, decommitment, and residue-based veto across waking action, simulation, and offline integration?

hub_targets.title: REE requires staged developmental training with explicit curriculum gates.

Subtractive developmental sparsification: mature sparse/structured memory connectivity emerges by pruning / down-weighting an initially over-connected, dense, near-random ('tabula plena') substrate, not by additively growing connections onto a sparse skeleton; correspondingly, mature recall requires convergent summation of several weak inputs rather than a single strong cue.

created_claims.title: Should REE distinguish an early over-connected exploratory developmental substrate from a mature sparse/structured substrate -- and is developmental sparsification best modelled as deletion, down-weighting, gating, or residue-tagged de-authorization?

hub_targets.title: Goal-directed behavior requires homeostatic drive modulation: z_goal seeding demands drive-scaled benefit signals.

The drive -> liking-stream -> approach-cue gain pathway is one of several drive->approach pathways in the REE substrate. It biases approach action scoring via a liking-specific per-candidate score_bias contribution, but is NOT the sole or necessary pathway by which drive amplification reaches approach action selection (narrowed 2026-05-31 from necessity to modulation per V3-EXQ-490j autopsy; original necessity title preserved in functional_restatement history). Parallel architecturally first-class drive->approach pathways operate in the same substrate: MECH-216 schema-readout wanting, MECH-290 backward credit sweep, MECH-307 anticipatory liking, and serotonin tonic_5ht benefit_salience.

Non-terminal drive register: needs beyond hunger/thirst (exploration, play, social, learning, grooming, rest) are first-class drive axes, each carried as its own homeostatic-style integrator rather than collapsed into the single SD-012 energy scalar.

created_claims.title: Multidrive arbitration is priced in a common opportunity-cost-of-time currency: a global, slowly-varying tonic vigour signal (the long-run average reward rate / opportunity cost of dwelling on the currently-arbitrated drive) supplies the commensurable scale over which otherwise-incommensurable drive axes compete, sitting ABOVE the per-candidate liking-stream score_bias (MECH-295). The currency sets HOW VIGOROUSLY the arbitrated drive is pursued; it does NOT by itself determine WHICH drive wins -- selection additionally requires a per-axis-differentiated benefit gradient, so the global scalar is necessary-but-insufficient for arbitration.

hub_targets.title: BG-level beta oscillations gate E3-to-action-selection propagation, not E3 internal updating.

Belief-state hypothesis set: when observations are ambiguous or incomplete, REE maintains a bounded set of competing latent-state hypotheses, each carrying confidence/precision, predicted transitions, goal/antigoal relations, and uncertainty; E3 evaluates candidate trajectories over the hypothesis set rather than over a single collapsed state.

Inference / belief-state affordance layer: a named integrative function that constructs latent state hypotheses and inferred affordance fields from partial observation, memory, cue traces, candidate rules, affective gradients, uncertainty, and E2 action-consequence rollouts, so E3 selects trajectories under partial observability without requiring direct perception or oracle-like prior knowledge.
Commit-boundary token reclassifies pre-commit vs post-commit error routing.

Are MECH-314a (striatal novelty), MECH-314b (frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity), and MECH-314c (learning-progress curiosity) three distinct substrates with independent contributions, or three different readings of one mechanism with different upstream inputs (e.g., novelty as a special case of uncertainty as a special case of learning progress)?

Epistemic action pressure: when goal success or harm avoidance depends on hidden state, REE can assign action pressure to information-gathering transitions that reduce uncertainty, even when those actions are not immediately reward-maximising or harm-minimising; generalises Q-044 curiosity into a survival-relevant viability function under partial observability.

created_claims.title: Epistemic commitment timing: the inference layer's decision of WHEN to stop gathering evidence and commit a trajectory is a governed control parameter (an urgency/threshold over the belief-state set), balancing pragmatic value (act now) against epistemic value (sample more). Its two failure poles are epistemic-freezing (epistemic value over-weighted / threshold too high -> the agent keeps sampling and never commits) and anti-epistemic-panic (under threat, the epistemic term collapses / urgency forced high -> the agent commits on too little evidence). This axis is NOT reducible to the MECH-126 state-abstraction failure taxonomy; it lives at the seam between the belief-state hypothesis set (MECH-385) / epistemic action pressure (MECH-388) and the commitment gate (MECH-061 / MECH-090), and has an inverted-U optimum rather than a monotone.

hub_targets.title: dACC/aMCC-analog (adaptive control): module that reads z_harm_a precision-weighted prediction error, z_conflict, and control-demand signals; outputs behavioural-adjustment magnitude; writes to a learnable striatal-analog action-value target.

Frontopolar-analog (parallel-goal deliberation substrate): V4-scope module maintaining counterfactual-value estimates for alternatives to the current course of action, mediating transitions between external engagement and internally-generated deliberation, enabling disengagement from the current task to explore novel alternatives, and monitoring relative importance across multiple active goals. Hooks reserved in V3 via the operating_mode vocabulary; substrate deferred to V4.

Frontopolar counterfactual-value tracking: SD-033e maintains, in parallel with SD-033c's chosen-option value signal, a running estimate of the value of unchosen alternatives. A switch-to-alternative decision is signalled when the counterfactual estimate exceeds the chosen estimate by a threshold-sensitive margin.

created_claims.title: LC-NE-analog explore/exploit gain control: a value-INDEPENDENT, broadly-projecting tonic/phasic gain signal gates DISENGAGEMENT from the committed course. Phasic gain stabilises current-task exploitation; a tonic-mode shift -- driven by waning task utility monitored in the dACC/value system -- licenses disengagement to explore alternatives, supplying the trigger that MECH-264's value-margin switch alone does not. REE has no NE-analog substrate today; this names the missing modulator.

hub_targets.title: dACC/aMCC-analog (adaptive control): module that reads z_harm_a precision-weighted prediction error, z_conflict, and control-demand signals; outputs behavioural-adjustment magnitude; writes to a learnable striatal-analog action-value target.

Multi-slot GoalState holds N>=2 simultaneously-active goal slots with per-slot z_goal, drive coupling, age, and persistence parameters. Each slot generates its own ghost-goal-bank rank, ghost-probe budget, and proposer trajectories; a dACC-style arbitrator selects which slot's best trajectory commits this tick.

Frontopolar-analog (parallel-goal deliberation substrate): V4-scope module maintaining counterfactual-value estimates for alternatives to the current course of action, mediating transitions between external engagement and internally-generated deliberation, enabling disengagement from the current task to explore novel alternatives, and monitoring relative importance across multiple active goals. Hooks reserved in V3 via the operating_mode vocabulary; substrate deferred to V4.

Frontopolar relative-importance monitoring across competing goals: SD-033e maintains a representation of relative importance across a set of active goals (parallel, not pairwise), enabling parallel-goal monitoring and flexible switching. Lesion analogue should reproduce the Mansouri 2015 over-focus + novel-rule-impairment phenotype.

Frontopolar counterfactual-value tracking: SD-033e maintains, in parallel with SD-033c's chosen-option value signal, a running estimate of the value of unchosen alternatives. A switch-to-alternative decision is signalled when the counterfactual estimate exceeds the chosen estimate by a threshold-sensitive margin.

created_claims.title: dACC<->FPC reciprocal arbitration loop: the switch-to-alternative decision is not computed in one module but emerges from a comparison ACROSS two substrates -- the FPC-analog (SD-033e/MECH-264) carries the counterfactual value of the specific unchosen option, the dACC-analog (SD-032b) carries the environment search-value and expected-value-of-control, and slot-switching (SD-046) is gated by their relative comparison. Neither signal alone drives the switch; the loop does.

hub_targets.title: Mode-conditioned write gating: the operating-mode variable from the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) determines which substrates can write to E3, episodic memory, policy updates, and autonomic coupling. Generalises MECH-094 hypothesis tag to a mode-conditioned family of write gates. Operating mode is implemented as a soft probability vector over {external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation}, not a one-hot categorical.

Sleep-consolidation priority from V_s residuals: during sleep-phase Bayesian aggregation (MECH-275) and sleep-dependent self-model aggregation (MECH-273), the order and weight of replay events is biased by the schema-staleness map produced by MECH-284. Replay is not uniform across schema and is not solely salience-driven (dopaminergic tagging); it is also prioritised by accumulated verisimilitude residuals. Schema regions with the most accumulated 'this is wrong' evidence get replayed first, more often, and with higher schema-update authority during sleep. PTSD-rumination has a clean architectural account here: MECH-285 priority loss co-occurring with MECH-094 hypothesis-tag dysfunction, locking the staleness tag from ever clearing.

Event-level write-authority gate: an explicit per-event transition from observed/represented to write-eligible over the DURABLE MODEL-UPDATE path (E1/E2 world-model and policy weights, not only episodic memory), conditioned on f(prediction_error, salience, pathway_state, residue_status, goal_relevance, plasticity_eligibility). The gate decides which individual events within an already-open write channel are licensed to durably deform the model; an event may be salient, real-provenance, and in a write-permitted mode yet still fail the gate. Without it, every prediction error in an open channel writes -- the undifferentiated-global-update / catastrophic-interference failure mode.

created_claims.title: Two-factor (tag-and-capture) write-eligibility: MECH-368's plasticity_eligibility is not a single instantaneous test but a TWO-STAGE process -- a local event sets a transient, input-specific eligibility TAG, and a durable model/policy write is consummated only if that tag CAPTURES a separately-gated plasticity/consolidation-resource signal within a time window. A tagged-eligible event can still fail to write if no capture signal arrives, and an arriving capture signal can rescue a recently-tagged weak event.

hub_targets.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).
Papez-like loop provides provenance gating and reality filtering.

Provenance-bearing event token: every autobiographical event token carries an explicit provenance/commitment-status structure -- event_token = {time, place, self_state, other_agents, perspective, affect, residue, source_status, committed_vs_imagined} -- and a ONE-WAY gate ensures imagined / simulated future tokens can be used for planning without ever acquiring committed-history status. The scarce resource in mental time travel is not capacity but provenance: any path that lets a simulated event accrue committed weight is a confabulation bug.

created_claims.title: Multi-dimensional provenance source vector: an event token's provenance is a SOURCE VECTOR over several partly-independent dimensions (perceived-vs-imagined, self-generated-vs-other-generated, source identity, temporal source, modality), not a single committed_vs_imagined bit. Provenance failures dissociate per-dimension -- the system can correctly attribute real-vs-imagined while mis-attributing who-generated-it or when -- so each dimension carries its own confidence, and the one-way committed gate applies per safety-relevant dimension rather than to a single global bit.

hub_targets.title: Mode-conditioned write gating: the operating-mode variable from the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) determines which substrates can write to E3, episodic memory, policy updates, and autonomic coupling. Generalises MECH-094 hypothesis tag to a mode-conditioned family of write gates. Operating mode is implemented as a soft probability vector over {external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation}, not a one-hot categorical.

Sleep-consolidation priority from V_s residuals: during sleep-phase Bayesian aggregation (MECH-275) and sleep-dependent self-model aggregation (MECH-273), the order and weight of replay events is biased by the schema-staleness map produced by MECH-284. Replay is not uniform across schema and is not solely salience-driven (dopaminergic tagging); it is also prioritised by accumulated verisimilitude residuals. Schema regions with the most accumulated 'this is wrong' evidence get replayed first, more often, and with higher schema-update authority during sleep. PTSD-rumination has a clean architectural account here: MECH-285 priority loss co-occurring with MECH-094 hypothesis-tag dysfunction, locking the staleness tag from ever clearing.
The NREM sub-phase of offline mode replays recent episodic content via SWR-equivalent sequences, transferring episodic traces from E3/hippocampal buffer to E1/neocortical schematic representation.

Candidate-gradient hippocampal episode schema: enrich the event trace from state -> action -> outcome to state -> candidates-considered -> affective gradients over candidates -> selected action -> outcome -> residue (relief / harm / blocked-agency / safety update), and use the affective gradient as a memory WRITE-WEIGHT and RETRIEVAL-QUERY variable -- high-gradient episodes are preferentially written, and later similar-gradient states retrieve prior action-affect-outcome arcs rather than undifferentiated state-action-outcome tuples.

created_claims.title: Schema-congruence as a consolidation write-weight and routing variable: the degree of fit between an event and the agent's existing schemas modulates how that event is consolidated -- schema-congruent content is consolidated preferentially and routed more directly into the durable/semantic store (a fast vmPFC-gated systems-consolidation route), while schema-incongruent content requires prolonged hippocampal-dependent consolidation or is gated out. Schema-fit is a WRITE-WEIGHT input to consolidation alongside affect (MECH-361), not only a retrieval-time prior.

Cue-triggered wanting / cue-recall (L6): a PERCEIVED cue/object type (with no benefit pulse) retrieves its SD-057 incentive token and nudges z_goal toward that object's stored identity embedding BEFORE consumption -- identity-matched (pulls toward the perceived cue's object) and drive-specific (amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive)). Distinct from the benefit-driven seed: no benefit pulse, no token revaluation, weaker (cue_recall_gain) pull.

MECH-094's hypothesis tag is realized as differential downstream routing of hippocampal replay, not as a source-side boolean. Anchored replay (trusted starting state, MECH-269) preferentially reaches subiculum -> entorhinal deep layers -> neocortex (E1 consolidation) and lateral PFC (SD-033a viability map); probe replay (low-verisimilitude seed, strengthened tag) preferentially reaches BLA (affective tagging without consolidation) and NAc (curiosity / novelty scaffolding). Tag loss presents as probe content reaching consolidation destinations it should not reach -- an auditable confabulatory-planning signature distinct from psychosis or hallucination.

created_claims.title: Retrieval-time accessibility gating: which stored traces become reinstatable at a given moment is set by two composable READ-side policy layers, not by storage alone. Line A -- a global, slowly-fluctuating, arousal-coupled reinstatement GAIN (content-blind; sets the threshold on whether ANY stored trace crosses into accessibility; stochastic-resonance flavour). Line B -- a content-selective competitive SUPPRESSION that, given what the global gate admits, inhibits specific competitors to keep retrieval clean. The READ-side sibling of MECH-261's mode-conditioned WRITE-gate family: REE owns the gates but not this retrieval-time gating POLICY.

REE developmental training proceeds in three ordered stages: (1) self-as-object — action-space discovery via motor experimentation, producing the substrate SD-003 requires; (2) objects-as-patterns — object-schema formation via experimental action on the world; (3) others-as-special-objects — modelling other agents as objects with their own policies. Caregiver-scaffolded rule-population mechanism (the 'in' face of the ARC-063 CandidateRule field). A caregiver / teacher agent structures the agent's exposure (Vygotsky ZPD; Wood/Bruner/Ross scaffolding) and marks regularities ostensively (Csibra & Gergely natural pedagogy); the marked regularity is written into the ARC-063 CandidateRule field as a candidate the agent could not have invented alone, tagged with the scaffolding context. Population is context-bound by construction -- this is the concrete mechanism behind 'context-bound rule population'. Child of ARC-077. Structural slot only; hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull and a caregiver-agent substrate that does not exist in V3.

Socially-scaffolded rule-population pathway: the third rule-source, peer to ARC-062 (top-down gated-policy apprehension) and ARC-064 (bottom-up behavioural-pattern extraction), and upstream-fed by ARC-065 (behavioural diversity generation). Architectural commitment: in biology the candidate-rule hypothesis space is not invented by the agent alone -- caregivers populate it from outside via scaffolded exposure (Vygotsky ZPD; Wood/Bruner/Ross scaffolding; Csibra & Gergely ostensive cueing / natural pedagogy; Tomasello shared intentionality; joint attention / social referencing). This is the most direct architectural answer to MECH-309: a non-Bayesian rule-creator that does not invent its own hypotheses receives candidate regularities, context-bound to the scaffolding episode, from a caregiver. The pathway fills the ARC-063 CandidateRule field (the 'in' face); MECH-337 is the population mechanism; MECH-338 is the cue-driven context-bound retrieval mechanism (the 'select' face). Registered 2026-05-18 as a structural slot only -- hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull and on a caregiver/teacher-agent substrate that does not yet exist in V3.

hub_targets.title: Harm stream separates into sensory-discriminative (z_harm_s: proximity/intensity, Adelta-pathway analog, forward-predictable) and affective-motivational (z_harm_a: accumulated homeostatic deviation, C-fiber/paleospinothalamic analog).

The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).

Relief-completion event reuses goal-achievement / reward-circuit completion machinery. When a comparator on a suffering-stream derivative crosses a downward threshold (sustained suffering-reduction below baseline), the resulting event fires the same downstream tag-and-release pipeline as goal-achievement: MECH-057a (commitment-release / beta-gate-drop), MECH-091 (salient-event phase-reset), and MECH-094 (categorical hypothesis-tag write gate). The polarity of the reinforcement is set at the input -- what counts as the completion is the suffering-derivative crossing, not a reward-onset event -- but the consolidation pipeline is shared. 'Things that just reduced suffering' are tagged in the same approach-attractor structure as 'things liked'.

Context-bound passive safety representation: the agent encodes 'this environment predicts absence of suffering' through sustained non-occurrence of harm, without requiring a discrete teaching event. Substrate is prefrontal-hippocampal (IL for expression gating; vHipp-to-PL-equivalent for contextual store). Update rule is diffuse and slow -- accumulated context exposure without harm drives the store. Output lowers background vigilance threshold: reduces the general avoidance commitment level when the agent is in an environment the store predicts as safe. Parallel to the 'things liked' goal-cue store but tracking suffering-absence rather than reward-presence. Sister claim to MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition pathway).

Instrumental-avoidance acquisition: REE's defensive system needs an instrumental-ACQUISITION side, not only the defensive-REACTION side. SD-035 (amygdala BLA/CeA salience) + MECH-279 (PAG freeze gate) give REE the Pavlovian reaction (Tovote 2016: response EXECUTION, not learning); what is missing is the step from reaction to learned avoidance. Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance learning is the RESOLUTION of a Pavlovian-instrumental conflict -- the freezing reaction and the instrumental avoidance action are mutually exclusive, and learning to avoid REQUIRES the infralimbic PFC to SUPPRESS central-amygdala-driven freezing (ilPFC lesion -> more freezing, less avoidance; CeA lesion -> opposite). A freeze-and-salience substrate with no reaction-suppression / instrumental-acquisition layer is the ilPFC-lesion animal: it freezes instead of learning to avoid -- the V3-EXQ-603g G_H 0/3 signature. SD-058 adds the architecture (an instrumental-avoidance action pathway + an ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression gate gated by learned avoidance-efficacy, staged under a protective scaffold); MECH-357 is the gate mechanism.

Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge: SD-058/MECH-357 supply an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate but its avoidance_efficacy is a GLOBAL SCALAR that only penalises the no-op/freeze class -- compute_action_bias by design 'does NOT compute the escape direction'. V3-EXQ-603h (engaged-but-insufficient, readiness met) showed the consequence: the agent un-freezes but acquires no directed escape (seed-43 scalar efficacy 0.633 -> WORST survival 11.0). Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance needs the LA/BA->NAcc relief/safety action-credit half that positively reinforces a SPECIFIC avoidance response, not only the suppression half. REE owns relief (MECH-302/SD-050) + safety (MECH-303/304/SD-052/SD-051) but they are UNWIRED to avoidance. SD-059 adds the architecture: an affordance-indexed (per-first-action-class) credit table that, when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (relief) or terminates the threat (safety), tags that action as an escape affordance approachable under future threat; MECH-358 is the bridge mechanism.

Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge mechanism (instantiates SD-059): a pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/escape_affordance_bridge.py, sibling to the SD-058/MECH-357 gate) extending the MECH-357 scalar avoidance_efficacy into a per-first-action-class credit table. RELIEF half: a directed action under threat that drops z_harm_a (delta = prev - now > floor) credits relief_affordance[class] (EMA toward 1; MECH-302-consistent). SAFETY half: a directed action after which threat is absent (threat_scale <= 0) credits safety_affordance[class] (MECH-303/304-consistent response-produced safety). Approach bonus: under future threat, a per-candidate NEGATIVE (favoured) E3 score-bias toward credited classes = -clamp(approach_gain * threat_scale * combined_affordance[class], 0, bias_scale); the no-op/freeze class never gets a bonus. Three guards: bias_scale clamp, threat-context gate (zero when safe), per-tick leak.

Infralimbic-PFC-analog freeze-suppression + instrumental-avoidance gate: the mechanism instantiating SD-058. A pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/infralimbic_avoidance_gate.py, sibling to SD-035 CeA/BLA, MECH-279 PAG, MECH-313/MECH-320 policy regulators) with three coordinated pieces, all behind use_instrumental_avoidance (no-op default): (a) an instrumental-avoidance ACTION pathway -- a per-candidate E3 score-bias that under threat penalises the no-op/freeze class proportional to effective avoidance-efficacy, RELEASING the instrumental action (it does not pick the escape direction; E3's harm gradient does -- ARC-007-strict-compatible); (b) an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate that, when effective_efficacy*threat_scale >= threshold, overrides the MECH-279 freeze no-op so the agent acts instead of freezing; (c) an eligibility-trace avoidance-efficacy learner credited when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (Debiec & Sullivan 2017 gradual acquisition), bootstrapped by a protective-scaffold floor that anneals across Stage-H (Turchetta 2020).

Cue-specific conditioned safety prediction: a discrete predictive structure encodes 'this stimulus actively predicts that suffering will be omitted', updated by explicit MECH-302 relief-completion events as its teaching signal. Encoding substrate is cortico-striatal (dorsal striatum + dlPFC). Expression/output pathway is IL-to-CeA. This is the conditioned-inhibition mechanism: when a specific cue co-occurs with relief, a separate learned prediction forms that can gate avoidance commitment release when the cue is later present. Sister claim to MECH-303 (contextual passive safety representation).

Trainable relief critic Q_relief(state, action, threat_context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head that predicts expected harm/suffering reduction following an action under threat -- negative-reinforcement credit assignment, distinct from generic reward / wanting. It is the trainable successor to the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA credit table of the MECH-358 relief half, and is downstream of (NOT a duplicate of) the non-trainable MECH-302 / SD-050 relief-completion comparator that merely DETECTS relief on the current state. Q_relief is a function approximator generalising relief-credit across continuous state x action x threat-context, trained on action-contingent drops in z_harm_a: positive target when a directed action under threat is followed by a temporally-close, action-contingent z_harm_a drop not explained by passive environmental drift; negative / extinction target when the expected relief action fails to reduce harm. Feeds E3 as a bounded, threat-gated, extinguishable score-bias toward actions predicted to reduce harm -- never global reward, never fires when safe, never credits no-op / freeze unless explicitly modelling passive safety. MECH-094-safe: simulated relief in hypothesis mode must not train the waking critic unless authorised as play / training.

created_claims.title: Trainable prospective safety predictor P_safety(state, cue, action, context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head predicting threat-ABSENCE / response-produced safety / conditioned inhibition, licensing commitment-release, approach to safety affordances, and recovery after threat. Distinct from z_goal (it predicts the ABSENCE of threat, not the PRESENCE of a goal) and from relief (it is a PROSPECTIVE threat-absence prediction, not an aversive-offset event). It is the trainable + contrastive successor that makes the MECH-303 (contextual passive safety) + MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition) substrate learnable, replacing the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA safety table of the MECH-358 safety half: positive target when a cue / context / action predicts threat absence or response-produced safety; negative target when 'safe' cues are followed by threat recurrence; CONTRASTIVE target to stop safety overgeneralising to stable background features that merely co-occurred with relief. Output supports commitment release, permits approach to safety affordances, stabilises recovery, and prevents persistent defensive mode when threat is genuinely absent.

Provides the substrate for MECH-302 by detecting when a period of suffering has cleanly ended, reusing the same downstream tag-and-release pipeline as goal-achievement (MECH-057a beta-gate release, MECH-094 VALENCE_LIKING write). Architecturally adjacent to MECH-091 (urgency interrupt) but opposite polarity: MECH-091 fires on upward z_harm_a spike; SD-050 fires on downward sustained drop.
