hub_targets.title: Residue is persistent latent-space curvature; hippocampal paths form a cognitive map.

Subtractive developmental sparsification: mature sparse/structured memory connectivity emerges by pruning / down-weighting an initially over-connected, dense, near-random ('tabula plena') substrate, not by additively growing connections onto a sparse skeleton; correspondingly, mature recall requires convergent summation of several weak inputs rather than a single strong cue.

Diffuse long-range competitive coupling is a generative stability requirement: stable, synergistic, hierarchical cognifold dynamics require signed competitive coupling -- specifically diffuse, long-range competition between distant fields with opposite profiles -- not merely local damping. An all-cooperative (all-positive) routed-field cognifold is unstable: every salient stream reinforces every other, producing runaway resonance / over-synchronisation / loss of modular segregation. Competition is the constructive ingredient that buys stabilisation, segregation, hierarchy, synergy, and subject-specificity.

Substrate-independent cognifold primitives: REE specifies its single cognifold (one interacting state-space, not a modular stack) in a hardware-neutral primitive vocabulary -- persistent state, history-dependent deformation, multi-timescale field dynamics, oscillatory propagation, stochastic transition, attractor transitions, residue-as-deformation-of-the-future-action-landscape, commitment as a real boundary between simulated and released action, and offline reintegration -- so that any FUTURE physical substrate is evaluated by whether it can INSTANTIATE these dynamics, not merely execute modular software. The primitives remain software-expressible now while also being legible as future physical-substrate affordances.

created_claims.title: Memristive deformation as the physical analogue of residue/cognifold curvature: spintronic-memristive media (magnetic tunnel junctions, nanomagnet ensembles, domain walls, topological spin textures, spin waves / spin-Hall nano-oscillators) are physical substrates in which past activity alters future state-transition behaviour -- making 'residue is not merely stored memory but deformation of the future action landscape' physically literal in a way von Neumann computation does not. They are a candidate post-V5 physical cognifold substrate because they combine persistent state, history-dependent deformation, oscillatory dynamics, stochastic switching, attractor-like state-space trajectories, and possible low-power embodied operation in one medium.

hub_targets.title: Social cognition uses mirror modelling and coupling.
Language is a symbolic mediation and coordination layer.
Derived social tags and empathy coupling via control-plane knobs.
Do affect dimensions (not necessarily universal expressions) map to stable control-channel regimes in z_beta?

created_claims.title: A lightweight LanguageAffectAdaptor parses affect/emotion from user or agent LANGUAGE into the shared world model: a language-interface component that, when literal semantic content is insufficient to recover affect, converts text into PROBABILISTIC affect/emotion hypotheses (treated as uncertain latent-state estimates, NOT categorical emotion truths) and feeds those estimates into REE's wider agent-state and context modelling. It is an input/perception adaptor on the language channel -- distinct from REE's INTERNAL affective representation (Q-007 z_beta dimensions) -- supplying other-agent affect priors to the social/empathy modelling layer.

hub_targets.title: REE requires staged developmental training with explicit curriculum gates.

Sense-specific perceptual-manifold adaptor: each sensory modality requires its own adaptor transforming raw stimulus space into a perceptual-manifold (metric) space before shared-world-model entry; senses are not interchangeable raw streams.
E1 performs multimodal exteroceptive fusion across sensory modalities before feeding E2.
Minimal stream tags with typed exteroception and explicit reality-coherence lane.

created_claims.title: Modality-heterogeneity / adaptor-depth gradient: senses differ in how much transformation they need before world-model entry -- smell is a near-raw gradient primitive, sight needs a deep perceptual-manifold adaptor; gradient-like (low-adaptor-depth) senses enter earliest developmentally.

hub_targets.title: Control plane routes precision and modes.

REE's failure-mode taxonomy is indexed on TWO axes simultaneously: (1) named failure mode (the existing mechanistically-distinct entries -- psychosis/hypothesis-tag loss, confabulation, derealization, OCD, depressive attractor, catatonia subtypes, etc.) AND (2) a finite, named set of cross-cutting LATENT VULNERABILITY AXES that span the named entries (precision/confidence allocation; commitment-threshold/action-release authority; provenance/source tagging; agency attribution; residue/consequence persistence; goal/salience/incentive coupling; self-other coupling; offline integration/replay; social-contagion/cross-agent coupling; global instability). Named clinical syndromes are emergent clusters -- weighted combinations -- over these axes, not primitive natural kinds; comorbidity is overlapping axis activation and pleiotropy is one mechanism loading multiple axes. The axis layer is an INDEXING layer, never a merging layer: it does not collapse mechanistically-distinct failure modes into one another.

Clinically distinct psychiatric diagnoses share a small set of latent genomic factors that cut across diagnostic boundaries: large-scale genomic structural-equation modelling across 14 childhood- and adult-onset psychiatric disorders (>1 million individuals) finds that the majority of case-vs-control genetic variance is captured by FIVE shared genomic factors (Compulsive; Schizophrenia-bipolar / psychotic-mood; Neurodevelopmental; Internalizing; Substance-use) spanning 238 variants, with factor-specific biology (e.g. oligodendrocyte genes enriched in the Internalizing factor) acting early in brain development. Psychiatric categories are surface expressions over overlapping latent dimensions, not genetically discrete kinds.

created_claims.title: A global-instability / broad control-plane vulnerability axis (a p-factor / general-psychopathology-factor analogue) loads across ALL failure modes: a single broad dimension of control-plane regulatory fragility -- instability in precision/gain/threshold setpoint regulation (ARC-005) rather than any one specific comparator or stream -- raises joint susceptibility to multiple failure modes at once, distinct from and orthogonal to any single-axis failure. This is the axis with no existing REE home; it predicts that a subset of agents/patients carry elevated risk across the whole failure-mode space rather than along one axis.

hub_targets.title: control_plane.commit_maintenance_release. The R-c readiness signals that gate commitment ENTRY (MECH-090: score_margin decisiveness + nav_competence) must ALSO be able to RELEASE an already-elevated beta latch when execution readiness degrades mid-commitment. The release is a graded, bounded-accumulation drift-to-a-release-bound (conflict-scaled by the deficit magnitude), NOT a one-shot threshold flag; targeted to the active committed motor program (not a global brake); and hysteretic with a reengagement path that guards the premature-abort pole. This closes the V3-EXQ-592f reach gap (the MECH-090 R-c conjunction is admission-only by design; no existing release pathway covers degraded-readiness-mid- commitment).
Modes are control-plane regimes applied to shared predictive machinery: the precision-to-commitment circuit.

Slow substrate-state modulator with authority over compulsive-loop stickiness: a slowly-varying, broadly-projecting modulatory state can bias the decommit-friction / commitment-threshold / action-release landscape so that certain action loops become sticky, urgent, or hard to release INDEPENDENTLY of represented goal value or fast prediction-error -- i.e. a compulsive loop can arise from field-state bias rather than from an endorsed reward, valued goal, or false belief. The modulator changes the release/threshold landscape, not the value estimate.

dACC conflict saturation: the dACC-analog (SD-032b) prediction-error / conflict signal caps and habituates under repeated identical outcomes; it does not grow unboundedly as conflict persists. Without saturation, a stuck governance loop can generate unbounded pe signal that never triggers a mode change, which is the control-theory signature of persistent rumination.
Failure mode taxonomy.

Action-chunk cache stores frequently-traversed action sequences as cached lookups, indexed by (state-signature, expected-outcome-signature). Sits in the dorsolateral-loop slot of ARC-021. Provides the model-free habit pathway missing from V3 and the runaway-chunking failure mode underlying OCD compulsions and rituals (Graybiel 2008).

policy_composition_via_repeated_grounding (zoom-out / chunk a sequence of primitives into a single atomic primitive after repeated successful execution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. Architectural commitment: sequences of policy primitives that have been repeatedly executed together with consistent outcomes are accumulated into a single primitive that the rule-apprehension and diversity-generation layers can treat atomically. Trigger: repetition count + outcome consistency (slow accumulator). Direction: zoom out. Phenomenology anchor: 'making coffee was once seventeen motor acts; after a thousand repetitions it is one unit.' Names the TRANSITION mechanism (planned -> habitual chunk) that MECH-163 dual systems presupposes but does not specify.

When a comparator on a suffering-stream derivative crosses a downward threshold (sustained suffering-reduction below baseline), the resulting event fires the same downstream tag-and-release pipeline as goal-achievement: MECH-057a (commitment-release / beta-gate-drop), MECH-091 (salient-event phase-reset), and MECH-094 (categorical hypothesis-tag write gate). Context-bound passive safety representation: the agent encodes 'this environment predicts absence of suffering' through sustained non-occurrence of harm, without requiring a discrete teaching event. Substrate is prefrontal-hippocampal (IL for expression gating; vHipp-to-PL-equivalent for contextual store). Update rule is diffuse and slow -- accumulated context exposure without harm drives the store. Output lowers background vigilance threshold: reduces the general avoidance commitment level when the agent is in an environment the store predicts as safe. Parallel to the 'things liked' goal-cue store but tracking suffering-absence rather than reward-presence. Sister claim to MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition pathway).

Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge: SD-058/MECH-357 supply an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate but its avoidance_efficacy is a GLOBAL SCALAR that only penalises the no-op/freeze class -- compute_action_bias by design 'does NOT compute the escape direction'. V3-EXQ-603h (engaged-but-insufficient, readiness met) showed the consequence: the agent un-freezes but acquires no directed escape (seed-43 scalar efficacy 0.633 -> WORST survival 11.0). Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance needs the LA/BA->NAcc relief/safety action-credit half that positively reinforces a SPECIFIC avoidance response, not only the suppression half. REE owns relief (MECH-302/SD-050) + safety (MECH-303/304/SD-052/SD-051) but they are UNWIRED to avoidance. SD-059 adds the architecture: an affordance-indexed (per-first-action-class) credit table that, when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (relief) or terminates the threat (safety), tags that action as an escape affordance approachable under future threat; MECH-358 is the bridge mechanism.

Infralimbic-PFC-analog freeze-suppression + instrumental-avoidance gate: the mechanism instantiating SD-058. Cue-specific conditioned safety prediction: a discrete predictive structure encodes 'this stimulus actively predicts that suffering will be omitted', updated by explicit MECH-302 relief-completion events as its teaching signal. Encoding substrate is cortico-striatal (dorsal striatum + dlPFC). Expression/output pathway is IL-to-CeA. This is the conditioned-inhibition mechanism: when a specific cue co-occurs with relief, a separate learned prediction forms that can gate avoidance commitment release when the cue is later present. Sister claim to MECH-303 (contextual passive safety representation).

created_claims.title: Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge mechanism (instantiates SD-059): a pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/escape_affordance_bridge.py, sibling to the SD-058/MECH-357 gate) extending the MECH-357 scalar avoidance_efficacy into a per-first-action-class credit table. RELIEF half: a directed action under threat that drops z_harm_a (delta = prev - now > floor) credits relief_affordance[class] (EMA toward 1; MECH-302-consistent). SAFETY half: a directed action after which threat is absent (threat_scale <= 0) credits safety_affordance[class] (MECH-303/304-consistent response-produced safety). created_claims.title: Instrumental-avoidance acquisition: REE's defensive system needs an instrumental-ACQUISITION side, not only the defensive-REACTION side. SD-035 (amygdala BLA/CeA salience) + MECH-279 (PAG freeze gate) give REE the Pavlovian reaction (Tovote 2016: response EXECUTION, not learning); what is missing is the step from reaction to learned avoidance. Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance learning is the RESOLUTION of a Pavlovian-instrumental conflict -- the freezing reaction and the instrumental avoidance action are mutually exclusive, and learning to avoid REQUIRES the infralimbic PFC to SUPPRESS central-amygdala-driven freezing (ilPFC lesion -> more freezing, less avoidance; CeA lesion -> opposite). A freeze-and-salience substrate with no reaction-suppression / instrumental-acquisition layer is the ilPFC-lesion animal: it freezes instead of learning to avoid -- the V3-EXQ-603g G_H 0/3 signature. SD-058 adds the architecture (an instrumental-avoidance action pathway + an ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression gate gated by learned avoidance-efficacy, staged under a protective scaffold); MECH-357 is the gate mechanism.

created_claims.title: Object-bound incentive-salience layer: insert a per-object incentive layer between the benefit pulse and z_goal. SD-057 adds (L2 MECH-344) benefit->object-identity binding on the SD-049 per-type tag, (L3 MECH-345) a per-object slow-decay revaluable incentive token with at-recall drive-specific wanting amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive), and (L4 MECH-346) z_goal seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored embedding rather than the raw last-contacted z_resource. v1 = L2+L3+L4 core; L6 cue-recall (MECH-CUEWANT) + L7 dACC-readout-wiring (MECH-CONSUME) deferred to a phase-2 pass within this SD.

hub_targets.title: e3_scoring_preserves_trajectory_class_diversity. E3 score aggregation over CEM-supplied candidates must preserve trajectory-class diversity rather than collapse a diverse candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. Without explicit diversity preservation at the scoring step, downstream action selection becomes deterministic regardless of proposal-layer diversity (ARC-065 SP-CEM child), making the whole distributed diversity pathway rate-limited by Layer B. Mechanism options (not yet committed): (1) entropy bonus over candidate first-action classes added to E3 score; (2) class- stratified argmax with within-class proportional sampling; (3) jittered tie-breaking when top-K E3 scores are within epsilon. Final design pending diagnostic data on whether E3 collapse is near-tie or large-gap (see behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan.md Phase P2).
Hippocampus generates explicit rollouts and post-commitment viability mapping.

difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy (controlled proposal-entropy widening under goal blockage). When goal progress stalls -- repeated failure to improve goal progress, high inter-candidate conflict, low E3 score margin, low committed-action diversity, plateau/stuck-state signal -- WITH goal salience preserved, the agent should transiently INCREASE proposal-generation entropy UPSTREAM of action selection (wider hippocampal/world-model rollout candidate set + higher within-class sampling temperature) while preserving goal/harm/constraint scoring and DELAYING commitment until one candidate clears the E3 score-margin / commitment threshold; entropy then NARROWS once a workable candidate is found -> committed action -> entropy decay. Asserted distinction (preserve this): a hard problem must trigger WIDER INTERNAL PROPOSALS -> more candidate diversity -> longer arbitration -> selective committed action (controlled entropy), NOT 'hard problem -> random behaviour' (noise). WORKING HYPOTHESIS -- no experimental evidence yet; not an established mechanism.

created_claims.title: Does stuck-state-GATED proposal entropy outperform BOTH entropy-off and always-high entropy? Main empirical prediction of MECH-343: in a hard-goal/blocked-path environment (matched easy-goal controls), the difficulty-gated-entropy arm should show flexible exploration -- improved goal progress, no harm increase, no random-churn increase, commitment latency that rises during the hard phase then falls after solution discovery -- and should BEAT both the entropy-off arm (proposal rigidity / stuck) and the entropy-always-high arm (disorganised exploration / no narrowing). WORKING QUESTION -- no evidence yet.

The R-c readiness signals that gate commitment ENTRY (MECH-090: score_margin decisiveness + nav_competence) must ALSO be able to RELEASE an already-elevated beta latch when execution readiness degrades mid-commitment. The release is a graded, bounded-accumulation drift-to-a-release-bound (conflict-scaled by the deficit magnitude), NOT a one-shot threshold flag; targeted to the active committed motor program (not a global brake); and hysteretic with a reengagement path that guards the premature-abort pole. F accumulates with effort / time-on-task and dissipates with rest; at the upper bound it emits STOP / disengage, recovering to a lower bound before re-engaging. Two time-constants: a fast within-task accumulator and a slow sleep-pressure (Process-S) variant whose recover phase is offline (SD-017 sleep). The in-task STOP feeds the MECH-342 release actuator as a new deficit input and the ARC-078 goal-disengagement consumer via a cost/benefit (non-aversive) channel; the recover / re-accumulation half lives on the SD-012 / SD-017 side. Monomodal policy collapse is the equilibrium of a parametric-policy agent without a rule-apprehension layer. Bayesian update and gradient descent revise weights over a hypothesis space they do not invent; without a non-Bayesian rule-creator that proposes discriminative policy modes ('near-hazard -> reef regime; else -> forage regime'), the trainer collapses to the smoothest single regime good-enough across the whole state space. Monostrategy is therefore not a bug of training but the predicted output of an architecture in which only updaters exist and no apprehender does. Falsifiable by the weak-reading rule-apprehension experiment (ARC-062): a gated-policy architecture trained on the same substrate should break the collapse where standard E3 does not.

Object-bound incentive-salience layer: insert a per-object incentive layer between the benefit pulse and z_goal. The legacy goal stream wrote a SINGLE z_goal attractor overwritten on every contact, conflating liking (hedonic impact at consumption) with wanting (incentive salience to a cue/object) and goal-location (where) with goal-object (what); wanting target always equalled liking target, so the L9 wanting!=liking dissociation was structurally inexpressible (514l C6=0.0 on all seeds). SD-057 adds (L2 MECH-344) benefit->object-identity binding on the SD-049 per-type tag, (L3 MECH-345) a per-object slow-decay revaluable incentive token with at-recall drive-specific wanting amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive), and (L4 MECH-346) z_goal seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored embedding rather than the raw last-contacted z_resource. v1 = L2+L3+L4 core; L6 cue-recall (MECH-CUEWANT) + L7 dACC-readout-wiring (MECH-CONSUME) deferred to a phase-2 pass within this SD.

z_goal written from the incentive-token pointer (L4; amends MECH-230): z_goal is seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored identity embedding (argmax over per-object wanting) rather than from the raw last-contacted z_resource. z_goal keeps its role as E1 conditioning vector and E3 goal_proximity target; only the seed SOURCE changes, making the attractor object-bound and the wanting target dissociable from the liking (last-contacted) target.

hub_targets.title: behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway (multi-substrate distributed: LC-NE tonic + frontopolar curiosity + striatal novelty + hippocampal trajectory sampling). Architectural commitment: a non-trivial behavioural diversity generation pathway is upstream-of and logically prior to both rule pathways (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension and ARC-064 bottom-up rule-discovery). Without it, neither pathway has anything to weight or cluster -- gradient descent on a parametric policy without diversity pressure collapses to the smoothest single regime, the predicted equilibrium MECH-309 identifies. The biology distributes diversity generation across at least four substrates: LC-NE tonic noise floor, frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity, striatal novelty bonus, and hippocampal trajectory sampling. REE registers this as a foundational architectural slot whose specific child mechanisms (MECH-313 noise-floor, MECH-314 structured-curiosity with three sub-flavours, and the MECH-315-absorbed proposal-diversity channel) are independently testable but jointly load-bearing.

e3_scoring_preserves_trajectory_class_diversity. E3 score aggregation over CEM-supplied candidates must preserve trajectory-class diversity rather than collapse a diverse candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. Without explicit diversity preservation at the scoring step, downstream action selection becomes deterministic regardless of proposal-layer diversity (ARC-065 SP-CEM child), making the whole distributed diversity pathway rate-limited by Layer B. Mechanism options (not yet committed): (1) entropy bonus over candidate first-action classes added to E3 score; (2) class- stratified argmax with within-class proportional sampling; (3) jittered tie-breaking when top-K E3 scores are within epsilon. Final design pending diagnostic data on whether E3 collapse is near-tie or large-gap (see behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan.md Phase P2).
Hippocampus generates explicit rollouts and post-commitment viability mapping.

control_plane.commit_maintenance_release. The R-c readiness signals that gate commitment ENTRY (MECH-090: score_margin decisiveness + nav_competence) must ALSO be able to RELEASE an already-elevated beta latch when execution readiness degrades mid-commitment. The release is a graded, bounded-accumulation drift-to-a-release-bound (conflict-scaled by the deficit magnitude), NOT a one-shot threshold flag; targeted to the active committed motor program (not a global brake); and hysteretic with a reengagement path that guards the premature-abort pole. This closes the V3-EXQ-592f reach gap (the MECH-090 R-c conjunction is admission-only by design; no existing release pathway covers degraded-readiness-mid- commitment).
BG-level beta oscillations gate E3-to-action-selection propagation, not E3 internal updating.
E3 selects and commits trajectories.

structured_curiosity_bonus (frontopolar_uncertainty_driven_exploration_expected_free_energy_analog). A reward bonus on action-selection that rewards information-gain or uncertainty-reduction, distinct from a state-independent noise floor (MECH-313). Biological substrate: rostrolateral prefrontal exploration bonus (Daw et al. 2006 Nature) operating jointly with striatal novelty (Wittmann et al. 2008 Neuron). Three sub-flavours (MECH-314a/b/c) that the lit-pull recommended NOT to collapse prematurely: striatal novelty (Wittmann anchor), frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity (Daw anchor), learning-progress / intrinsic-motivation curiosity (Schmidhuber/Pathak tradition). Active-inference (Friston 2010/2015 expected free energy) provides the formal-level unification. Q-044 captures the open question of whether the three sub-flavours are distinct substrates or three readings of one mechanism with different upstream inputs.

Difficulty-gated proposal-entropy regulator: a stuck-state/impasse detector + a transient gain on the ARC-018/CEM PROPOSAL-generation layer (wider candidate set + within-class CEM sampling temperature), decaying as the impasse clears. Builds MECH-343's substrate_conditional blocker part 2 (the 'stuck-state detector + transient CEM temperature/candidate-count gain + decay not yet designed' piece named in MECH-343's evidence_quality_note); blocker part 1 (modulatory-bias-selection-authority) is already IMPLEMENTED via the 569i top-k shortlist conversion. The detector integrates goal-progress stall + E3 score margin + committed-action-class lock-in + dACC choice_difficulty into a graded stuck_score, GUARDED by goal salience (stuck-WITH-goal, not goal-abandonment); the regulator maps stuck_score to extra CEM candidates + a within-class temperature lift. Scoring, commitment (MECH-090/342) and selection authority (569i/MECH-341) are untouched -- a hard problem widens proposals, not behaviour.

created_claims.title: difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy (controlled proposal-entropy widening under goal blockage). When goal progress stalls -- repeated failure to improve goal progress, high inter-candidate conflict, low E3 score margin, low committed-action diversity, plateau/stuck-state signal -- WITH goal salience preserved, the agent should transiently INCREASE proposal-generation entropy UPSTREAM of action selection (wider hippocampal/world-model rollout candidate set + higher within-class sampling temperature) while preserving goal/harm/constraint scoring and DELAYING commitment until one candidate clears the E3 score-margin / commitment threshold; entropy then NARROWS once a workable candidate is found -> committed action -> entropy decay. Asserted distinction (preserve this): a hard problem must trigger WIDER INTERNAL PROPOSALS -> more candidate diversity -> longer arbitration -> selective committed action (controlled entropy), NOT 'hard problem -> random behaviour' (noise). WORKING HYPOTHESIS -- no experimental evidence yet; not an established mechanism.

Object identity is a cross-cutting representational primitive. An object is a token-bound identity representation that persists across time and perceptual gaps, generalising z_object/z_resource into an object-file/binding layer (ARC-006), defined by causal feature-coherence under intervention (MECH-278), and consumed by drive/goal (SD-057), hippocampal planning (MECH-262), and the self/other special-object cases. The four planned object capabilities -- (1) permanence, (2) self-as-object, (3) tools/affordances, (4) others-as-object -- are specialisations of one primitive, not four separate mechanisms.

Self-as-object (PILLAR 2 of ARC-080): z_self becomes a privileged token-keyed object-file SLOT in the generalised object-file layer. The SELF BEGINS IN V3 -- z_self self/world split (SD-005), self-attribution (SD-003), action-space discovery / self-as-object stage 1 (MECH-277, ARC-059 stage 1), reward-free babbling Phase 0 (ARC-074). The object-file CUTOVER IS V4 -- z_self promoted from a body-state latent to a privileged self-OBJECT slot, gated by the DR-10..DR-14 self-model integration audit, MECH-214 (goal E1-representability), MECH-215 (self-model prerequisite for agentive prediction), INV-064 (maturational-sequence necessity), and SD-030 (E2 self-forward-model, V4-deferred). The beginning of self is V3; the object-file-slot cutover is V4.

REE developmental training proceeds in three ordered stages: (1) self-as-object — action-space discovery via motor experimentation, producing the substrate SD-003 requires; (2) objects-as-patterns — object-schema formation via experimental action on the world; (3) others-as-special-objects — modelling other agents as objects with their own policies. Stage-2 specialisation of MECH-276: once the agent can distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change (stage 1 complete via MECH-277), it forms object-schemas via experimental action on the world. An object is the stable bundle of features that behave causally together under interventional perturbation -- push here, these features move together; occlude this, that cluster disappears. Object-schema formation is the stage-2 specialisation of the scientist-agent principle, with world-features as the target of intervention. V3's z_world (SD-005) is currently engineered pre-split; this is an architectural shortcut past stage 2.

created_claims.title: E2 world-forward action-conditional divergence preservation via auxiliary InfoNCE-style contrastive loss. Substrate-level fix for the V3-EXQ-571 root cause finding (2026-05-25): with world_dim=32 and action_dim=4, action contributes ~11% of world_forward input dimensionality, and reconstruction-shaped training collapses to the state-dominated local minimum where action effect is fitted to zero. hub_targets.title: behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway (multi-substrate distributed: LC-NE tonic + frontopolar curiosity + striatal novelty + hippocampal trajectory sampling). Architectural commitment: a non-trivial behavioural diversity generation pathway is upstream-of and logically prior to both rule pathways (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension and ARC-064 bottom-up rule-discovery). Without it, neither pathway has anything to weight or cluster -- gradient descent on a parametric policy without diversity pressure collapses to the smoothest single regime, the predicted equilibrium MECH-309 identifies. The biology distributes diversity generation across at least four substrates: LC-NE tonic noise floor, frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity, striatal novelty bonus, and hippocampal trajectory sampling. REE registers this as a foundational architectural slot whose specific child mechanisms (MECH-313 noise-floor, MECH-314 structured-curiosity with three sub-flavours, and the MECH-315-absorbed proposal-diversity channel) are independently testable but jointly load-bearing.
The SWS sub-phase of offline mode performs global attractor flattening and residue field denoising (synaptic homeostasis analog), pruning weak noisy traces and restoring signal-to-noise ratio.

REE-v3 requires a minimal sleep-phase infrastructure: an SWS-analog phase (bidirectional hippocampus-to-cortex replay for schema/slot consolidation) and a REM-analog phase (causal attribution replay for slot-filling from co-correlational evidence ordering). Without these offline phases, hippocampal attribution mapping cannot converge and context representations remain globally undifferentiated.

Any agent that builds a model of the world, acts in that world, and learns from experience cannot safely update its world model while using it to navigate the world; it therefore requires periodic offline phases in which action is suspended and the model is reorganised via replay and simulation -- this is not a biological contingency but a general computational necessity for model-building agents.

Rule-apprehension architectural slot, weak reading: a non-Bayesian rule-creator at the policy layer that proposes discriminative policy modes for the updaters (E3, training loop) to refine. V3 instantiation: a gated-policy architecture in which at least two policy heads share encoder features but receive different gating from a learned context discriminator (e.g., reef-context vs open-context heads). Tests the logical-necessity claim of MECH-309 within the existing V3 substrate without registering the heavier CandidateRule machinery (ARC-063, V4-deferred). Architectural slot, not yet implemented.

stochastic_noise_floor (max_entropy_policy_regularisation_LC_NE_tonic_analog). A floor-level stochastic action-selection noise that prevents complete deterministic collapse of the policy. Biological substrate: locus coeruleus tonic firing producing baseline action-selection variability (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 adaptive-gain model). Computational analog: max-entropy policy regularisation / SAC entropy bonus (Haarnoja et al. 2018). Distinct from MECH-260 dACC anti-recency: MECH-313 is a state-independent noise floor, while MECH-260 is a state-dependent recency penalty. Both can contribute to anti-monostrategy pressure but operate via different mechanisms; whether they collapse into a single substrate or are mutually load-bearing is open (Q-045).

structured_curiosity_bonus (frontopolar_uncertainty_driven_exploration_expected_free_energy_analog). A reward bonus on action-selection that rewards information-gain or uncertainty-reduction, distinct from a state-independent noise floor (MECH-313). Biological substrate: rostrolateral prefrontal exploration bonus (Daw et al. 2006 Nature) operating jointly with striatal novelty (Wittmann et al. 2008 Neuron). Three sub-flavours (MECH-314a/b/c) that the lit-pull recommended NOT to collapse prematurely: striatal novelty (Wittmann anchor), frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity (Daw anchor), learning-progress / intrinsic-motivation curiosity (Schmidhuber/Pathak tradition). Active-inference (Friston 2010/2015 expected free energy) provides the formal-level unification. Q-044 captures the open question of whether the three sub-flavours are distinct substrates or three readings of one mechanism with different upstream inputs.

Behavioural diversity is a structural prerequisite for ethical counterfactual evaluation. A system with monomodal policy cannot instantiate the counterfactual evaluation that ethical judgement requires, because the 'could have done otherwise' comparison demands that the agent's candidate trajectory pool contain at least two distinct trajectory classes with distinct harm profiles. The argument is mathematical-by-construction: if P(a|s) is monomodal, the CEM elite pool contains only trajectories beginning with a*, and SD-003's counterfactual E2(z_t, a_cf) for a_cf != a* is never evaluated in the on-policy candidate distribution. (Was proposed 2026-05-15 as INV-074 in behavioral_diversity_acceptance_criteria.md but never registered; the ID was subsequently taken 2026-05-17 by an unrelated plasticity-crystallization invariant. Re-registered under INV-076 with scientific content unchanged.)

created_claims.title: e3_scoring_preserves_trajectory_class_diversity. E3 score aggregation over CEM-supplied candidates must preserve trajectory-class diversity rather than collapse a diverse candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. Without explicit diversity preservation at the scoring step, downstream action selection becomes deterministic regardless of proposal-layer diversity (ARC-065 SP-CEM child), making the whole distributed diversity pathway rate-limited by Layer B. Mechanism options (not yet committed): (1) entropy bonus over candidate first-action classes added to E3 score; (2) class- stratified argmax with within-class proportional sampling; (3) jittered tie-breaking when top-K E3 scores are within epsilon. Final design pending diagnostic data on whether E3 collapse is near-tie or large-gap (see behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan.md Phase P2).
