recurrent_dependency_hubs.title: Rule-apprehension architectural slot, weak reading: a non-Bayesian rule-creator at the policy layer that proposes discriminative policy modes for the updaters (E3, training loop) to refine. V3 instantiation: a gated-policy architecture in which at least two policy heads share encoder features but receive different gating from a learned context discriminator (e.g., reef-context vs open-context heads). Tests the logical-necessity claim of MECH-309 within the existing V3 substrate without registering the heavier CandidateRule machinery (ARC-063, V4-deferred). Architectural slot, not yet implemented.

source_claims.title: Pre-approach orienting/surveying mode: a cue-triggered, need-gated active-sensing control state entered when a cue/need is present but directional/affordance confidence is too low for reliable approach; it samples gradients (turn/scan, exploratory arcs) until a directional vector stabilises, then exits to approach.

Safety-route inference: under threat, REE can infer a likely route to safety from partial map, cue, gradient, and prior-trajectory evidence rather than requiring safety to be directly visible or navigation-handed; generalises the scalar per-action-class escape credit of SD-059/MECH-358 into an inferred route.

Inferred affordance field: REE can infer affordances not directly perceived by combining current cues, hippocampal traces, E2 action-consequence predictions, CandidateRuleField content, affective gradients, and control-plane precision; these inferred affordances bias E3 candidate trajectories without overwriting perception and remain corrigible by action outcome.

Inference / belief-state affordance layer: a named integrative function that constructs latent state hypotheses and inferred affordance fields from partial observation, memory, cue traces, candidate rules, affective gradients, uncertainty, and E2 action-consequence rollouts, so E3 selects trajectories under partial observability without requiring direct perception or oracle-like prior knowledge.

dACC object-discriminative goal readout (L7): the dACC adaptive-control consumer reads per-candidate goal_proximity to the (SD-057 object-bound) z_goal, so its effort/value computation becomes object-discriminative -- approach_commit is goal-conditioned rather than z_goal-blind. Resolves the 2026-06-04 L7 audit finding that only E3 goal_proximity read z_goal consequentially and dACC was blind.

Cue-triggered wanting / cue-recall (L6): a PERCEIVED cue/object type (with no benefit pulse) retrieves its SD-057 incentive token and nudges z_goal toward that object's stored identity embedding BEFORE consumption -- identity-matched (pulls toward the perceived cue's object) and drive-specific (amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive)). The downstream E3 goal_proximity + MECH-295 approach bridge then raise pre-consummatory approach toward the cued object. Distinct from the benefit-driven seed: no benefit pulse, no token revaluation, weaker (cue_recall_gain) pull.

z_goal written from the incentive-token pointer (L4; amends MECH-230): z_goal is seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored identity embedding (argmax over per-object wanting) rather than from the raw last-contacted z_resource. z_goal keeps its role as E1 conditioning vector and E3 goal_proximity target; only the seed SOURCE changes, making the attractor object-bound and the wanting target dissociable from the liking (last-contacted) target.

Per-object incentive-salience token (L3): each resource identity accrues a slowly-decaying, revaluable base incentive value plus a stored identity embedding; wanting amplitude at recall = base_value * (1 + kappa * drive), with the drive multiplier relocated from the seeding gate onto the stored per-object value and computed per-axis so wanting is drive-specific / identity-matched (specific PIT).

Benefit-to-object-identity binding (L2): at resource contact the benefit pulse is bound to the contacted object's identity (the SD-049 per-type tag) via an associative object->benefit node, rather than written as a raw scalar gate against the current world/resource latent. The amygdala/BLA-analog identity-binding node the legacy substrate lacked (cue_features was a V3 no-op stub).

Object identity is a cross-cutting representational primitive. An object is a token-bound identity representation that persists across time and perceptual gaps, generalising z_object/z_resource into an object-file/binding layer (ARC-006), defined by causal feature-coherence under intervention (MECH-278), and consumed by drive/goal (SD-057), hippocampal planning (MECH-262), and the self/other special-object cases. The four planned object capabilities -- (1) permanence, (2) self-as-object, (3) tools/affordances, (4) others-as-object -- are specialisations of one primitive, not four separate mechanisms.

recurrent_dependency_hubs.title: Object-bound incentive-salience layer: insert a per-object incentive layer between the benefit pulse and z_goal. The legacy goal stream wrote a SINGLE z_goal attractor overwritten on every contact, conflating liking (hedonic impact at consumption) with wanting (incentive salience to a cue/object) and goal-location (where) with goal-object (what); wanting target always equalled liking target, so the L9 wanting!=liking dissociation was structurally inexpressible (514l C6=0.0 on all seeds). SD-057 adds (L2 MECH-344) benefit->object-identity binding on the SD-049 per-type tag, (L3 MECH-345) a per-object slow-decay revaluable incentive token with at-recall drive-specific wanting amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive), and (L4 MECH-346) z_goal seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored embedding rather than the raw last-contacted z_resource. v1 = L2+L3+L4 core; L6 cue-recall (MECH-CUEWANT) + L7 dACC-readout-wiring (MECH-CONSUME) deferred to a phase-2 pass within this SD.

source_claims.title: Context-conditioned weights PROPER -- learned connection weights as a function of context, distinct from context-conditioned GAIN: REE today has the GAIN form of context-conditioning (ARC-044's unifier -- a context-specific multiplicative scalar: MECH-152 terrain_weight scaling E3 harm/goal scoring, ARC-016 precision, MECH-261 mode-conditioned write-CHANNEL gating) which modulates a FIXED transfer function. It does NOT have the WEIGHT form: a substrate where the learned connection weights THEMSELVES are a function of context (a different effective weight set selected/generated per context -- the transfer function changes, not a gain on it). The valuation/gating parameters are static nn.Modules; context enters only through the INPUT (z_world) and through output GAIN, never through the weights. HYPOTHESIS: genuinely context-dependent BEHAVIOUR (not just context-scaled magnitude) requires context to reach the weights -- the learned per-channel selection weight w_chan conditioned on z_world that ARC-108 introduces is the first instance of this WEIGHT form at the gating layer.

Is an EXPLICIT event-level write-eligible state (MECH-368) actually needed, or is the existing combination -- MECH-261 mode-conditioned channel gating + MECH-094 provenance gating + MECH-285 consolidation-priority by V_s residual -- already sufficient to prevent undifferentiated global model updates? This is the falsifier for MECH-368: if a substrate that gates only the channel (mode) and prioritises only at consolidation still avoids catastrophic interference on the online world-model/policy path, MECH-368 earns no keep.

Two-factor (tag-and-capture) write-eligibility: MECH-368's plasticity_eligibility is not a single instantaneous test but a TWO-STAGE process -- a local event sets a transient, input-specific eligibility TAG, and a durable model/policy write is consummated only if that tag CAPTURES a separately-gated plasticity/consolidation-resource signal within a time window. A tagged-eligible event can still fail to write if no capture signal arrives, and an arriving capture signal can rescue a recently-tagged weak event.

Schema-congruence as a consolidation write-weight and routing variable: the degree of fit between an event and the agent's existing schemas modulates how that event is consolidated -- schema-congruent content is consolidated preferentially and routed more directly into the durable/semantic store (a fast vmPFC-gated systems-consolidation route), while schema-incongruent content requires prolonged hippocampal-dependent consolidation or is gated out. Schema-fit is a WRITE-WEIGHT input to consolidation alongside affect (MECH-361), not only a retrieval-time prior.

Retrieval-time accessibility gating: which stored traces become reinstatable at a given moment is set by two composable READ-side policy layers, not by storage alone. Line A -- a global, slowly-fluctuating, arousal-coupled reinstatement GAIN (content-blind; sets the threshold on whether ANY stored trace crosses into accessibility; stochastic-resonance flavour). Line B -- a content-selective competitive SUPPRESSION that, given what the global gate admits, inhibits specific competitors to keep retrieval clean. The READ-side sibling of MECH-261's mode-conditioned WRITE-gate family: REE owns the gates but not this retrieval-time gating POLICY.

Consolidation gated-write-authority: over-frequent rewriting of consolidated memory is a failure mode; the consolidation operator's authority to overwrite is gated by schema-stability / schedule-sensitivity, not run after every interaction.

Contextual memory-allocation gate policy: a control-plane decision stage (context_similarity x temporal_distance interaction, schema_fit, salience, PE, uncertainty, goal_relevance) selecting integrate / partial_overlap / separate over the hippocampal graph.

Labels as active top-down perceptual-control signals: a self-directed label ('food-gradient', 'danger-gradient', 'novelty-gradient', 'blocked-goal', 'return-to-baseline') is not merely a post-perceptual report but a top-down tuning signal that biases perceptual search and detection -- a perceptual-control intervention, not a description.

Event-level write-authority gate: an explicit per-event transition from observed/represented to write-eligible over the DURABLE MODEL-UPDATE path (E1/E2 world-model and policy weights, not only episodic memory), conditioned on f(prediction_error, salience, pathway_state, residue_status, goal_relevance, plasticity_eligibility). The gate decides which individual events within an already-open write channel are licensed to durably deform the model; an event may be salient, real-provenance, and in a write-permitted mode yet still fail the gate. Without it, every prediction error in an open channel writes -- the undifferentiated-global-update / catastrophic-interference failure mode.

Candidate-gradient hippocampal episode schema: enrich the event trace from state -> action -> outcome to state -> candidates-considered -> affective gradients over candidates -> selected action -> outcome -> residue (relief / harm / blocked-agency / safety update), and use the affective gradient as a memory WRITE-WEIGHT and RETRIEVAL-QUERY variable -- high-gradient episodes are preferentially written, and later similar-gradient states retrieve prior action-affect-outcome arcs rather than undifferentiated state-action-outcome tuples.

recurrent_dependency_hubs.title: Mode-conditioned write gating: the operating-mode variable from the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) determines which substrates can write to E3, episodic memory, policy updates, and autonomic coupling. Generalises MECH-094 hypothesis tag to a mode-conditioned family of write gates. Operating mode is implemented as a soft probability vector over {external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation}, not a one-hot categorical.

source_claims.title: Foreclosing the SELF's own future reachable-option space carries a decision cost in E3 trajectory scoring, GATED BY FORECAST UNCERTAINTY -- the non-harm, self-directed analog of INV-026 (which scopes foreclosure-of-reachable-state-space as a harm to OTHERS). E3 today scores harm + benefit + goal + residue + the modulatory stack; nothing represents the option-value / reversibility of an action for the agent's OWN reachable futures. REE's irreversibility-awareness is HARM-scoped (residue cannot be erased; No-Go gates; INV-026 foreclosure-of-others); there is no INFORMATION/RESOURCE-scoped analog (don't cheaply foreclose your own options). The claim: an uncertainty-gated reachable-option-preservation cost should change committed action -- preferring the reversible/option-preserving branch MORE when the forecast that justifies foreclosure is UNCERTAIN, and not at all when it is confident (a generalization of DR-12's PE-conditioned E3 confidence from object-rollouts to a foreclosure cost).

Cholinergic TAN-pause plasticity-window gating of selector credit: dopamine should NOT continuously update every recently-active selector component; a striatal cholinergic tonically-active-neuron (TAN) pause should open a NARROW plasticity window around behaviourally-relevant events, so the three-factor learned-gating updates (ARC-108) are admitted only WITHIN the window. Without a window, continuous credit smears across irrelevant recently-active components and degrades the learned gating the conversion attack depends on. The OPENING-side neuromodulatory complement to REE's existing CLOSURE-side plasticity control (MECH-094 waking-gate; INV-074/MECH-333/MECH-334 consolidation/EWC) -- REE today has machinery to stop/consolidate learning but not a phasic gate to OPEN a precise learning window.

Loop-local eligibility traces under a globally-broadcast dopamine signal: even with a SINGLE shared dopaminergic teaching signal (ARC-108 delta_t), the credit traces that decide WHICH synapses/channels the signal updates must remain LOCAL and loop-specific -- effective update = shared delta_t x separate local eligibility trace x loop-specific active synapses -- rather than the current single globally-broadcast credit that updates every recently-active selector component. A too-broad or temporally-smeared eligibility trace would make learned gating appear ineffective (no committed conversion) even when the underlying dopamine learning rule is exactly correct, because the right teaching signal is delivered to the wrong synapses.

Intermediate channel-granularity falsifier -- before the full segregated-loop build (ARC-110), expose the compressed E3 score_bias modulatory channel as SEVERAL separately-learnable finer channels (OFC-devaluation / dACC-conflict / lateral-PFC rule-evidence / vigour / liking) to the learned-gating layer (ARC-108 w_chan), so the learner can discover SEPARATELY that different control functions matter in different states. The current single global w_chan learns one weight over a pre-compressed blend; this tests whether the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is REPRESENTATIONAL COMPRESSION (finer channels convert non-motor influence to committed action) rather than a requirement for full per-loop competition (finer channels do NOT convert, and only ARC-110 segregated loops do). The cheap intermediate rung BETWEEN ARC-108's one global weight vector and ARC-110's full segregated loops -- a V3-tractable falsifier that can pre-empt the V4 loop build.

The valuation/gating parameters are static nn.Modules; context enters only through the INPUT (z_world) and through output GAIN, never through the weights. A hard argmin over an F-dominated score always returns the F-winner (the conversion ceiling); a settling competition with lateral inhibition can FLIP the selected attractor when a modulatory channel is strong enough, and turns the additive _modulatory_accum BLEND into a competitive winner-take-most. The V3-bounded version of the BG's recurrent settling dynamics; the full learned thalamo-cortico-basal loop is the V4 bet.

Parallel segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops (motor / cognitive-set / motivational): committed-action selection should run through SEPARATE striatal loop channels -- a motor loop, an associative/cognitive-set loop, and a limbic/motivational loop -- each owning its own eligibility-and-gate, arbitrated AFTER within-loop competition, rather than collapsing all channels into ONE shared E3 selection arena where the dACC/lPFC/OFC analogs feed in only as additive biases. HYPOTHESIS (assembly-map A.2 / s.D): the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is partly an ARTEFACT of the single-arena collapse -- F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance because every channel competes in one F-dominated arena; with segregated loops F could dominate only the motor loop and could not drown the limbic 'is this worth committing to' computation, which is a different loop with a different value. Translation target is FUNCTIONAL (the Alexander/DeLong/Strick parallel-loop organisation as a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

D1/D2 striatal population split with asymmetric dopamine gain: the Go (direct/D1) and No-Go (indirect/D2) pathways should be represented as TWO populations with OPPOSITE dopamine sensitivity (DA potentiates D1/Go via LTP, depresses D2/No-Go via LTD), NOT collapsed into one additive scoring scalar. REE today renders Go/No-Go as a scoring SIGN (benefit_eval_head minus harm_eval_head; MECH-449 Go-promote / No-Go-suppress over the eligible set) -- dissociable pathways pre-summed into one cost. The split is REQUIRED to EARN the Parkinson / dyskinesia / Huntington / impulse-control-disorder psychiatric axis per the ARC-106 EARNS criterion.

Unified dopamine substrate -- signed dopaminergic-RPE teaching signal feeding LEARNED gating weights on the E3 selector: the cortico-striatal weights that decide which channel wins committed-selection authority should themselves be LEARNED via three-factor plasticity (Hebbian co-activation x signed dopaminergic RPE) with the D1-LTP / D2-LTD asymmetry, consolidating the currently-scattered RPE / vigor / incentive functions into one substrate and supplying the GPi->lateral-habenula negative-RPE drain. The ARC-107 arbitration layer (MECH-447/448/449 + the authority rescale) is today pure arithmetic with NO learned parameters; F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance (MECH-439) precisely because no learned striatal weighting can re-weight channels through experience. The single highest-leverage missing BG piece and the proposed next attack on MECH-439.

Is the E3 committed-action conversion ceiling CONSTITUTIONAL (the rules by which candidate actions become eligible to win -- eligibility mask, Go/No-Go pressures, conflict-sensitive hold, threshold/widening, recurrent competition, commitment permission, post-commit latch -- are under-specified) rather than PARAMETRIC (upstream signals too weak / modulatory channels too quiet)? Across mechanistically distinct channels (CRF V3-EXQ-654g, OFC V3-EXQ-485h, SD-037 V3-EXQ-625e, dACC V3-EXQ-445h, modulatory V3-EXQ-569g) a formed-and-measurable signal reaches E3 authority yet committed action does not change reliably -- 'signal strength can exist without lawful access to committed action.' The basal-ganglia action-selection bottleneck (direct/Go, indirect/No-Go, hyperdirect-STN conflict-hold, striatal channel competition, pallidal permission-to-commit) is the functional reference; the open question is whether a BG-like selection CONSTITUTION is required BEYOND MECH-439's F-variance-share rebalance / shortlist levers.

Go/No-Go eligibility constitution for committed-action conversion: committed-action diversity is recovered not by any single louder channel but by an explicit eligibility CONSTITUTION -- bounded Go pressure (promote a channel when evidence/value/drive/rule/safety make it eligible) AND bounded No-Go pressure (suppress unsafe / stale / perseverative / irrelevant / low-viability channels) governing which candidates may compete for the pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate -- so that lawful, channel-specific access (not scalar dominance) decides the committed action. The full Go/No-Go eligibility-set governance is what converts when the minimal near-tie lever (MECH-447) does not and isolated F->eligibility demotion (MECH-448) is insufficient alone.

Residual conversion ceiling requiring rank-preserving F->eligibility demotion: near-tie levers (conflict-graded shortlist / commit-T, MECH-447) CAP committed-action-class entropy BELOW the proposer ceiling because they act only at near-ties while F still decides every non-tie; only REMOVING F from the final committed argmin -- demoting it to a graded ELIGIBILITY envelope (rank-preserving renormalisation against the competing field; divisive-normalisation analog) so a modulatory/diversity channel arbitrates within the F-eligible set -- lifts committed diversity to the proposer ceiling without disinhibiting harmful classes.

Conflict-graded near-tie lever sufficiency: a hyperdirect-STN-like conflict-graded shortlist / commit-temperature lever (k = f(top-F gap); T = f(top-F gap)) is SUFFICIENT to lift committed-action-class entropy strict-above both collapsed-proposer and gap-blind controls -- gap-CONCENTRATED (the lift correlates with per-tick top-F gap) -- WITHOUT reducing F's E3 variance share. I.e. F can keep monopolising selection variance and conversion is still recovered by widening/hotting only at near-ties.

source_claims.title: Residue-aware social repair: exploiting a cooperating other leaves a persisting regret-residue that spawns a self-state repair-goal (restore commitment/relationship coherence), distinguishing genuine prosocial commitment from mere reciprocity bookkeeping.

Other-model prediction, reciprocity reward, and residue-aware social commitment are three separable functions: an agent can predict cooperative intent without binding it into commitment-altering value, and can value reciprocity without generating repair-residue after exploitation (the A/B/C/D dissociation).

Fast empathy mechanism: other-bound affect is produced by routing the agent's OWN motivational-affective streams (SD-011 suffering, MECH-112 wanting, etc.) through a stable other-model slot -- e.g. other-bound suffering = suffering stream + other-model binding; MECH-183 z_beta leakage is one such attribution-gated binding.

Mirror-coupling gain must be homeostatically regulated inside an operating window; the three social pathologies are its boundaries (low gain = psychopathy/callousness, high gain = empathic overwhelm/paralysis, miscalibrated = burnout/moral injury).

A lightweight LanguageAffectAdaptor parses affect/emotion from user or agent LANGUAGE into the shared world model: a language-interface component that, when literal semantic content is insufficient to recover affect, converts text into PROBABILISTIC affect/emotion hypotheses (treated as uncertain latent-state estimates, NOT categorical emotion truths) and feeds those estimates into REE's wider agent-state and context modelling. It is an input/perception adaptor on the language channel -- distinct from REE's INTERNAL affective representation (Q-007 z_beta dimensions) -- supplying other-agent affect priors to the social/empathy modelling layer.

Language bootstraps from a grounded social ecology, not from grammar: given shared attention, partial observability, coordination pressure, a low-cost channel, and repair, proto-language partially bootstraps from grounded proto-communication. The grammar/LLM scaffold is a turbocharger, never the engine -- the engine is the V5 social ecology.

No empathy module / no empathy scalar: fast empathy must emerge from binding existing motivational-affective streams across self -> object -> other, never as an empathy_enabled flag or empathy_score primitive.

Others-as-object (PILLAR 4 of ARC-080): each other agent j gets its own token-keyed object-file SLOT (z_self_j, z_harm_a_j, drive, commitment chain) -- a special case of the ARC-080 object-file. This pillar is V4 (ARC-010 mirror modelling, ARC-047 SocialGridWorld), gated on MECH-163 multi-step hippocampal planning. Per developmental_needs_register DEV-NEED-021 its prerequisites are object-permanence (PILLAR 1, partial via SD-039 ghost bank) + self-stability (PILLAR 2 self, ARC-081): otherness inference REQUIRES object persistence + a stable self.

source_claims.title: Difficulty-gated proposal-entropy regulator: a stuck-state/impasse detector + a transient gain on the ARC-018/CEM PROPOSAL-generation layer (wider candidate set + within-class CEM sampling temperature), decaying as the impasse clears. Builds MECH-343's substrate_conditional blocker part 2 (the 'stuck-state detector + transient CEM temperature/candidate-count gain + decay not yet designed' piece named in MECH-343's evidence_quality_note); blocker part 1 (modulatory-bias-selection-authority) is already IMPLEMENTED via the 569i top-k shortlist conversion. The detector integrates goal-progress stall + E3 score margin + committed-action-class lock-in + dACC choice_difficulty into a graded stuck_score, GUARDED by goal salience (stuck-WITH-goal, not goal-abandonment); the regulator maps stuck_score to extra CEM candidates + a within-class temperature lift. Scoring, commitment (MECH-090/342) and selection authority (569i/MECH-341) are untouched -- a hard problem widens proposals, not behaviour.

De-commit-authority magnitude: the closure-coupled de-commit lowers post-closure latch occupancy with authority magnitude sufficient to overcome the natural-commit occupancy it competes against -- the committed-run-scaled refractory drives a within-arm around-closure occupancy drop (pre-closure vs post-closure window on the ON arm), scaling with committed-run length so a long committed run triggers a proportionally long de-commit. Child B of the SD-034 de-commit-pipeline decomposition (S4).

Composed compulsion-risk readout: compulsive vulnerability is best modelled not as a single scalar (reward, habit strength, or belief) but as a composition compulsion_risk = f(loop_reinforcement, threat_salience, residue_persistence, decommit_friction, slow_modulatory_state) over quantities REE already represents separately -- a multi-layer state in which the substrate can make certain loops difficult to release even when any single term looks benign.

Slow substrate-state modulator with authority over compulsive-loop stickiness: a slowly-varying, broadly-projecting modulatory state can bias the decommit-friction / commitment-threshold / action-release landscape so that certain action loops become sticky, urgent, or hard to release INDEPENDENTLY of represented goal value or fast prediction-error -- i.e. a compulsive loop can arise from field-state bias rather than from an endorsed reward, valued goal, or false belief. The modulator changes the release/threshold landscape, not the value estimate.

Effort/fatigue stop-recover homeostatic accumulator: a two-bound (hysteretic) leaky cost-evidence accumulator on the SD-012 homeostatic-drive side (substrate-hosted by the SD-048 interoceptive channel). F accumulates with effort / time-on-task and dissipates with rest; at the upper bound it emits STOP / disengage, recovering to a lower bound before re-engaging. Two time-constants: a fast within-task accumulator and a slow sleep-pressure (Process-S) variant whose recover phase is offline (SD-017 sleep). The in-task STOP feeds the MECH-342 release actuator as a new deficit input and the ARC-078 goal-disengagement consumer via a cost/benefit (non-aversive) channel; the recover / re-accumulation half lives on the SD-012 / SD-017 side. Distinct from suffering / learned-helplessness (SD-011 side): fatigue is controllability-independent, incentive-reversible, and -- decisively -- recovers with rest, which helplessness does not.

Blocked-agency / control-failure affect stream (z_block): an integrated readout on the SD-029 agency comparator applied to the action-outcome channel. z_block rises when an intended action repeatedly fails to produce its forward-model-predicted outcome (MECH-112 z_goal supplies the expectation), the mismatch is attributed to an EXTERNAL constraint (not own motor error), AND goal/capacity-belief is RETAINED. It is a distinct affect stream from harm (SD-011: no noxious input required), from suffering (SD-019b/Q-036: OPPOSITE controllability pole -- capacity-retained drives ASSERT, capacity-collapsed drives WITHDRAW), from residue (MECH-056: action-prevented, not action-taken-at-cost), and from licit commitment-hold (MECH-090: externally-imposed block, not self-imposed gate).

difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy (controlled proposal-entropy widening under goal blockage). When goal progress stalls -- repeated failure to improve goal progress, high inter-candidate conflict, low E3 score margin, low committed-action diversity, plateau/stuck-state signal -- WITH goal salience preserved, the agent should transiently INCREASE proposal-generation entropy UPSTREAM of action selection (wider hippocampal/world-model rollout candidate set + higher within-class sampling temperature) while preserving goal/harm/constraint scoring and DELAYING commitment until one candidate clears the E3 score-margin / commitment threshold; entropy then NARROWS once a workable candidate is found -> committed action -> entropy decay. Asserted distinction (preserve this): a hard problem must trigger WIDER INTERNAL PROPOSALS -> more candidate diversity -> longer arbitration -> selective committed action (controlled entropy), NOT 'hard problem -> random behaviour' (noise). WORKING HYPOTHESIS -- no experimental evidence yet; not an established mechanism.

The R-c readiness signals that gate commitment ENTRY (MECH-090: score_margin decisiveness + nav_competence) must ALSO be able to RELEASE an already-elevated beta latch when execution readiness degrades mid-commitment. competence_based_intrinsic_motivation / goal_achievement_progress_wanting. A wanting bonus indexed to the agent's RATE-OF-IMPROVEMENT in ACHIEVING its own active goals: per active goal, an EMA of the derivative of goal-achievement competence (success-rate, or 1 - proximity-at-termination) injected as intrinsic wanting alongside MECH-229 VALENCE_WANTING, biasing the agent toward goals it is currently getting BETTER at reaching. top_internal_sources.title: Rule-apprehension architectural slot, strong reading: a distributed CandidateRule field with tolerance-gated availability, hippocampal-rollout-eligibility shaping, structured per-action evidence-trace records, and waking-vs-sleep refinement asymmetry. The biology-faithful form of the rule-apprehension layer, formalising the 2026-05-04 thought-intake on tolerance-gated rule apprehension (PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2508061123). Brought forward V4->V3 2026-05-18; V3-tractable design landed 2026-06-04 (docs/architecture/arc_063_candidate_rule_field.md). Only the social in-face (ARC-077/MECH-337) is V4-deferred (needs a caregiver-agent substrate absent in V3); the sleep-vs-waking refinement asymmetry is V3 (sleep rescoped to V3 2026-04-20; reuses the MECH-272/273/285 sleep cluster) and is a V3 follow-on within ARC-063, NOT V4. Persistent flag for governance: this slot is expected to be needed if ARC-062 (weak reading) fails or proves insufficient at scale, AND independently as the architectural commitment that supports moral-residue attribution to the rule-field, sleep-vs-waking refinement asymmetry, and clinically-realistic failure modes (trauma schemas, paranoid rule fields, depressive rollout constraint).

Socially-scaffolded rule-population pathway: the third rule-source, peer to ARC-062 (top-down gated-policy apprehension) and ARC-064 (bottom-up behavioural-pattern extraction), and upstream-fed by ARC-065 (behavioural diversity generation). Architectural commitment: in biology the candidate-rule hypothesis space is not invented by the agent alone -- caregivers populate it from outside via scaffolded exposure (Vygotsky ZPD; Wood/Bruner/Ross scaffolding; Csibra & Gergely ostensive cueing / natural pedagogy; Tomasello shared intentionality; joint attention / social referencing). This is the most direct architectural answer to MECH-309: a non-Bayesian rule-creator that does not invent its own hypotheses receives candidate regularities, context-bound to the scaffolding episode, from a caregiver. The pathway fills the ARC-063 CandidateRule field (the 'in' face); MECH-337 is the population mechanism; MECH-338 is the cue-driven context-bound retrieval mechanism (the 'select' face). Registered 2026-05-18 as a structural slot only -- hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull and on a caregiver/teacher-agent substrate that does not yet exist in V3.

Monomodal policy collapse is the equilibrium of a parametric-policy agent without a rule-apprehension layer. Bayesian update and gradient descent revise weights over a hypothesis space they do not invent; without a non-Bayesian rule-creator that proposes discriminative policy modes ('near-hazard -> reef regime; else -> forage regime'), the trainer collapses to the smoothest single regime good-enough across the whole state space. Monostrategy is therefore not a bug of training but the predicted output of an architecture in which only updaters exist and no apprehender does. Falsifiable by the weak-reading rule-apprehension experiment (ARC-062): a gated-policy architecture trained on the same substrate should break the collapse where standard E3 does not.

Caregiver-scaffolded rule-population mechanism (the 'in' face of the ARC-063 CandidateRule field). A caregiver / teacher agent structures the agent's exposure (Vygotsky ZPD; Wood/Bruner/Ross scaffolding) and marks regularities ostensively (Csibra & Gergely natural pedagogy); the marked regularity is written into the ARC-063 CandidateRule field as a candidate the agent could not have invented alone, tagged with the scaffolding context. Population is context-bound by construction -- this is the concrete mechanism behind 'context-bound rule population'. Child of ARC-077. Structural slot only; hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull and a caregiver-agent substrate that does not exist in V3.

Cue-driven context-bound rule retrieval (the 'cue pipeline' / 'select' face of the ARC-063 CandidateRule field). Environmental or internal cues are matched against CandidateRule context tags to gate rollout-eligibility: a rule populated in a context becomes available again when that context, or a cue associated with it, recurs (context-dependent / cued recall; Tulving & Thomson encoding-specificity; Godden & Baddeley context-dependent memory). This is the retrieval pay-off of context-bound population (MECH-337) and the access gate that decides which CandidateRules enter hippocampal rollout. Child of ARC-077. Structural slot only; hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull.

Rule-apprehension architectural slot, weak reading: a non-Bayesian rule-creator at the policy layer that proposes discriminative policy modes for the updaters (E3, training loop) to refine. V3 instantiation: a gated-policy architecture in which at least two policy heads share encoder features but receive different gating from a learned context discriminator (e.g., reef-context vs open-context heads). Tests the logical-necessity claim of MECH-309 within the existing V3 substrate without registering the heavier CandidateRule machinery (ARC-063, V4-deferred). Architectural slot, not yet implemented.

bottom_up_behavioral_pattern_extraction_pathway (hippocampal_CLS_bi_pathway + dorsolateral_striatum_chunking + OFC_cognitive_map analog). Architectural commitment: rule discovery from observed-behaviour clustering is logically and architecturally distinct from rule application from instructed/external context (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension). Where ARC-062 receives a context cue and selects a discriminative policy mode, ARC-064 receives an observed-behaviour stream and extracts cross-episode regularities, compressed behavioural patterns, and rule-state abstractions. Both pathways presuppose ARC-065 behavioural diversity generation upstream. Multi-substrate distributed instantiation: hippocampal Complementary Learning Systems bi-pathway (Schapiro et al. 2017), dorsolateral striatum action chunking (Smith & Graybiel 2013/2016), OFC cognitive-map state abstraction (Wilson et al. 2014; Schuck et al. 2016).

Rule-apprehension architectural slot, strong reading: a distributed CandidateRule field with tolerance-gated availability, hippocampal-rollout-eligibility shaping, structured per-action evidence-trace records, and waking-vs-sleep refinement asymmetry. The biology-faithful form of the rule-apprehension layer, formalising the 2026-05-04 thought-intake on tolerance-gated rule apprehension (PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2508061123). Brought forward V4->V3 2026-05-18; V3-tractable design landed 2026-06-04 (docs/architecture/arc_063_candidate_rule_field.md). Only the social in-face (ARC-077/MECH-337) is V4-deferred (needs a caregiver-agent substrate absent in V3); the sleep-vs-waking refinement asymmetry is V3 (sleep rescoped to V3 2026-04-20; reuses the MECH-272/273/285 sleep cluster) and is a V3 follow-on within ARC-063, NOT V4. Rule-apprehension architectural slot, weak reading: a non-Bayesian rule-creator at the policy layer that proposes discriminative policy modes for the updaters (E3, training loop) to refine. Tests the logical-necessity claim of MECH-309 within the existing V3 substrate without registering the heavier CandidateRule machinery (ARC-063, V4-deferred). Architectural slot, not yet implemented.

bottom_up_behavioral_pattern_extraction_pathway (hippocampal_CLS_bi_pathway + dorsolateral_striatum_chunking + OFC_cognitive_map analog). Architectural commitment: rule discovery from observed-behaviour clustering is logically and architecturally distinct from rule application from instructed/external context (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension). source_claims.title: Is the E3 committed-action conversion ceiling CONSTITUTIONAL (the rules by which candidate actions become eligible to win -- eligibility mask, Go/No-Go pressures, conflict-sensitive hold, threshold/widening, recurrent competition, commitment permission, post-commit latch -- are under-specified) rather than PARAMETRIC (upstream signals too weak / modulatory channels too quiet)? Across mechanistically distinct channels (CRF V3-EXQ-654g, OFC V3-EXQ-485h, SD-037 V3-EXQ-625e, dACC V3-EXQ-445h, modulatory V3-EXQ-569g) a formed-and-measurable signal reaches E3 authority yet committed action does not change reliably -- 'signal strength can exist without lawful access to committed action.' The basal-ganglia action-selection bottleneck (direct/Go, indirect/No-Go, hyperdirect-STN conflict-hold, striatal channel competition, pallidal permission-to-commit) is the functional reference; the open question is whether a BG-like selection CONSTITUTION is required BEYOND MECH-439's F-variance-share rebalance / shortlist levers.

priority_weighted_replay_write_selection (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze + hippocampal prioritized-replay analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-319's simulation-mode rule-write gate. MECH-319 is a BINARY categorical gate: during a ghost/replay/DMN pass it either blocks arbitration-weight writes (normal) or admits them (the V3-EXQ-543c/628 falsifier flag) -- all-or-nothing, no ordering among the replayed transitions it admits. MECH-443 asserts that WHEN the replay write channel is open, the transitions admitted to update the rule-arbitration layer should not be written uniformly but in GRADED priority order, weighted by an update-utility signal (a surprise / value-prediction-error / coverage proxy), so a high-utility replayed transition writes more strongly and a low-utility one writes weakly or not at all. The external analog is EfficientZero/MuZero prioritized experience replay (priority ~ value-prediction error); the biology is hippocampal SWR replay, which is demonstrably prioritized rather than uniform. CRITICAL REFINEMENT FROM BIOLOGY: the priority is the value of the UPDATE (Mattar & Daw gain x need), NOT raw reward magnitude or current action-value -- Carey et al. 2019 shows replay can be biased AWAY from the currently-most-valuable outcome. MECH-443 is the WHICH/HOW-STRONGLY complement to MECH-319's WHETHER gate; it does not change the binary gate, it grades the admitted writes.

Committed-action diversity survives the selection/commit step via a behavioral-descriptor eligible-set ARCHIVE (Quality-Diversity / MAP-Elites analog): the committed E3 selection should draw from a structure that, UPSTREAM of the winner-take-all commit, partitions the eligible candidate set by a behavioral descriptor (first-action / committed-action class / e2.world_forward strategy signature, NOT F-rank) and retains the F-best candidate WITHIN each behavioral niche, then commits by a coverage-aware rule -- so a behaviorally-distinct action stays selectable at a moderate primary-score (F) gap, bounded by the per-niche-elite safety envelope, rather than collapsing to F's single global optimum. The validated V3-EXQ-569i top-k shortlist is the descriptor-free degenerate instance (eligible-set axis = F-rank, near-ties only); MAP-Elites generalizes it to a behavioral-descriptor-indexed eligible-set archive paired with an active variability generator (MECH-313), predicted to convert per-candidate diversity into committed-action diversity more robustly than the thin near-tie shortlist. The F-dominated committed argmax itself (MECH-439) is biologically faithful and is NOT changed -- only the eligible-set structure feeding it.

F-dominance bounds committed-action diversity: the primary harm/goal score (F) monopolises ~88-89% of E3 committed-selection variance (V3-EXQ-571: 0.886 baseline, 0.894 with the full diversity stack -- the stack does not dent F's share), so modulatory, within-class, and rule-bias diversity channels cannot convert to committed-action diversity while F dominates -- they act only at near-ties. top_internal_sources.title: Basal-ganglia-like E3 selector constitution: committed-action selection should be governed by an explicit BG-mirroring eligibility-gating CONSTITUTION -- candidate actions pass through an eligibility mask, bounded Go (direct-pathway promotion) and No-Go (indirect-pathway suppression) pressures, a conflict-sensitive hold / threshold-raise / candidate-set widening (hyperdirect-STN), striatal-like parallel channel competition (rather than one scalar monarch), a pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate (rather than bare argmax), and a stable post-commit latch / de-commit -- so that an upstream signal's STRENGTH is necessary but not sufficient: it also needs LAWFUL ACCESS to committed action. The translation target is functional (a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated BG analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

Minimal recurrent settling step over the eligible set: replace the one-shot feed-forward argmin/softmax committed-selection readout with a few rounds of mutual-inhibition (surround-inhibition) updates on the within-eligible _modulatory_accum field BEFORE commit, so the committed action emerges from a bounded recurrent SETTLING competition rather than a single global comparison. A hard argmin over an F-dominated score always returns the F-winner (the conversion ceiling); a settling competition with lateral inhibition can FLIP the selected attractor when a modulatory channel is strong enough, and turns the additive _modulatory_accum BLEND into a competitive winner-take-most. The V3-bounded version of the BG's recurrent settling dynamics; the full learned thalamo-cortico-basal loop is the V4 bet.

Unified dopamine substrate -- signed dopaminergic-RPE teaching signal feeding LEARNED gating weights on the E3 selector: the cortico-striatal weights that decide which channel wins committed-selection authority should themselves be LEARNED via three-factor plasticity (Hebbian co-activation x signed dopaminergic RPE) with the D1-LTP / D2-LTD asymmetry, consolidating the currently-scattered RPE / vigor / incentive functions into one substrate and supplying the GPi->lateral-habenula negative-RPE drain. The ARC-107 arbitration layer (MECH-447/448/449 + the authority rescale) is today pure arithmetic with NO learned parameters; F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance (MECH-439) precisely because no learned striatal weighting can re-weight channels through experience. The single highest-leverage missing BG piece and the proposed next attack on MECH-439.

D1/D2 striatal population split with asymmetric dopamine gain: the Go (direct/D1) and No-Go (indirect/D2) pathways should be represented as TWO populations with OPPOSITE dopamine sensitivity (DA potentiates D1/Go via LTP, depresses D2/No-Go via LTD), NOT collapsed into one additive scoring scalar. REE today renders Go/No-Go as a scoring SIGN (benefit_eval_head minus harm_eval_head; MECH-449 Go-promote / No-Go-suppress over the eligible set) -- dissociable pathways pre-summed into one cost. The split is REQUIRED to EARN the Parkinson / dyskinesia / Huntington / impulse-control-disorder psychiatric axis per the ARC-106 EARNS criterion.

Residual conversion ceiling requiring rank-preserving F->eligibility demotion: near-tie levers (conflict-graded shortlist / commit-T, MECH-447) CAP committed-action-class entropy BELOW the proposer ceiling because they act only at near-ties while F still decides every non-tie; only REMOVING F from the final committed argmin -- demoting it to a graded ELIGIBILITY envelope (rank-preserving renormalisation against the competing field; divisive-normalisation analog) so a modulatory/diversity channel arbitrates within the F-eligible set -- lifts committed diversity to the proposer ceiling without disinhibiting harmful classes.

Go/No-Go eligibility constitution for committed-action conversion: committed-action diversity is recovered not by any single louder channel but by an explicit eligibility CONSTITUTION -- bounded Go pressure (promote a channel when evidence/value/drive/rule/safety make it eligible) AND bounded No-Go pressure (suppress unsafe / stale / perseverative / irrelevant / low-viability channels) governing which candidates may compete for the pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate -- so that lawful, channel-specific access (not scalar dominance) decides the committed action. The full Go/No-Go eligibility-set governance is what converts when the minimal near-tie lever (MECH-447) does not and isolated F->eligibility demotion (MECH-448) is insufficient alone.

Parallel segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops (motor / cognitive-set / motivational): committed-action selection should run through SEPARATE striatal loop channels -- a motor loop, an associative/cognitive-set loop, and a limbic/motivational loop -- each owning its own eligibility-and-gate, arbitrated AFTER within-loop competition, rather than collapsing all channels into ONE shared E3 selection arena where the dACC/lPFC/OFC analogs feed in only as additive biases. HYPOTHESIS (assembly-map A.2 / s.D): the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is partly an ARTEFACT of the single-arena collapse -- F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance because every channel competes in one F-dominated arena; with segregated loops F could dominate only the motor loop and could not drown the limbic 'is this worth committing to' computation, which is a different loop with a different value. Translation target is FUNCTIONAL (the Alexander/DeLong/Strick parallel-loop organisation as a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

Conflict-graded near-tie lever sufficiency: a hyperdirect-STN-like conflict-graded shortlist / commit-temperature lever (k = f(top-F gap); T = f(top-F gap)) is SUFFICIENT to lift committed-action-class entropy strict-above both collapsed-proposer and gap-blind controls -- gap-CONCENTRATED (the lift correlates with per-tick top-F gap) -- WITHOUT reducing F's E3 variance share. I.e. F can keep monopolising selection variance and conversion is still recovered by widening/hotting only at near-ties.

source_claims.title: Cholinergic TAN-pause plasticity-window gating of selector credit: dopamine should NOT continuously update every recently-active selector component; a striatal cholinergic tonically-active-neuron (TAN) pause should open a NARROW plasticity window around behaviourally-relevant events, so the three-factor learned-gating updates (ARC-108) are admitted only WITHIN the window. Without a window, continuous credit smears across irrelevant recently-active components and degrades the learned gating the conversion attack depends on. The OPENING-side neuromodulatory complement to REE's existing CLOSURE-side plasticity control (MECH-094 waking-gate; INV-074/MECH-333/MECH-334 consolidation/EWC) -- REE today has machinery to stop/consolidate learning but not a phasic gate to OPEN a precise learning window.

Loop-local eligibility traces under a globally-broadcast dopamine signal: even with a SINGLE shared dopaminergic teaching signal (ARC-108 delta_t), the credit traces that decide WHICH synapses/channels the signal updates must remain LOCAL and loop-specific -- effective update = shared delta_t x separate local eligibility trace x loop-specific active synapses -- rather than the current single globally-broadcast credit that updates every recently-active selector component. A too-broad or temporally-smeared eligibility trace would make learned gating appear ineffective (no committed conversion) even when the underlying dopamine learning rule is exactly correct, because the right teaching signal is delivered to the wrong synapses.

top_internal_sources.title: Mode-conditioned write gating: the operating-mode variable from the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) determines which substrates can write to E3, episodic memory, policy updates, and autonomic coupling. Generalises MECH-094 hypothesis tag to a mode-conditioned family of write gates. Operating mode is implemented as a soft probability vector over {external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation}, not a one-hot categorical.

Lateral-PFC-analog (mid-lateral rule/goal substrate): module that holds stimulus-abstracted rule and goal representations across delays, persists through simulated distractors, and projects bias signals into E3 action selection. Primary write target for MECH-261 under external_task and internal_planning modes.

Rule-selective persistence in lateral-PFC-analog: stimulus-abstracted rule representations in SD-033a persist across simulated time steps without external drive, remain selective through distractor events, and emerge through training rather than being innate.

Salience-network coordinator: network-level module reading AIC-, dACC-, MCC-, PCC-analog subdivisions and outputting a discrete operating-mode variable (external_task / internal_replay / internal_planning / offline_consolidation) plus a mode-switch trigger.

PFC subdivision architecture: a network-level module with lateral-PFC-analog (mid-lateral rule/goal), OFC-analog (specific-outcome prediction and task-structure map), vmPFC-analog (value integration), premotor/SMA-analog (sequence execution), and frontopolar-analog (branching / nested control; V4 scope) subdivisions. Primary output: the rule/policy context that gates action selection and the natural write target for MECH-261 mode-conditioned gating.

OFC-analog (specific-outcome prediction and task-structure cognitive map): module that represents the state space of the current task and the specific outcomes expected from actions in each state. Durable long-term storage of the hippocampal viability map requires a hippocampal-entorhinal loop that engages during offline (sleep/DMN-equivalent) consolidation and provides a coordinate-invariant grid representation; this loop does not operate during waking planning or waking immobility consolidation.

Any agent that builds a model of the world, acts in that world, and learns from experience cannot safely update its world model while using it to navigate the world; it therefore requires periodic offline phases in which action is suspended and the model is reorganised via replay and simulation -- this is not a biological contingency but a general computational necessity for model-building agents.

Biology-grounding as a standing construction constraint: build REE the agent so each functional component maps to an identified neural substrate at the level of FUNCTION (not homology), with biology as the reference of first resort for underdetermined design forks. Grounding must be load-bearing (a named neural primitive whose defining constraint is validated on a REE falsifier), not decorative naming; divergences from biology are legitimate but must be explicit and tracked, never silent.

Can spintronic-memristive media (or any candidate physical cognifold substrate) scale to embodied REE cognition WITHOUT losing auditability, stability, or the harm/safety boundaries that REE's software cognifold currently enforces -- and which cognifold primitives (ARC-089) does each candidate substrate genuinely instantiate versus merely approximate?

Is an EXPLICIT event-level write-eligible state (MECH-368) actually needed, or is the existing combination -- MECH-261 mode-conditioned channel gating + MECH-094 provenance gating + MECH-285 consolidation-priority by V_s residual -- already sufficient to prevent undifferentiated global model updates? This is the falsifier for MECH-368: if a substrate that gates only the channel (mode) and prioritises only at consolidation still avoids catastrophic interference on the online world-model/policy path, MECH-368 earns no keep.

Two-factor (tag-and-capture) write-eligibility: MECH-368's plasticity_eligibility is not a single instantaneous test but a TWO-STAGE process -- a local event sets a transient, input-specific eligibility TAG, and a durable model/policy write is consummated only if that tag CAPTURES a separately-gated plasticity/consolidation-resource signal within a time window. A tagged-eligible event can still fail to write if no capture signal arrives, and an arriving capture signal can rescue a recently-tagged weak event.

Schema-congruence as a consolidation write-weight and routing variable: the degree of fit between an event and the agent's existing schemas modulates how that event is consolidated -- schema-congruent content is consolidated preferentially and routed more directly into the durable/semantic store (a fast vmPFC-gated systems-consolidation route), while schema-incongruent content requires prolonged hippocampal-dependent consolidation or is gated out. Schema-fit is a WRITE-WEIGHT input to consolidation alongside affect (MECH-361), not only a retrieval-time prior.

Retrieval-time accessibility gating: which stored traces become reinstatable at a given moment is set by two composable READ-side policy layers, not by storage alone. Line A -- a global, slowly-fluctuating, arousal-coupled reinstatement GAIN (content-blind; sets the threshold on whether ANY stored trace crosses into accessibility; stochastic-resonance flavour). Line B -- a content-selective competitive SUPPRESSION that, given what the global gate admits, inhibits specific competitors to keep retrieval clean. The READ-side sibling of MECH-261's mode-conditioned WRITE-gate family: REE owns the gates but not this retrieval-time gating POLICY.

Contextual memory-allocation gate policy: a control-plane decision stage (context_similarity x temporal_distance interaction, schema_fit, salience, PE, uncertainty, goal_relevance) selecting integrate / partial_overlap / separate over the hippocampal graph.

Labels as active top-down perceptual-control signals: a self-directed label ('food-gradient', 'danger-gradient', 'novelty-gradient', 'blocked-goal', 'return-to-baseline') is not merely a post-perceptual report but a top-down tuning signal that biases perceptual search and detection -- a perceptual-control intervention, not a description.

Event-level write-authority gate: an explicit per-event transition from observed/represented to write-eligible over the DURABLE MODEL-UPDATE path (E1/E2 world-model and policy weights, not only episodic memory), conditioned on f(prediction_error, salience, pathway_state, residue_status, goal_relevance, plasticity_eligibility). The gate decides which individual events within an already-open write channel are licensed to durably deform the model; an event may be salient, real-provenance, and in a write-permitted mode yet still fail the gate. Without it, every prediction error in an open channel writes -- the undifferentiated-global-update / catastrophic-interference failure mode.

top_internal_sources.title: Sleep-phase full-Bayesian aggregation is a general mechanism across attribution domains: given a waking-phase feedstock of counterfactual-backed attributions (produced by MECH-276), sleep phases aggregate across many episodes, correcting for delayed consequences, failed counterfactuals, and systematic attribution biases that single-episode attribution cannot catch. MECH-273 (self-model aggregation) and MECH-274 (other-model aggregation, V4) are specialisations. Object-schema revision is a further specialisation. INV-049 (offline phases mathematically necessary for model-building agents) is operationalised here: what sleep is mathematically necessary FOR is this cross-episode Bayesian aggregation of counterfactual-backed attribution.

Sleep-consolidation priority from V_s residuals: during sleep-phase Bayesian aggregation (MECH-275) and sleep-dependent self-model aggregation (MECH-273), the order and weight of replay events is biased by the schema-staleness map produced by MECH-284. Replay is not uniform across schema and is not solely salience-driven (dopaminergic tagging); it is also prioritised by accumulated verisimilitude residuals. Schema regions with the most accumulated 'this is wrong' evidence get replayed first, more often, and with higher schema-update authority during sleep. PTSD-rumination has a clean architectural account here: MECH-285 priority loss co-occurring with MECH-094 hypothesis-tag dysfunction, locking the staleness tag from ever clearing.

REE developmental training proceeds in three ordered stages: (1) self-as-object — action-space discovery via motor experimentation, producing the substrate SD-003 requires; (2) objects-as-patterns — object-schema formation via experimental action on the world; (3) others-as-special-objects — modelling other agents as objects with their own policies. The ordering is load-bearing: without a self-model the agent cannot distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change; without object-schemas the agent cannot recognise other-agents as a distinguished subclass of objects. Refines the generic ARC-019 curriculum-gates claim.

The self-model has a waking half and a sleep half. The waking half is SD-003 (single-episode counterfactual self-attribution via E2). The sleep half is full-Bayesian aggregation of single-episode SD-003 outputs across many episodes, routed by the anchored channel to E1 and SD-033a, correcting for delayed consequences, failed counterfactuals, and systematic attribution biases. Without the sleep half, REE has an episode-local causal signature but not a durable self-model.

The scientist-agent principle: the waking-phase mechanism that feeds MECH-275 is deliberate intervention. The agent generates hypotheses (proposer-side, via MECH-269 probe channel), selects actions that will produce informative contrast under those hypotheses, executes the actions, observes the outcomes, and computes counterfactual-backed attribution. Correlational observation is insufficient -- the agent must behave like a scientist, performing experiments whose outcomes produce structured attribution signals. Applies across all three developmental stages; specialised by MECH-277 (action-space discovery), MECH-278 (object-schema formation), and a V4 social-intervention mechanism (parallel to MECH-278 for other-agents).

MECH-271 routing is state-gated. In waking, the anchor channel dominates the hippocampal fan-out: replay preferentially reaches consolidation and viability-map consumers to support decision-making. In sleep, the probe channel dominates: replay preferentially seeds Bayesian schema restructuring -- testing which action-outcome attributions held up across episodes, creating new buckets for non-fitting experiences, revising causal graphs. The informational needs of sleep (schema revision) and waking (decision support) are distinct, and the routing bias reflects that.

V4-reserved. The sleep-dependent aggregation pattern of MECH-273 extends to other-attribution. Fast empathy (ARC-010) produces single-episode attributions of other-agent action-outcome links; a stable model of other minds requires full-Bayesian aggregation of those attributions during sleep, architecturally parallel to MECH-273 but operating on other-agent rather than self attributions.

Stage-2 specialisation of MECH-276: once the agent can distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change (stage 1 complete via MECH-277), it forms object-schemas via experimental action on the world. An object is the stable bundle of features that behave causally together under interventional perturbation -- push here, these features move together; occlude this, that cluster disappears. Object-schema formation is the stage-2 specialisation of the scientist-agent principle, with world-features as the target of intervention. V3's z_world (SD-005) is currently engineered pre-split; this is an architectural shortcut past stage 2.

V_s residual schema-staleness accumulator: a region-indexed scalar that integrates broadcast invalidation events (MECH-287) with attribution_weight credit assignment over the active anchor set, leaks slowly, and is read by both online anchor-reset (MECH-269 hysteresis check, waking) and sleep-consolidation priority (MECH-285, offline). Distinct from generic prediction error (which operates on latent values and updates online via gradient): MECH-284 is region-indexed, accumulates across events, and exposes a dual read-out (online + offline). Refined 2026-04-22 from sleep-only formulation to dual-readout formulation after V3-EXQ-475 demonstrated that an agent trapped in a stale anchor needs an online consumer of the staleness signal -- MECH-285 sleep-only readout cannot rescue the agent during waking. Saturated map produces over-attention to schema revision (anxiety-analog); absent map produces schema rigidity (V3-EXQ-475 phenotype: 5-6 PAG releases per seed but never integrate to anchor invalidation -> 1000/1000 freeze-active steps).

MECH-094's hypothesis tag is realized as differential downstream routing of hippocampal replay, not as a source-side boolean. Anchored replay (trusted starting state, MECH-269) preferentially reaches subiculum -> entorhinal deep layers -> neocortex (E1 consolidation) and lateral PFC (SD-033a viability map); probe replay (low-verisimilitude seed, strengthened tag) preferentially reaches BLA (affective tagging without consolidation) and NAc (curiosity / novelty scaffolding). Tag loss presents as probe content reaching consolidation destinations it should not reach -- an auditable confabulatory-planning signature distinct from psychosis or hallucination.

source_claims.title: REE instantiates a global-workspace-like access channel: a capacity-limited selection-for-broadcast bottleneck (SD-027 boundary gate + MECH-089 theta-gamma packaging + E3 broadcast, riding the MECH-287 / SD-037 broadcast machinery) whose contents are reportable and causally load-bearing for integrative, multi-step cognition while automatic/reactive behaviour bypasses it. The SD-027 'does NOT commit to a single global workspace' disclaimer conflates Global Workspace Theory with unitary intra-E3 selection: MECH-007 (attention fragmentation) forbids the latter but is COMPATIBLE with the former, because GWT's specialized parallel processors are fragmented by construction -- fragmentation is the backstage of the theatre, not its negation.

Entity binding is continuously re-evaluated, not fixed: an established self-anchor <-> world-configuration binding is re-bound to a competing configuration when that competitor overtakes the currently-bound one under perturbation of the shared anchor. Rebinding is the ENTITY-LAYER analogue of MECH-269(b) anchor-reset -- it operates over self<->world-config bindings rather than proposer stream-anchors. The rebinding trigger is prediction-error / competitor-overtake driven (object-file updating; serial-dependence hysteresis; PE-driven perceptual switching), NOT a coherence-specific selection factor C(tau) (that coherence-SPECIFICITY question is settled NO-CLAIM by V3-EXQ-725a and is explicitly excluded from this claim).

Constructive rule-key separability: minted CandidateRule context keys should be assigned in a quantised / categorical codebook that is separable by construction (a DreamerV3-style discrete latent codebook), bounding the number of rules that co-match any context (n_matched) up front so theta(n_matched) stays below the availability ceiling -- rather than letting overlapping continuous context tags produce unbounded co-match counts that the conflict gate then locks out. The codebook capacity must be large enough to keep genuinely-distinct rules on distinct keys (no key-collapse).

Rule-pool distinguishability is a MAINTAINED property, not a minting byproduct: keeping the CandidateRuleField pool mutually distinguishable (so co-matching rules remain jointly selectable through the conflict gate) requires a periodic, non-gradient consolidation/refactor operator over the minted pool -- compress and merge near-duplicate rules, retire rules that never reach selection, and re-separate the survivors under a description-length / separability objective -- rather than a reactive affine gate theta(n_matched). The maintained invariant is that mean n_matched stays low enough that theta(n_matched) sits below the availability ceiling.

Why might other-bound suffering/threat need to come online before other-bound liking/wanting? Is it protection-first (register harm to others before benefit) versus exploitation-vulnerability (early positive other-reward is gameable), and how should the ordering be enforced?

Is an EXPLICIT event-level write-eligible state (MECH-368) actually needed, or is the existing combination -- MECH-261 mode-conditioned channel gating + MECH-094 provenance gating + MECH-285 consolidation-priority by V_s residual -- already sufficient to prevent undifferentiated global model updates? This is the falsifier for MECH-368: if a substrate that gates only the channel (mode) and prioritises only at consolidation still avoids catastrophic interference on the online world-model/policy path, MECH-368 earns no keep.

Two-factor (tag-and-capture) write-eligibility: MECH-368's plasticity_eligibility is not a single instantaneous test but a TWO-STAGE process -- a local event sets a transient, input-specific eligibility TAG, and a durable model/policy write is consummated only if that tag CAPTURES a separately-gated plasticity/consolidation-resource signal within a time window. A tagged-eligible event can still fail to write if no capture signal arrives, and an arriving capture signal can rescue a recently-tagged weak event.

Schema-congruence as a consolidation write-weight and routing variable: the degree of fit between an event and the agent's existing schemas modulates how that event is consolidated -- schema-congruent content is consolidated preferentially and routed more directly into the durable/semantic store (a fast vmPFC-gated systems-consolidation route), while schema-incongruent content requires prolonged hippocampal-dependent consolidation or is gated out. Schema-fit is a WRITE-WEIGHT input to consolidation alongside affect (MECH-361), not only a retrieval-time prior.

Retrieval-time accessibility gating: which stored traces become reinstatable at a given moment is set by two composable READ-side policy layers, not by storage alone. Line A -- a global, slowly-fluctuating, arousal-coupled reinstatement GAIN (content-blind; sets the threshold on whether ANY stored trace crosses into accessibility; stochastic-resonance flavour). Line B -- a content-selective competitive SUPPRESSION that, given what the global gate admits, inhibits specific competitors to keep retrieval clean. The READ-side sibling of MECH-261's mode-conditioned WRITE-gate family: REE owns the gates but not this retrieval-time gating POLICY.

Grammatical aspect is a map of REE's event arc and post-commit closure: starting/ongoing/repeated/interrupted/resumed/completed/failed/abandoned aspect is a grammatical naming of the pre-linguistic ActionEventArc and closure machinery, not a replacement for it. Event Segmentation Theory: experience segments around prediction error and event boundaries, overlapping REE's contact/interruption/closure/transition needs.

Predicate-argument-event rule bridge: a V6 grammar-facing layer renders ARC-063 CandidateRule structures as 'if context, then action-object, causing outcome, unless exception' -- naming, querying, and recombining pre-linguistic rules without making language the rule substrate. Predicate-argument-event structure is the same context->action-object->outcome shape ARC-063 already mints; the 'unless/except/but' exception grammar is a shadow of ARC-063 tolerance-gated availability.

Developmental ordering of other-bound streams: other-bound suffering/threat (protective) come online BEFORE other-bound liking/wanting (appetitive), because early positive other-reward is destabilising and exploitable -- a safety-relevant maturational ordering on the ARC-059 social spine.

Consolidation gated-write-authority: over-frequent rewriting of consolidated memory is a failure mode; the consolidation operator's authority to overwrite is gated by schema-stability / schedule-sensitivity, not run after every interaction.

Consolidation provenance + contradiction-flag + rollback: every consolidated summary carries transformation_history + contradiction_flags; a summary conflicting with its source is flagged not silently authoritative; retired schemas leave source episodes intact.

Language bootstraps from a grounded social ecology, not from grammar: given shared attention, partial observability, coordination pressure, a low-cost channel, and repair, proto-language partially bootstraps from grounded proto-communication. The grammar/LLM scaffold is a turbocharger, never the engine -- the engine is the V5 social ecology.

Language-bootstrap enabling-condition contract: language only bootstraps when a specific pre-linguistic inventory is jointly satisfied -- shared world model, object tokens, action affordances, self-attribution, other-attribution, joint attention, partial observability, coordination pressure, episodic memory, rule apprehension, a low-cost signalling channel, partner variation, and repair. Sharpens MECH-010's abstract five-step sequence into a machine-checkable V6-entry precondition contract over landed V4/V5 nodes.

Self-as-object (PILLAR 2 of ARC-080): z_self becomes a privileged token-keyed object-file SLOT in the generalised object-file layer. The SELF BEGINS IN V3 -- z_self self/world split (SD-005), self-attribution (SD-003), action-space discovery / self-as-object stage 1 (MECH-277, ARC-059 stage 1), reward-free babbling Phase 0 (ARC-074). The object-file CUTOVER IS V4 -- z_self promoted from a body-state latent to a privileged self-OBJECT slot, gated by the DR-10..DR-14 self-model integration audit, MECH-214 (goal E1-representability), MECH-215 (self-model prerequisite for agentive prediction), INV-064 (maturational-sequence necessity), and SD-030 (E2 self-forward-model, V4-deferred). The beginning of self is V3; the object-file-slot cutover is V4.

top_internal_sources.title: Cue-specific conditioned safety prediction: a discrete predictive structure encodes 'this stimulus actively predicts that suffering will be omitted', updated by explicit MECH-302 relief-completion events as its teaching signal. Encoding substrate is cortico-striatal (dorsal striatum + dlPFC). Expression/output pathway is IL-to-CeA. This is the conditioned-inhibition mechanism: when a specific cue co-occurs with relief, a separate learned prediction forms that can gate avoidance commitment release when the cue is later present. Sister claim to MECH-303 (contextual passive safety representation).

Relief-completion event reuses goal-achievement / reward-circuit completion machinery. When a comparator on a suffering-stream derivative crosses a downward threshold (sustained suffering-reduction below baseline), the resulting event fires the same downstream tag-and-release pipeline as goal-achievement: MECH-057a (commitment-release / beta-gate-drop), MECH-091 (salient-event phase-reset), and MECH-094 (categorical hypothesis-tag write gate). The polarity of the reinforcement is set at the input -- what counts as the completion is the suffering-derivative crossing, not a reward-onset event -- but the consolidation pipeline is shared. 'Things that just reduced suffering' are tagged in the same approach-attractor structure as 'things liked'.

Context-bound passive safety representation: the agent encodes 'this environment predicts absence of suffering' through sustained non-occurrence of harm, without requiring a discrete teaching event. Substrate is prefrontal-hippocampal (IL for expression gating; vHipp-to-PL-equivalent for contextual store). Update rule is diffuse and slow -- accumulated context exposure without harm drives the store. Output lowers background vigilance threshold: reduces the general avoidance commitment level when the agent is in an environment the store predicts as safe. Parallel to the 'things liked' goal-cue store but tracking suffering-absence rather than reward-presence. Sister claim to MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition pathway).

source_claims.title: Dedicated safety-terrain RBF bandwidth: an opt-in, tighter bandwidth for the MECH-303 contextual-safety-terrain RBF read, separate from the shared kernel_bandwidth (1.0). The shared bandwidth is ~15x too wide for the z_world residual scale (~0.065 between safe/unsafe contexts under SD-008 under-differentiation), so evaluate_safety SATURATES (reads ~identically in every context) and the fixed contextual_safety_release_threshold cannot resolve the safe-vs-unsafe signal into an absolute gap -- the discrimination exists as a rank (AUC ~0.83, V3-EXQ-760) but the behavioural release fires indiscriminately. The tighter bandwidth resolves it into an absolute gap the release gate can use. The Euclidean-RBF sibling of SD-066 (same SD-008 root cause); centering is a no-op here because Euclidean distance is translation-invariant, so bandwidth is the correct lever. A read-resolution workaround, NOT a z_world representation fix.

Conditioned-safety cue channel: env-level controllable, observable Pavlovian safety CS added to CausalGridWorld -- an ambient (uniform-when-active) 25-dim field view emitted into world_state (feeds the z_world encoder the SD-051 ConditionedSafetyStore keys on). Can be paired with the MECH-302 relief-completion window during teaching (the store still writes its prototype ONLY on the real event_fired tick -- the pairing is real, not synthesized) and presented CONCURRENTLY with a threat cue at test. Closes the 'no controllable safety cue' substrate gap that forced V3-EXQ-759 to synthesize the Pavlovian pairing off-substrate, making MECH-304's promote-to-active classical-conditioned-inhibition behavioural falsifier runnable. Adds no entity type (NUM_ENTITY_TYPES stays 7); pure environment substrate; no trainable parameters; no MECH-094 interaction at the env level.

Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge: SD-058/MECH-357 supply an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate but its avoidance_efficacy is a GLOBAL SCALAR that only penalises the no-op/freeze class -- compute_action_bias by design 'does NOT compute the escape direction'. V3-EXQ-603h (engaged-but-insufficient, readiness met) showed the consequence: the agent un-freezes but acquires no directed escape (seed-43 scalar efficacy 0.633 -> WORST survival 11.0). Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance needs the LA/BA->NAcc relief/safety action-credit half that positively reinforces a SPECIFIC avoidance response, not only the suppression half. REE owns relief (MECH-302/SD-050) + safety (MECH-303/304/SD-052/SD-051) but they are UNWIRED to avoidance. SD-059 adds the architecture: an affordance-indexed (per-first-action-class) credit table that, when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (relief) or terminates the threat (safety), tags that action as an escape affordance approachable under future threat; MECH-358 is the bridge mechanism.

Trainable prospective safety predictor P_safety(state, cue, action, context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head predicting threat-ABSENCE / response-produced safety / conditioned inhibition, licensing commitment-release, approach to safety affordances, and recovery after threat. Distinct from z_goal (it predicts the ABSENCE of threat, not the PRESENCE of a goal) and from relief (it is a PROSPECTIVE threat-absence prediction, not an aversive-offset event). It is the trainable + contrastive successor that makes the MECH-303 (contextual passive safety) + MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition) substrate learnable, replacing the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA safety table of the MECH-358 safety half: positive target when a cue / context / action predicts threat absence or response-produced safety; negative target when 'safe' cues are followed by threat recurrence; CONTRASTIVE target to stop safety overgeneralising to stable background features that merely co-occurred with relief. Output supports commitment release, permits approach to safety affordances, stabilises recovery, and prevents persistent defensive mode when threat is genuinely absent.
