Trainable relief critic Q_relief(state, action, threat_context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head that predicts expected harm/suffering reduction following an action under threat -- negative-reinforcement credit assignment, distinct from generic reward / wanting. It is the trainable successor to the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA credit table of the MECH-358 relief half, and is downstream of (NOT a duplicate of) the non-trainable MECH-302 / SD-050 relief-completion comparator that merely DETECTS relief on the current state. Q_relief is a function approximator generalising relief-credit across continuous state x action x threat-context, trained on action-contingent drops in z_harm_a: positive target when a directed action under threat is followed by a temporally-close, action-contingent z_harm_a drop not explained by passive environmental drift; negative / extinction target when the expected relief action fails to reduce harm. Feeds E3 as a bounded, threat-gated, extinguishable score-bias toward actions predicted to reduce harm -- never global reward, never fires when safe, never credits no-op / freeze unless explicitly modelling passive safety. MECH-094-safe: simulated relief in hypothesis mode must not train the waking critic unless authorised as play / training.

Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge mechanism (instantiates SD-059): a pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/escape_affordance_bridge.py, sibling to the SD-058/MECH-357 gate) extending the MECH-357 scalar avoidance_efficacy into a per-first-action-class credit table. RELIEF half: a directed action under threat that drops z_harm_a (delta = prev - now > floor) credits relief_affordance[class] (EMA toward 1; MECH-302-consistent). SAFETY half: a directed action after which threat is absent (threat_scale <= 0) credits safety_affordance[class] (MECH-303/304-consistent response-produced safety). Approach bonus: under future threat, a per-candidate NEGATIVE (favoured) E3 score-bias toward credited classes = -clamp(approach_gain * threat_scale * combined_affordance[class], 0, bias_scale); the no-op/freeze class never gets a bonus. Three guards: bias_scale clamp, threat-context gate (zero when safe), per-tick leak.

Emotion-as-anti-collapse architecture: emotion-like systems are a set of GATED, PARTIALLY INDEPENDENT evaluators (is-this-harmful / is-this-safe / did-this-reduce-suffering / am-I-pursuing-something-I-want / did-I-merely-like-the-last-thing / am-I-stuck / am-I-overcommitted / is-this-goal-stale / should-I-explore / should-I-stop / should-I-sleep-and-consolidate / should-I-release-the-policy) whose collective effect is to prevent behaviour from collapsing onto the currently dominant gradient. Affect is therefore the architectural SOURCE of structured behavioural diversity -- not decoration on a rational optimiser and not random exploration noise, but native modulatory control (gates, biases, interrupts, salience shifts, persistence regulators, release conditions, credit-assignment signals) that produces STRUCTURED deviations from naive optimisation. A unifying MAP over REE's already-owned affect machinery, not a new substrate; an optimise-then-bolt-on-safety design fails because these evaluators must be native, not added afterward.

Endogenous parasympathetic recovery / autonomic rebound: an active, offset-triggered, transient acceleration of return-to-baseline for the affective/autonomic stress state, fired by the agent's OWN stressor offset (the z_harm_a derivative going negative -- the MECH-302 SufferingDerivativeComparator signal) with NO conspecific and NO prediction. Shares the effector/update rule of MECH-355 soothing (decay-acceleration on the recovery side: a transient state-scaled multiplier on the MECH-219 z_harm_a recovery_rate + the SD-032e drive_bias leak) but differs by TRIGGER (endogenous offset vs conspecific). The V3-tractable sibling of MECH-355 that closes REE's sympathetic-rich / parasympathetic-poor asymmetry (dense escalation: MECH-219 onset, SD-032e accumulation, SD-037 override, MECH-091 urgency, MECH-279 freeze; thin recovery: only passive recovery_rate + offline-only drive_bias decay). Distinct from passive MECH-219 recovery (active overshoot, not decay), from MECH-302 relief (shared offset trigger, different output -- relief writes a reinforcer, rebound boosts recovery rate), from MECH-303/304 safety (no prediction), and from MECH-355 soothing (endogenous trigger, not social).

Language prediction as a corrective / instantiating predictive stream: when language is modelled as an externalisation of internal cognition, predicting language inside the integrated substrate can INSTANTIATE cognitive structures not gained sensorimotorically, and can CORRECT or DEGRADE existing structures as a function of the language's quality. The bidirectional clause (good language repairs structure; bad language corrupts it) is the discriminating edge over language-as-scaffold.

Event-arc grammatical realisation: grammatical tense/aspect/connectives (because, but, unless, done, again, stop, resume) are the symbolic rendering of the pre-linguistic ActionEventArc (initiate/persist/interrupt/reorient/resume/close). 'unless' = ARC-063 exception gate; 'because' = causal link; 'again/done' = aspect over closure. The action arc must EXIST (V3..V5) before grammar can name it.

Analogy as relational structure-mapping across grounded domains (Gentner): map relational structure from source to target regardless of surface features (spatial containment <-> social inclusion; physical support <-> commitment). The capstone symbolic capacity; first tested as emergent from the compositional + relational stack before any dedicated analogy module is built.

Relational/propositional inference over named relations: transitive inference, role-binding (giver vs receiver), and proposition chaining are realised as theta-sequence traversal (MECH-300) of a SYMBOLIC/type-graph cognitive map whose nodes are named symbols. The V6 realisation of MECH-300's cognitive-map-traversal primitive over a named symbolic map.

Compositional generalisation over named symbols: the agent systematically recombines grounded, named primitives (object/action/property/relation symbols) into novel combinations never directly experienced, via the symbol/grammar layer rather than the substrate. Compositionality is mined from grounded substrate, not imported as transformer attention.

REE frame inventory: a small extensible V5/V6 inventory of scene-frames (feeding, hazard, contact, interruption, help-harm, give-receive, request-response, belief-report, error-correction) where each frame binds to REE substrates, not to words. Frame semantics (Fillmore): a word evokes a whole scene; in REE each frame is a scene-schema over rule structures, the second mining artifact after the grammar->substrate table.

A lightweight LanguageAffectAdaptor parses affect/emotion from user or agent LANGUAGE into the shared world model: a language-interface component that, when literal semantic content is insufficient to recover affect, converts text into PROBABILISTIC affect/emotion hypotheses (treated as uncertain latent-state estimates, NOT categorical emotion truths) and feeds those estimates into REE's wider agent-state and context modelling. It is an input/perception adaptor on the language channel -- distinct from REE's INTERNAL affective representation (Q-007 z_beta dimensions) -- supplying other-agent affect priors to the social/empathy modelling layer.

Uncertainty-propagation invariant: affect recovered from language MUST enter agent-state modelling as a probability distribution (an uncertain other-agent prior), NEVER as a categorical emotion truth, and must remain overridable by the agent's own grounded harm/threat streams. Any path that lets a confident text label override grounded harm sensing violates this invariant.

Language-cannot-override-harm guard (language-input level): symbolic/linguistic input may CONDITION priors, but the harm/ethics substrate retains veto authority over any language-mediated update. There must be NO path by which symbolic/linguistic content overwrites or suppresses a harm signal. Operationalises the universal invariant INV-007 as an explicit guard a design can violate.

Symbolic inference is subordinate to embodied harm sensing (the V6 inference-level instance of INV-007): symbolic, compositional, and analogical INFERENCE cannot override embodied harm sensing or the ethics-coherence authority. Recombination and structure-mapping are exactly the machinery that produces persuasive harmful rationalisations, so they remain subordinate to the harm/ethics authority by construction.

Two distinct abstraction levels, not to be conflated: REE has SUBSTRATE-level abstraction (V4 theta-packaged units / cognitive-map traversal / type-encoder -- computed-over, sub-symbolic) and SYMBOLIC-scale abstraction (V6 recombination over named, grounded primitives). The symbolic level is the consequent reasoning capacity of the language layer and is categorically distinct from the V4 object-reasoning substrate.

Language bootstraps from a grounded social ecology, not from grammar: given shared attention, partial observability, coordination pressure, a low-cost channel, and repair, proto-language partially bootstraps from grounded proto-communication. The grammar/LLM scaffold is a turbocharger, never the engine -- the engine is the V5 social ecology.

Grammar/LLM primitive-mining (not import) commitment: grammatical structure and LLMs are MINED for candidate pre-linguistic primitive cuts, never imported as architecture. A mined cut is grounded only if it changes perception, attention, action, memory, rule-availability, or coordination in the substrate. No imported transformer block; no LLM as authority.

Language-bootstrap enabling-condition contract: language only bootstraps when a specific pre-linguistic inventory is jointly satisfied -- shared world model, object tokens, action affordances, self-attribution, other-attribution, joint attention, partial observability, coordination pressure, episodic memory, rule apprehension, a low-cost signalling channel, partner variation, and repair. Sharpens MECH-010's abstract five-step sequence into a machine-checkable V6-entry precondition contract over landed V4/V5 nodes.

Global-scalar arousal channels are a VARIANCE AMPLIFIER of the already-dominant selection channel, not a source of behavioural differentiation: the three affective routes that modulate commitment globally (D1/D2 dopamine gain, harm-urgency threshold shrinkage, LC-NE/phasic-surprise temperature) apply one scalar uniformly across all K candidates and therefore cannot change an argmax, but DO change whether commitment fires and how sharply -- selecting for whichever channel already carries the most per-candidate score variance. Under F-dominance (MECH-439) this makes affective engagement ENTRENCH F rather than convert diversity, predicting that F's share of committed-selection variance RISES with arousal and FALLS under low urgency.

Foreclosing the SELF's own future reachable-option space carries a decision cost in E3 trajectory scoring, GATED BY FORECAST UNCERTAINTY -- the non-harm, self-directed analog of INV-026 (which scopes foreclosure-of-reachable-state-space as a harm to OTHERS). E3 today scores harm + benefit + goal + residue + the modulatory stack; nothing represents the option-value / reversibility of an action for the agent's OWN reachable futures. REE's irreversibility-awareness is HARM-scoped (residue cannot be erased; No-Go gates; INV-026 foreclosure-of-others); there is no INFORMATION/RESOURCE-scoped analog (don't cheaply foreclose your own options). The claim: an uncertainty-gated reachable-option-preservation cost should change committed action -- preferring the reversible/option-preserving branch MORE when the forecast that justifies foreclosure is UNCERTAIN, and not at all when it is confident (a generalization of DR-12's PE-conditioned E3 confidence from object-rollouts to a foreclosure cost).

Loop-local eligibility traces under a globally-broadcast dopamine signal: even with a SINGLE shared dopaminergic teaching signal (ARC-108 delta_t), the credit traces that decide WHICH synapses/channels the signal updates must remain LOCAL and loop-specific -- effective update = shared delta_t x separate local eligibility trace x loop-specific active synapses -- rather than the current single globally-broadcast credit that updates every recently-active selector component. A too-broad or temporally-smeared eligibility trace would make learned gating appear ineffective (no committed conversion) even when the underlying dopamine learning rule is exactly correct, because the right teaching signal is delivered to the wrong synapses.

Intermediate channel-granularity falsifier -- before the full segregated-loop build (ARC-110), expose the compressed E3 score_bias modulatory channel as SEVERAL separately-learnable finer channels (OFC-devaluation / dACC-conflict / lateral-PFC rule-evidence / vigour / liking) to the learned-gating layer (ARC-108 w_chan), so the learner can discover SEPARATELY that different control functions matter in different states. The current single global w_chan learns one weight over a pre-compressed blend; this tests whether the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is REPRESENTATIONAL COMPRESSION (finer channels convert non-motor influence to committed action) rather than a requirement for full per-loop competition (finer channels do NOT convert, and only ARC-110 segregated loops do). The cheap intermediate rung BETWEEN ARC-108's one global weight vector and ARC-110's full segregated loops -- a V3-tractable falsifier that can pre-empt the V4 loop build.

Minimal recurrent settling step over the eligible set: replace the one-shot feed-forward argmin/softmax committed-selection readout with a few rounds of mutual-inhibition (surround-inhibition) updates on the within-eligible _modulatory_accum field BEFORE commit, so the committed action emerges from a bounded recurrent SETTLING competition rather than a single global comparison. A hard argmin over an F-dominated score always returns the F-winner (the conversion ceiling); a settling competition with lateral inhibition can FLIP the selected attractor when a modulatory channel is strong enough, and turns the additive _modulatory_accum BLEND into a competitive winner-take-most. The V3-bounded version of the BG's recurrent settling dynamics; the full learned thalamo-cortico-basal loop is the V4 bet.

Parallel segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops (motor / cognitive-set / motivational): committed-action selection should run through SEPARATE striatal loop channels -- a motor loop, an associative/cognitive-set loop, and a limbic/motivational loop -- each owning its own eligibility-and-gate, arbitrated AFTER within-loop competition, rather than collapsing all channels into ONE shared E3 selection arena where the dACC/lPFC/OFC analogs feed in only as additive biases. HYPOTHESIS (assembly-map A.2 / s.D): the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is partly an ARTEFACT of the single-arena collapse -- F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance because every channel competes in one F-dominated arena; with segregated loops F could dominate only the motor loop and could not drown the limbic 'is this worth committing to' computation, which is a different loop with a different value. Translation target is FUNCTIONAL (the Alexander/DeLong/Strick parallel-loop organisation as a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

Unified dopamine substrate -- signed dopaminergic-RPE teaching signal feeding LEARNED gating weights on the E3 selector: the cortico-striatal weights that decide which channel wins committed-selection authority should themselves be LEARNED via three-factor plasticity (Hebbian co-activation x signed dopaminergic RPE) with the D1-LTP / D2-LTD asymmetry, consolidating the currently-scattered RPE / vigor / incentive functions into one substrate and supplying the GPi->lateral-habenula negative-RPE drain. The ARC-107 arbitration layer (MECH-447/448/449 + the authority rescale) is today pure arithmetic with NO learned parameters; F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance (MECH-439) precisely because no learned striatal weighting can re-weight channels through experience. The single highest-leverage missing BG piece and the proposed next attack on MECH-439.

Is the E3 committed-action conversion ceiling CONSTITUTIONAL (the rules by which candidate actions become eligible to win -- eligibility mask, Go/No-Go pressures, conflict-sensitive hold, threshold/widening, recurrent competition, commitment permission, post-commit latch -- are under-specified) rather than PARAMETRIC (upstream signals too weak / modulatory channels too quiet)? Across mechanistically distinct channels (CRF V3-EXQ-654g, OFC V3-EXQ-485h, SD-037 V3-EXQ-625e, dACC V3-EXQ-445h, modulatory V3-EXQ-569g) a formed-and-measurable signal reaches E3 authority yet committed action does not change reliably -- 'signal strength can exist without lawful access to committed action.' The basal-ganglia action-selection bottleneck (direct/Go, indirect/No-Go, hyperdirect-STN conflict-hold, striatal channel competition, pallidal permission-to-commit) is the functional reference; the open question is whether a BG-like selection CONSTITUTION is required BEYOND MECH-439's F-variance-share rebalance / shortlist levers.

Go/No-Go eligibility constitution for committed-action conversion: committed-action diversity is recovered not by any single louder channel but by an explicit eligibility CONSTITUTION -- bounded Go pressure (promote a channel when evidence/value/drive/rule/safety make it eligible) AND bounded No-Go pressure (suppress unsafe / stale / perseverative / irrelevant / low-viability channels) governing which candidates may compete for the pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate -- so that lawful, channel-specific access (not scalar dominance) decides the committed action. The full Go/No-Go eligibility-set governance is what converts when the minimal near-tie lever (MECH-447) does not and isolated F->eligibility demotion (MECH-448) is insufficient alone.

Residual conversion ceiling requiring rank-preserving F->eligibility demotion: near-tie levers (conflict-graded shortlist / commit-T, MECH-447) CAP committed-action-class entropy BELOW the proposer ceiling because they act only at near-ties while F still decides every non-tie; only REMOVING F from the final committed argmin -- demoting it to a graded ELIGIBILITY envelope (rank-preserving renormalisation against the competing field; divisive-normalisation analog) so a modulatory/diversity channel arbitrates within the F-eligible set -- lifts committed diversity to the proposer ceiling without disinhibiting harmful classes.

Conflict-graded near-tie lever sufficiency: a hyperdirect-STN-like conflict-graded shortlist / commit-temperature lever (k = f(top-F gap); T = f(top-F gap)) is SUFFICIENT to lift committed-action-class entropy strict-above both collapsed-proposer and gap-blind controls -- gap-CONCENTRATED (the lift correlates with per-tick top-F gap) -- WITHOUT reducing F's E3 variance share. I.e. F can keep monopolising selection variance and conversion is still recovered by widening/hotting only at near-ties.

Committed-action diversity survives the selection/commit step via a behavioral-descriptor eligible-set ARCHIVE (Quality-Diversity / MAP-Elites analog): the committed E3 selection should draw from a structure that, UPSTREAM of the winner-take-all commit, partitions the eligible candidate set by a behavioral descriptor (first-action / committed-action class / e2.world_forward strategy signature, NOT F-rank) and retains the F-best candidate WITHIN each behavioral niche, then commits by a coverage-aware rule -- so a behaviorally-distinct action stays selectable at a moderate primary-score (F) gap, bounded by the per-niche-elite safety envelope, rather than collapsing to F's single global optimum. The validated V3-EXQ-569i top-k shortlist is the descriptor-free degenerate instance (eligible-set axis = F-rank, near-ties only); MAP-Elites generalizes it to a behavioral-descriptor-indexed eligible-set archive paired with an active variability generator (MECH-313), predicted to convert per-candidate diversity into committed-action diversity more robustly than the thin near-tie shortlist. The F-dominated committed argmax itself (MECH-439) is biologically faithful and is NOT changed -- only the eligible-set structure feeding it.

Basal-ganglia-like E3 selector constitution: committed-action selection should be governed by an explicit BG-mirroring eligibility-gating CONSTITUTION -- candidate actions pass through an eligibility mask, bounded Go (direct-pathway promotion) and No-Go (indirect-pathway suppression) pressures, a conflict-sensitive hold / threshold-raise / candidate-set widening (hyperdirect-STN), striatal-like parallel channel competition (rather than one scalar monarch), a pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate (rather than bare argmax), and a stable post-commit latch / de-commit -- so that an upstream signal's STRENGTH is necessary but not sufficient: it also needs LAWFUL ACCESS to committed action. The translation target is functional (a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated BG analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

Biology-grounding as a standing construction constraint: build REE the agent so each functional component maps to an identified neural substrate at the level of FUNCTION (not homology), with biology as the reference of first resort for underdetermined design forks. Grounding must be load-bearing (a named neural primitive whose defining constraint is validated on a REE falsifier), not decorative naming; divergences from biology are legitimate but must be explicit and tracked, never silent.

Committed-action diversity survives the selection/commit step via a behavioral-descriptor eligible-set ARCHIVE (Quality-Diversity / MAP-Elites analog): the committed E3 selection should draw from a structure that, UPSTREAM of the winner-take-all commit, partitions the eligible candidate set by a behavioral descriptor (first-action / committed-action class / e2.world_forward strategy signature, NOT F-rank) and retains the F-best candidate WITHIN each behavioral niche, then commits by a coverage-aware rule -- so a behaviorally-distinct action stays selectable at a moderate primary-score (F) gap, bounded by the per-niche-elite safety envelope, rather than collapsing to F's single global optimum. The validated V3-EXQ-569i top-k shortlist is the descriptor-free degenerate instance (eligible-set axis = F-rank, near-ties only); MAP-Elites generalizes it to a behavioral-descriptor-indexed eligible-set archive paired with an active variability generator (MECH-313), predicted to convert per-candidate diversity into committed-action diversity more robustly than the thin near-tie shortlist. The F-dominated committed argmax itself (MECH-439) is biologically faithful and is NOT changed -- only the eligible-set structure feeding it.

model_disagreement_directed_curiosity (RND / Plan2Explore analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-314's structured_curiosity_bonus: a PER-CANDIDATE, SELF-ANNEALING intrinsic curiosity signal derived from E2 FORWARD-MODEL DISAGREEMENT (an ensemble / dropout-variance proxy over E2 forward predictions) -- high where the forward model is uncertain, collapsing toward zero as a region is learned -- fed into E3 selection so it PROPAGATES per-candidate to the committed action, unlike the broadcast-novelty EMA channel found non-propagating in V3-EXQ-590a / EXQ-141b. The self-annealing-on-learning-progress property is the non-degeneracy guard against a cross-candidate-flat (degenerate) bonus. External analog: RND (Burda et al. 2018) predictor-error novelty; Plan2Explore (Sekar et al. 2020) ensemble model-disagreement. Maps to MECH-314c learning-progress / MECH-314b uncertainty-driven curiosity.

state_conditioned_self_annealing_noise_floor (NoisyNet learned-parametric-weight-noise analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-313's tonic exploration noise floor. MECH-313 is registered as a STATE-INDEPENDENT floor (a post-softmax max-entropy/temperature analog); V3-EXQ-687 found that floor NON-PROPAGATING -- the temperature was invisible to the argmax/committed action (selected_action_entropy=0.0, the r1a_entropy_only_artefact the degeneracy gate caught). MECH-440 asserts the LC-NE tonic floor must instead be injected as LEARNED PER-PARAMETER (factorised-Gaussian) WEIGHT NOISE in the E3 selection pathway, so it (i) PROPAGATES into the committed action (it changes which action is argmax, not just a discarded pre-commit temperature), (ii) is STATE-CONDITIONED by construction (weight noise x state-dependent activations perturbs different states differently, with no hand-set per-state schedule), and (iii) SELF-ANNEALS (a gradient-trained per-parameter sigma falls where the policy is confident and stays up where exploration pays, so the floor does not wash out committed-action diversity uniformly). External analog: NoisyNet (Fortunato et al. 2018).

F-dominance bounds committed-action diversity: the primary harm/goal score (F) monopolises ~88-89% of E3 committed-selection variance (V3-EXQ-571: 0.886 baseline, 0.894 with the full diversity stack -- the stack does not dent F's share), so modulatory, within-class, and rule-bias diversity channels cannot convert to committed-action diversity while F dominates -- they act only at near-ties. The committed-action-diversity conversion ceiling is therefore a SELECTION-VARIANCE problem (primary-vs-modulatory share), not (only) a candidate-pool geometry problem; a shortlist-then-modulate lever circumvents F locally but may cap committed entropy below the proposer ceiling unless F's variance share is itself rebalanced.

Emotion-as-anti-collapse architecture: emotion-like systems are a set of GATED, PARTIALLY INDEPENDENT evaluators (is-this-harmful / is-this-safe / did-this-reduce-suffering / am-I-pursuing-something-I-want / did-I-merely-like-the-last-thing / am-I-stuck / am-I-overcommitted / is-this-goal-stale / should-I-explore / should-I-stop / should-I-sleep-and-consolidate / should-I-release-the-policy) whose collective effect is to prevent behaviour from collapsing onto the currently dominant gradient. Affect is therefore the architectural SOURCE of structured behavioural diversity -- not decoration on a rational optimiser and not random exploration noise, but native modulatory control (gates, biases, interrupts, salience shifts, persistence regulators, release conditions, credit-assignment signals) that produces STRUCTURED deviations from naive optimisation. A unifying MAP over REE's already-owned affect machinery, not a new substrate; an optimise-then-bolt-on-safety design fails because these evaluators must be native, not added afterward.

difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy (controlled proposal-entropy widening under goal blockage). When goal progress stalls -- repeated failure to improve goal progress, high inter-candidate conflict, low E3 score margin, low committed-action diversity, plateau/stuck-state signal -- WITH goal salience preserved, the agent should transiently INCREASE proposal-generation entropy UPSTREAM of action selection (wider hippocampal/world-model rollout candidate set + higher within-class sampling temperature) while preserving goal/harm/constraint scoring and DELAYING commitment until one candidate clears the E3 score-margin / commitment threshold; entropy then NARROWS once a workable candidate is found -> committed action -> entropy decay. Asserted distinction (preserve this): a hard problem must trigger WIDER INTERNAL PROPOSALS -> more candidate diversity -> longer arbitration -> selective committed action (controlled entropy), NOT 'hard problem -> random behaviour' (noise). WORKING HYPOTHESIS -- no experimental evidence yet; not an established mechanism.

Does sleep consolidation (SD-017 SWS phase) preserve the trajectory- class diversity achieved by ARC-065 during waking, or does Hebbian winner- take-all dynamics during replay erode it? Is sleep a net positive or net negative for learned behavioural diversity? (Was proposed 2026-05-15 as Q-047 in behavioral_diversity_acceptance_criteria.md; never registered; re-registered under next available Q-id.)

What is the minimum trajectory-class diversity floor (Rung 1 first_action_entropy threshold) required for the ARC-062 context discriminator to learn a reliable discriminative cut between reef and foraging contexts? Is the current SP-CEM entropy lift of 0.497 nats sufficient, or is a higher floor required? (Was proposed 2026-05-15 as Q-046 in behavioral_diversity_acceptance_criteria.md; never registered; re-registered under next available Q-id.)

e3_scoring_preserves_trajectory_class_diversity. E3 score aggregation over CEM-supplied candidates must preserve trajectory-class diversity rather than collapse a diverse candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. Without explicit diversity preservation at the scoring step, downstream action selection becomes deterministic regardless of proposal-layer diversity (ARC-065 SP-CEM child), making the whole distributed diversity pathway rate-limited by Layer B. Mechanism options (not yet committed): (1) entropy bonus over candidate first-action classes added to E3 score; (2) class- stratified argmax with within-class proportional sampling; (3) jittered tie-breaking when top-K E3 scores are within epsilon. Final design pending diagnostic data on whether E3 collapse is near-tie or large-gap (see behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan.md Phase P2).

Behavioural diversity is a structural prerequisite for ethical counterfactual evaluation. A system with monomodal policy cannot instantiate the counterfactual evaluation that ethical judgement requires, because the 'could have done otherwise' comparison demands that the agent's candidate trajectory pool contain at least two distinct trajectory classes with distinct harm profiles. The argument is mathematical-by-construction: if P(a|s) is monomodal, the CEM elite pool contains only trajectories beginning with a*, and SD-003's counterfactual E2(z_t, a_cf) for a_cf != a* is never evaluated in the on-policy candidate distribution. (Was proposed 2026-05-15 as INV-074 in behavioral_diversity_acceptance_criteria.md but never registered; the ID was subsequently taken 2026-05-17 by an unrelated plasticity-crystallization invariant. Re-registered under INV-076 with scientific content unchanged.)

Pre-approach orienting/surveying mode: a cue-triggered, need-gated active-sensing control state entered when a cue/need is present but directional/affordance confidence is too low for reliable approach; it samples gradients (turn/scan, exploratory arcs) until a directional vector stabilises, then exits to approach.

Safety-route inference: under threat, REE can infer a likely route to safety from partial map, cue, gradient, and prior-trajectory evidence rather than requiring safety to be directly visible or navigation-handed; generalises the scalar per-action-class escape credit of SD-059/MECH-358 into an inferred route.

Inferred affordance field: REE can infer affordances not directly perceived by combining current cues, hippocampal traces, E2 action-consequence predictions, CandidateRuleField content, affective gradients, and control-plane precision; these inferred affordances bias E3 candidate trajectories without overwriting perception and remain corrigible by action outcome.

Inference / belief-state affordance layer: a named integrative function that constructs latent state hypotheses and inferred affordance fields from partial observation, memory, cue traces, candidate rules, affective gradients, uncertainty, and E2 action-consequence rollouts, so E3 selects trajectories under partial observability without requiring direct perception or oracle-like prior knowledge.

dACC object-discriminative goal readout (L7): the dACC adaptive-control consumer reads per-candidate goal_proximity to the (SD-057 object-bound) z_goal, so its effort/value computation becomes object-discriminative -- approach_commit is goal-conditioned rather than z_goal-blind. Resolves the 2026-06-04 L7 audit finding that only E3 goal_proximity read z_goal consequentially and dACC was blind.

Cue-triggered wanting / cue-recall (L6): a PERCEIVED cue/object type (with no benefit pulse) retrieves its SD-057 incentive token and nudges z_goal toward that object's stored identity embedding BEFORE consumption -- identity-matched (pulls toward the perceived cue's object) and drive-specific (amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive)). The downstream E3 goal_proximity + MECH-295 approach bridge then raise pre-consummatory approach toward the cued object. Distinct from the benefit-driven seed: no benefit pulse, no token revaluation, weaker (cue_recall_gain) pull.

z_goal written from the incentive-token pointer (L4; amends MECH-230): z_goal is seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored identity embedding (argmax over per-object wanting) rather than from the raw last-contacted z_resource. z_goal keeps its role as E1 conditioning vector and E3 goal_proximity target; only the seed SOURCE changes, making the attractor object-bound and the wanting target dissociable from the liking (last-contacted) target.

Per-object incentive-salience token (L3): each resource identity accrues a slowly-decaying, revaluable base incentive value plus a stored identity embedding; wanting amplitude at recall = base_value * (1 + kappa * drive), with the drive multiplier relocated from the seeding gate onto the stored per-object value and computed per-axis so wanting is drive-specific / identity-matched (specific PIT).

Benefit-to-object-identity binding (L2): at resource contact the benefit pulse is bound to the contacted object's identity (the SD-049 per-type tag) via an associative object->benefit node, rather than written as a raw scalar gate against the current world/resource latent. The amygdala/BLA-analog identity-binding node the legacy substrate lacked (cue_features was a V3 no-op stub).

Object identity is a cross-cutting representational primitive. An object is a token-bound identity representation that persists across time and perceptual gaps, generalising z_object/z_resource into an object-file/binding layer (ARC-006), defined by causal feature-coherence under intervention (MECH-278), and consumed by drive/goal (SD-057), hippocampal planning (MECH-262), and the self/other special-object cases. The four planned object capabilities -- (1) permanence, (2) self-as-object, (3) tools/affordances, (4) others-as-object -- are specialisations of one primitive, not four separate mechanisms.

Phasic surprise-burst regulator: a toggleable, event-triggered LC-NE phasic control lever (PhasicSurpriseBurst) that fires a transient softmax-temperature burst on a prediction-error surprise spike and decays it over a few ticks, routed into the E3 select() softmax at agent.select_action() as the PHASIC complement to MECH-313 stochastic_noise_floor (tonic) on the SAME temperature channel -- the substrate that makes MECH-063 sub-claim (ii) (each control axis carries independent tonic baseline AND phasic event-burst degrees of freedom) behaviourally testable without synthetic signals. Reuses the MECH-104 volatility-surprise lit basis (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 phasic mode) but routes to the SELECTION softmax, NOT the ARC-016 commit/de-commit gate that carries the MECH-104 volatility_interrupt claim.

Retrieval-time accessibility gating: which stored traces become reinstatable at a given moment is set by two composable READ-side policy layers, not by storage alone. Line A -- a global, slowly-fluctuating, arousal-coupled reinstatement GAIN (content-blind; sets the threshold on whether ANY stored trace crosses into accessibility; stochastic-resonance flavour). Line B -- a content-selective competitive SUPPRESSION that, given what the global gate admits, inhibits specific competitors to keep retrieval clean. The READ-side sibling of MECH-261's mode-conditioned WRITE-gate family: REE owns the gates but not this retrieval-time gating POLICY.

Cross-modal negotiation currency: a common precision-weighted representation that makes structurally dissimilar sense-specific geometries (smell gradient, sight manifold, touch boundary/contact, hearing temporal-source, proprioception body-state) mutually negotiable inside one shared world model.

Labels as active top-down perceptual-control signals: a self-directed label ('food-gradient', 'danger-gradient', 'novelty-gradient', 'blocked-goal', 'return-to-baseline') is not merely a post-perceptual report but a top-down tuning signal that biases perceptual search and detection -- a perceptual-control intervention, not a description.

Distancing operator: reframing a sticky, high-conflict, self-referential state from first-person ('I am failing') into a model-like system-state or third-person frame ('REE is encountering unresolved prediction-error pressure under current constraints') reduces self-referential collapse and increases model-based inspection during arbitration.

A global-instability / broad control-plane vulnerability axis (a p-factor / general-psychopathology-factor analogue) loads across ALL failure modes: a single broad dimension of control-plane regulatory fragility -- instability in precision/gain/threshold setpoint regulation (ARC-005) rather than any one specific comparator or stream -- raises joint susceptibility to multiple failure modes at once, distinct from and orthogonal to any single-axis failure. This is the axis with no existing REE home; it predicts that a subset of agents/patients carry elevated risk across the whole failure-mode space rather than along one axis.

Diffuse long-range competitive coupling is a generative stability requirement: stable, synergistic, hierarchical cognifold dynamics require signed competitive coupling -- specifically diffuse, long-range competition between distant fields with opposite profiles -- not merely local damping. An all-cooperative (all-positive) routed-field cognifold is unstable: every salient stream reinforces every other, producing runaway resonance / over-synchronisation / loss of modular segregation. Competition is the constructive ingredient that buys stabilisation, segregation, hierarchy, synergy, and subject-specificity.

Substrate-independent cognifold primitives: REE specifies its single cognifold (one interacting state-space, not a modular stack) in a hardware-neutral primitive vocabulary -- persistent state, history-dependent deformation, multi-timescale field dynamics, oscillatory propagation, stochastic transition, attractor transitions, residue-as-deformation-of-the-future-action-landscape, commitment as a real boundary between simulated and released action, and offline reintegration -- so that any FUTURE physical substrate is evaluated by whether it can INSTANTIATE these dynamics, not merely execute modular software. The primitives remain software-expressible now while also being legible as future physical-substrate affordances.

Sense-specific perceptual-manifold adaptor: each sensory modality requires its own adaptor transforming raw stimulus space into a perceptual-manifold (metric) space before shared-world-model entry; senses are not interchangeable raw streams.

Typed signed cognifold coupling: the cognifold represents inter-field coupling as a typed, signed edge -- cognifold_edge = {source, target, sign, gain, precision, gate, timescale, write_authority} -- with competition (sign < 0) as a FIRST-CLASS GENERATIVE coupling mode alongside cooperation (sign > 0) and gated-decoupling, not an emergent by-product of selection softmaxes. Three coupling modes: cooperative (binding, coherent trajectory, shared context), competitive (suppress incompatible trajectories, preserve boundaries, prevent runaway resonance, stop one field absorbing all others), gated-decoupling (isolate simulation / offline integration / unsafe candidates from release authority).

Foreclosing the SELF's own future reachable-option space carries a decision cost in E3 trajectory scoring, GATED BY FORECAST UNCERTAINTY -- the non-harm, self-directed analog of INV-026 (which scopes foreclosure-of-reachable-state-space as a harm to OTHERS). E3 today scores harm + benefit + goal + residue + the modulatory stack; nothing represents the option-value / reversibility of an action for the agent's OWN reachable futures. REE's irreversibility-awareness is HARM-scoped (residue cannot be erased; No-Go gates; INV-026 foreclosure-of-others); there is no INFORMATION/RESOURCE-scoped analog (don't cheaply foreclose your own options). The claim: an uncertainty-gated reachable-option-preservation cost should change committed action -- preferring the reversible/option-preserving branch MORE when the forecast that justifies foreclosure is UNCERTAIN, and not at all when it is confident (a generalization of DR-12's PE-conditioned E3 confidence from object-rollouts to a foreclosure cost).

Cholinergic TAN-pause plasticity-window gating of selector credit: dopamine should NOT continuously update every recently-active selector component; a striatal cholinergic tonically-active-neuron (TAN) pause should open a NARROW plasticity window around behaviourally-relevant events, so the three-factor learned-gating updates (ARC-108) are admitted only WITHIN the window. Without a window, continuous credit smears across irrelevant recently-active components and degrades the learned gating the conversion attack depends on. The OPENING-side neuromodulatory complement to REE's existing CLOSURE-side plasticity control (MECH-094 waking-gate; INV-074/MECH-333/MECH-334 consolidation/EWC) -- REE today has machinery to stop/consolidate learning but not a phasic gate to OPEN a precise learning window.

Loop-local eligibility traces under a globally-broadcast dopamine signal: even with a SINGLE shared dopaminergic teaching signal (ARC-108 delta_t), the credit traces that decide WHICH synapses/channels the signal updates must remain LOCAL and loop-specific -- effective update = shared delta_t x separate local eligibility trace x loop-specific active synapses -- rather than the current single globally-broadcast credit that updates every recently-active selector component. A too-broad or temporally-smeared eligibility trace would make learned gating appear ineffective (no committed conversion) even when the underlying dopamine learning rule is exactly correct, because the right teaching signal is delivered to the wrong synapses.

Intermediate channel-granularity falsifier -- before the full segregated-loop build (ARC-110), expose the compressed E3 score_bias modulatory channel as SEVERAL separately-learnable finer channels (OFC-devaluation / dACC-conflict / lateral-PFC rule-evidence / vigour / liking) to the learned-gating layer (ARC-108 w_chan), so the learner can discover SEPARATELY that different control functions matter in different states. The current single global w_chan learns one weight over a pre-compressed blend; this tests whether the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is REPRESENTATIONAL COMPRESSION (finer channels convert non-motor influence to committed action) rather than a requirement for full per-loop competition (finer channels do NOT convert, and only ARC-110 segregated loops do). The cheap intermediate rung BETWEEN ARC-108's one global weight vector and ARC-110's full segregated loops -- a V3-tractable falsifier that can pre-empt the V4 loop build.

Context-conditioned weights PROPER -- learned connection weights as a function of context, distinct from context-conditioned GAIN: REE today has the GAIN form of context-conditioning (ARC-044's unifier -- a context-specific multiplicative scalar: MECH-152 terrain_weight scaling E3 harm/goal scoring, ARC-016 precision, MECH-261 mode-conditioned write-CHANNEL gating) which modulates a FIXED transfer function. It does NOT have the WEIGHT form: a substrate where the learned connection weights THEMSELVES are a function of context (a different effective weight set selected/generated per context -- the transfer function changes, not a gain on it). The valuation/gating parameters are static nn.Modules; context enters only through the INPUT (z_world) and through output GAIN, never through the weights. HYPOTHESIS: genuinely context-dependent BEHAVIOUR (not just context-scaled magnitude) requires context to reach the weights -- the learned per-channel selection weight w_chan conditioned on z_world that ARC-108 introduces is the first instance of this WEIGHT form at the gating layer.

Parallel segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops (motor / cognitive-set / motivational): committed-action selection should run through SEPARATE striatal loop channels -- a motor loop, an associative/cognitive-set loop, and a limbic/motivational loop -- each owning its own eligibility-and-gate, arbitrated AFTER within-loop competition, rather than collapsing all channels into ONE shared E3 selection arena where the dACC/lPFC/OFC analogs feed in only as additive biases. HYPOTHESIS (assembly-map A.2 / s.D): the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is partly an ARTEFACT of the single-arena collapse -- F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance because every channel competes in one F-dominated arena; with segregated loops F could dominate only the motor loop and could not drown the limbic 'is this worth committing to' computation, which is a different loop with a different value. Translation target is FUNCTIONAL (the Alexander/DeLong/Strick parallel-loop organisation as a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

D1/D2 striatal population split with asymmetric dopamine gain: the Go (direct/D1) and No-Go (indirect/D2) pathways should be represented as TWO populations with OPPOSITE dopamine sensitivity (DA potentiates D1/Go via LTP, depresses D2/No-Go via LTD), NOT collapsed into one additive scoring scalar. REE today renders Go/No-Go as a scoring SIGN (benefit_eval_head minus harm_eval_head; MECH-449 Go-promote / No-Go-suppress over the eligible set) -- dissociable pathways pre-summed into one cost. The split is REQUIRED to EARN the Parkinson / dyskinesia / Huntington / impulse-control-disorder psychiatric axis per the ARC-106 EARNS criterion.

Unified dopamine substrate -- signed dopaminergic-RPE teaching signal feeding LEARNED gating weights on the E3 selector: the cortico-striatal weights that decide which channel wins committed-selection authority should themselves be LEARNED via three-factor plasticity (Hebbian co-activation x signed dopaminergic RPE) with the D1-LTP / D2-LTD asymmetry, consolidating the currently-scattered RPE / vigor / incentive functions into one substrate and supplying the GPi->lateral-habenula negative-RPE drain. The ARC-107 arbitration layer (MECH-447/448/449 + the authority rescale) is today pure arithmetic with NO learned parameters; F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance (MECH-439) precisely because no learned striatal weighting can re-weight channels through experience. The single highest-leverage missing BG piece and the proposed next attack on MECH-439.

Is the E3 committed-action conversion ceiling CONSTITUTIONAL (the rules by which candidate actions become eligible to win -- eligibility mask, Go/No-Go pressures, conflict-sensitive hold, threshold/widening, recurrent competition, commitment permission, post-commit latch -- are under-specified) rather than PARAMETRIC (upstream signals too weak / modulatory channels too quiet)? Across mechanistically distinct channels (CRF V3-EXQ-654g, OFC V3-EXQ-485h, SD-037 V3-EXQ-625e, dACC V3-EXQ-445h, modulatory V3-EXQ-569g) a formed-and-measurable signal reaches E3 authority yet committed action does not change reliably -- 'signal strength can exist without lawful access to committed action.' The basal-ganglia action-selection bottleneck (direct/Go, indirect/No-Go, hyperdirect-STN conflict-hold, striatal channel competition, pallidal permission-to-commit) is the functional reference; the open question is whether a BG-like selection CONSTITUTION is required BEYOND MECH-439's F-variance-share rebalance / shortlist levers.

Basal-ganglia-like E3 selector constitution: committed-action selection should be governed by an explicit BG-mirroring eligibility-gating CONSTITUTION -- candidate actions pass through an eligibility mask, bounded Go (direct-pathway promotion) and No-Go (indirect-pathway suppression) pressures, a conflict-sensitive hold / threshold-raise / candidate-set widening (hyperdirect-STN), striatal-like parallel channel competition (rather than one scalar monarch), a pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate (rather than bare argmax), and a stable post-commit latch / de-commit -- so that an upstream signal's STRENGTH is necessary but not sufficient: it also needs LAWFUL ACCESS to committed action. The translation target is functional (a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated BG analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

Global-scalar arousal channels are a VARIANCE AMPLIFIER of the already-dominant selection channel, not a source of behavioural differentiation: the three affective routes that modulate commitment globally (D1/D2 dopamine gain, harm-urgency threshold shrinkage, LC-NE/phasic-surprise temperature) apply one scalar uniformly across all K candidates and therefore cannot change an argmax, but DO change whether commitment fires and how sharply -- selecting for whichever channel already carries the most per-candidate score variance. Under F-dominance (MECH-439) this makes affective engagement ENTRENCH F rather than convert diversity, predicting that F's share of committed-selection variance RISES with arousal and FALLS under low urgency.

Biology-grounding as a standing construction constraint: build REE the agent so each functional component maps to an identified neural substrate at the level of FUNCTION (not homology), with biology as the reference of first resort for underdetermined design forks. Grounding must be load-bearing (a named neural primitive whose defining constraint is validated on a REE falsifier), not decorative naming; divergences from biology are legitimate but must be explicit and tracked, never silent.

Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge: SD-058/MECH-357 supply an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate but its avoidance_efficacy is a GLOBAL SCALAR that only penalises the no-op/freeze class -- compute_action_bias by design 'does NOT compute the escape direction'. V3-EXQ-603h (engaged-but-insufficient, readiness met) showed the consequence: the agent un-freezes but acquires no directed escape (seed-43 scalar efficacy 0.633 -> WORST survival 11.0). Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance needs the LA/BA->NAcc relief/safety action-credit half that positively reinforces a SPECIFIC avoidance response, not only the suppression half. REE owns relief (MECH-302/SD-050) + safety (MECH-303/304/SD-052/SD-051) but they are UNWIRED to avoidance. SD-059 adds the architecture: an affordance-indexed (per-first-action-class) credit table that, when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (relief) or terminates the threat (safety), tags that action as an escape affordance approachable under future threat; MECH-358 is the bridge mechanism.

Developmental ordering of other-bound streams: other-bound suffering/threat (protective) come online BEFORE other-bound liking/wanting (appetitive), because early positive other-reward is destabilising and exploitable -- a safety-relevant maturational ordering on the ARC-059 social spine.

Fast empathy mechanism: other-bound affect is produced by routing the agent's OWN motivational-affective streams (SD-011 suffering, MECH-112 wanting, etc.) through a stable other-model slot -- e.g. other-bound suffering = suffering stream + other-model binding; MECH-183 z_beta leakage is one such attribution-gated binding.

Trainable prospective safety predictor P_safety(state, cue, action, context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head predicting threat-ABSENCE / response-produced safety / conditioned inhibition, licensing commitment-release, approach to safety affordances, and recovery after threat. Distinct from z_goal (it predicts the ABSENCE of threat, not the PRESENCE of a goal) and from relief (it is a PROSPECTIVE threat-absence prediction, not an aversive-offset event). It is the trainable + contrastive successor that makes the MECH-303 (contextual passive safety) + MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition) substrate learnable, replacing the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA safety table of the MECH-358 safety half: positive target when a cue / context / action predicts threat absence or response-produced safety; negative target when 'safe' cues are followed by threat recurrence; CONTRASTIVE target to stop safety overgeneralising to stable background features that merely co-occurred with relief. Output supports commitment release, permits approach to safety affordances, stabilises recovery, and prevents persistent defensive mode when threat is genuinely absent.

Trainable relief critic Q_relief(state, action, threat_context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head that predicts expected harm/suffering reduction following an action under threat -- negative-reinforcement credit assignment, distinct from generic reward / wanting. It is the trainable successor to the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA credit table of the MECH-358 relief half, and is downstream of (NOT a duplicate of) the non-trainable MECH-302 / SD-050 relief-completion comparator that merely DETECTS relief on the current state. Q_relief is a function approximator generalising relief-credit across continuous state x action x threat-context, trained on action-contingent drops in z_harm_a: positive target when a directed action under threat is followed by a temporally-close, action-contingent z_harm_a drop not explained by passive environmental drift; negative / extinction target when the expected relief action fails to reduce harm. Feeds E3 as a bounded, threat-gated, extinguishable score-bias toward actions predicted to reduce harm -- never global reward, never fires when safe, never credits no-op / freeze unless explicitly modelling passive safety. MECH-094-safe: simulated relief in hypothesis mode must not train the waking critic unless authorised as play / training.

Candidate-differentiated affect vector: for proto-affect to carve behaviour it must carry per-candidate (cross-candidate) range, not merely per-tick magnitude. Each E3 candidate trajectory carries a multi-channel affect vector (curiosity / safety / harm-sensory / harm-affective / effort / relief / blocked-agency) so the same world-state can support different candidate rankings (approach / inspect / retreat / persist / retry / rest / reorient) under different internal pressures. A scalar added equally to all K candidates cannot change an argmax; only a per-candidate-differentiated contribution can.

Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge mechanism (instantiates SD-059): a pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/escape_affordance_bridge.py, sibling to the SD-058/MECH-357 gate) extending the MECH-357 scalar avoidance_efficacy into a per-first-action-class credit table. RELIEF half: a directed action under threat that drops z_harm_a (delta = prev - now > floor) credits relief_affordance[class] (EMA toward 1; MECH-302-consistent). SAFETY half: a directed action after which threat is absent (threat_scale <= 0) credits safety_affordance[class] (MECH-303/304-consistent response-produced safety). Approach bonus: under future threat, a per-candidate NEGATIVE (favoured) E3 score-bias toward credited classes = -clamp(approach_gain * threat_scale * combined_affordance[class], 0, bias_scale); the no-op/freeze class never gets a bonus. Three guards: bias_scale clamp, threat-context gate (zero when safe), per-tick leak.

Language-cannot-override-harm guard (language-input level): symbolic/linguistic input may CONDITION priors, but the harm/ethics substrate retains veto authority over any language-mediated update. There must be NO path by which symbolic/linguistic content overwrites or suppresses a harm signal. Operationalises the universal invariant INV-007 as an explicit guard a design can violate.

The motivational-affective stream taxonomy (liking, wanting, suffering, threat, relief, frustration, curiosity, attachment/proximity, fatigue/cost, agency, prediction-error) is an open, extensible register of handles -- it must permit later split/merge/rename and must not be frozen into a final ontology.

No empathy module / no empathy scalar: fast empathy must emerge from binding existing motivational-affective streams across self -> object -> other, never as an empathy_enabled flag or empathy_score primitive.

Emotion-as-anti-collapse architecture: emotion-like systems are a set of GATED, PARTIALLY INDEPENDENT evaluators (is-this-harmful / is-this-safe / did-this-reduce-suffering / am-I-pursuing-something-I-want / did-I-merely-like-the-last-thing / am-I-stuck / am-I-overcommitted / is-this-goal-stale / should-I-explore / should-I-stop / should-I-sleep-and-consolidate / should-I-release-the-policy) whose collective effect is to prevent behaviour from collapsing onto the currently dominant gradient. Affect is therefore the architectural SOURCE of structured behavioural diversity -- not decoration on a rational optimiser and not random exploration noise, but native modulatory control (gates, biases, interrupts, salience shifts, persistence regulators, release conditions, credit-assignment signals) that produces STRUCTURED deviations from naive optimisation. A unifying MAP over REE's already-owned affect machinery, not a new substrate; an optimise-then-bolt-on-safety design fails because these evaluators must be native, not added afterward.

Instrumental-avoidance acquisition: REE's defensive system needs an instrumental-ACQUISITION side, not only the defensive-REACTION side. SD-035 (amygdala BLA/CeA salience) + MECH-279 (PAG freeze gate) give REE the Pavlovian reaction (Tovote 2016: response EXECUTION, not learning); what is missing is the step from reaction to learned avoidance. Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance learning is the RESOLUTION of a Pavlovian-instrumental conflict -- the freezing reaction and the instrumental avoidance action are mutually exclusive, and learning to avoid REQUIRES the infralimbic PFC to SUPPRESS central-amygdala-driven freezing (ilPFC lesion -> more freezing, less avoidance; CeA lesion -> opposite). A freeze-and-salience substrate with no reaction-suppression / instrumental-acquisition layer is the ilPFC-lesion animal: it freezes instead of learning to avoid -- the V3-EXQ-603g G_H 0/3 signature. SD-058 adds the architecture (an instrumental-avoidance action pathway + an ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression gate gated by learned avoidance-efficacy, staged under a protective scaffold); MECH-357 is the gate mechanism.

Infralimbic-PFC-analog freeze-suppression + instrumental-avoidance gate: the mechanism instantiating SD-058. A pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/infralimbic_avoidance_gate.py, sibling to SD-035 CeA/BLA, MECH-279 PAG, MECH-313/MECH-320 policy regulators) with three coordinated pieces, all behind use_instrumental_avoidance (no-op default): (a) an instrumental-avoidance ACTION pathway -- a per-candidate E3 score-bias that under threat penalises the no-op/freeze class proportional to effective avoidance-efficacy, RELEASING the instrumental action (it does not pick the escape direction; E3's harm gradient does -- ARC-007-strict-compatible); (b) an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate that, when effective_efficacy*threat_scale >= threshold, overrides the MECH-279 freeze no-op so the agent acts instead of freezing; (c) an eligibility-trace avoidance-efficacy learner credited when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (Debiec & Sullivan 2017 gradual acquisition), bootstrapped by a protective-scaffold floor that anneals across Stage-H (Turchetta 2020).

Endogenous parasympathetic recovery / autonomic rebound: an active, offset-triggered, transient acceleration of return-to-baseline for the affective/autonomic stress state, fired by the agent's OWN stressor offset (the z_harm_a derivative going negative -- the MECH-302 SufferingDerivativeComparator signal) with NO conspecific and NO prediction. Shares the effector/update rule of MECH-355 soothing (decay-acceleration on the recovery side: a transient state-scaled multiplier on the MECH-219 z_harm_a recovery_rate + the SD-032e drive_bias leak) but differs by TRIGGER (endogenous offset vs conspecific). The V3-tractable sibling of MECH-355 that closes REE's sympathetic-rich / parasympathetic-poor asymmetry (dense escalation: MECH-219 onset, SD-032e accumulation, SD-037 override, MECH-091 urgency, MECH-279 freeze; thin recovery: only passive recovery_rate + offline-only drive_bias decay). Distinct from passive MECH-219 recovery (active overshoot, not decay), from MECH-302 relief (shared offset trigger, different output -- relief writes a reinforcer, rebound boosts recovery rate), from MECH-303/304 safety (no prediction), and from MECH-355 soothing (endogenous trigger, not social).

Soothing/comfort autonomic state-gain modulator: a present-tense down-regulation of the ONGOING aversive/stress state (lowers the gain or speeds the recovery of the active trajectory), canonically socially gated (conspecific buffering; oxytocinergic + parasympathetic/HPA + prefrontal regulation). Proposed home is a modulator on MECH-219 (suffering accumulator) decay + SD-012 (drive) + SD-032e (pACC autonomic coupling). Distinct from relief (MECH-302: past-offset phasic reinforcer), from safety (MECH-303/304: future inhibitory predictor), and from wanting (MECH-112: appetite): soothing acts on the present stress trajectory via autonomic state-gain, not reinforcement, prediction, or appetite. V4-social (the canonical trigger is an other-agent, which V3 cannot represent); an optional V3-minimal non-social autonomic-recovery hook is noted but not built.

Effort/fatigue stop-recover homeostatic accumulator: a two-bound (hysteretic) leaky cost-evidence accumulator on the SD-012 homeostatic-drive side (substrate-hosted by the SD-048 interoceptive channel). F accumulates with effort / time-on-task and dissipates with rest; at the upper bound it emits STOP / disengage, recovering to a lower bound before re-engaging. Two time-constants: a fast within-task accumulator and a slow sleep-pressure (Process-S) variant whose recover phase is offline (SD-017 sleep). The in-task STOP feeds the MECH-342 release actuator as a new deficit input and the ARC-078 goal-disengagement consumer via a cost/benefit (non-aversive) channel; the recover / re-accumulation half lives on the SD-012 / SD-017 side. Distinct from suffering / learned-helplessness (SD-011 side): fatigue is controllability-independent, incentive-reversible, and -- decisively -- recovers with rest, which helplessness does not.

top_dependency_targets.title: Harm stream separates into sensory-discriminative (z_harm_s: proximity/intensity, Adelta-pathway analog, forward-predictable) and affective-motivational (z_harm_a: accumulated homeostatic deviation, C-fiber/paleospinothalamic analog).

staleness_gated_target_refresh_on_replay_write (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze analog). The second, more speculative leg of the CDQ-005 reanalyze import, complementary to MECH-443. Asserts that a replayed transition admitted to update the rule-arbitration layer should NOT write its stored (ghost-derived, possibly stale) target verbatim; the target should first be RECOMPUTED against the current model/policy before it updates the rule layer, and the write should be down-weighted or skipped when the recomputed target has not drifted from the stored one (low staleness => low update value). This is the MuZero reanalyze trick (re-run the model on stored trajectories to produce fresh targets) plus EfficientZero off-policy/staleness correction. It guards against the failure MECH-319 was built to prevent (overcommitment to ghost-derived arbitration weights) from re-entering THROUGH the admitted-write channel that MECH-443 opens: prioritized writing of STALE targets would re-introduce drift, so the priority signal (MECH-443) and the freshness signal (MECH-444) must operate together.

priority_weighted_replay_write_selection (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze + hippocampal prioritized-replay analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-319's simulation-mode rule-write gate. MECH-319 is a BINARY categorical gate: during a ghost/replay/DMN pass it either blocks arbitration-weight writes (normal) or admits them (the V3-EXQ-543c/628 falsifier flag) -- all-or-nothing, no ordering among the replayed transitions it admits. MECH-443 asserts that WHEN the replay write channel is open, the transitions admitted to update the rule-arbitration layer should not be written uniformly but in GRADED priority order, weighted by an update-utility signal (a surprise / value-prediction-error / coverage proxy), so a high-utility replayed transition writes more strongly and a low-utility one writes weakly or not at all. The external analog is EfficientZero/MuZero prioritized experience replay (priority ~ value-prediction error); the biology is hippocampal SWR replay, which is demonstrably prioritized rather than uniform. CRITICAL REFINEMENT FROM BIOLOGY: the priority is the value of the UPDATE (Mattar & Daw gain x need), NOT raw reward magnitude or current action-value -- Carey et al. 2019 shows replay can be biased AWAY from the currently-most-valuable outcome. MECH-443 is the WHICH/HOW-STRONGLY complement to MECH-319's WHETHER gate; it does not change the binary gate, it grades the admitted writes.

Does REE need an explicit graded action-status vocabulary -- simulated != rehearsed != intended != committed != acted, with a parallel self_reference_frame (first_person / system_state / third_person_model) -- as a first-class annotation, or do MECH-094's simulation/commit write-profiles plus MECH-061's commit-boundary token already suffice to carry the distinction?

Multi-dimensional provenance source vector: an event token's provenance is a SOURCE VECTOR over several partly-independent dimensions (perceived-vs-imagined, self-generated-vs-other-generated, source identity, temporal source, modality), not a single committed_vs_imagined bit. Provenance failures dissociate per-dimension -- the system can correctly attribute real-vs-imagined while mis-attributing who-generated-it or when -- so each dimension carries its own confidence, and the one-way committed gate applies per safety-relevant dimension rather than to a single global bit.

Retrieval-time accessibility gating: which stored traces become reinstatable at a given moment is set by two composable READ-side policy layers, not by storage alone. Line A -- a global, slowly-fluctuating, arousal-coupled reinstatement GAIN (content-blind; sets the threshold on whether ANY stored trace crosses into accessibility; stochastic-resonance flavour). Line B -- a content-selective competitive SUPPRESSION that, given what the global gate admits, inhibits specific competitors to keep retrieval clean. The READ-side sibling of MECH-261's mode-conditioned WRITE-gate family: REE owns the gates but not this retrieval-time gating POLICY.

Consolidation provenance + contradiction-flag + rollback: every consolidated summary carries transformation_history + contradiction_flags; a summary conflicting with its source is flagged not silently authoritative; retired schemas leave source episodes intact.

Contextual memory-allocation gate policy: a control-plane decision stage (context_similarity x temporal_distance interaction, schema_fit, salience, PE, uncertainty, goal_relevance) selecting integrate / partial_overlap / separate over the hippocampal graph.

Lightweight self-narration trace/debug scaffold: an optional traceable field set (state_label, goal_label, sensed_gradient, active_prediction, uncertainty_level, candidate_action, candidate_action_reason, expected_consequence, affective_pressure, conflict_flag, commitment_threshold, stop_condition, simulation_or_commitment, self_reference_frame) that surfaces REE's working state for inspection -- the V3-compatible reduced form of an externalised 'private speech' surface, before it is compressed into internal control.
