top_dependency_targets.title: Rule-apprehension architectural slot, weak reading: a non-Bayesian rule-creator at the policy layer that proposes discriminative policy modes for the updaters (E3, training loop) to refine. V3 instantiation: a gated-policy architecture in which at least two policy heads share encoder features but receive different gating from a learned context discriminator (e.g., reef-context vs open-context heads). Tests the logical-necessity claim of MECH-309 within the existing V3 substrate without registering the heavier CandidateRule machinery (ARC-063, V4-deferred). Architectural slot, not yet implemented.

source_claims.title: Pre-approach orienting/surveying mode: a cue-triggered, need-gated active-sensing control state entered when a cue/need is present but directional/affordance confidence is too low for reliable approach; it samples gradients (turn/scan, exploratory arcs) until a directional vector stabilises, then exits to approach.

Safety-route inference: under threat, REE can infer a likely route to safety from partial map, cue, gradient, and prior-trajectory evidence rather than requiring safety to be directly visible or navigation-handed; generalises the scalar per-action-class escape credit of SD-059/MECH-358 into an inferred route.

Inferred affordance field: REE can infer affordances not directly perceived by combining current cues, hippocampal traces, E2 action-consequence predictions, CandidateRuleField content, affective gradients, and control-plane precision; these inferred affordances bias E3 candidate trajectories without overwriting perception and remain corrigible by action outcome.

Inference / belief-state affordance layer: a named integrative function that constructs latent state hypotheses and inferred affordance fields from partial observation, memory, cue traces, candidate rules, affective gradients, uncertainty, and E2 action-consequence rollouts, so E3 selects trajectories under partial observability without requiring direct perception or oracle-like prior knowledge.

dACC object-discriminative goal readout (L7): the dACC adaptive-control consumer reads per-candidate goal_proximity to the (SD-057 object-bound) z_goal, so its effort/value computation becomes object-discriminative -- approach_commit is goal-conditioned rather than z_goal-blind. Resolves the 2026-06-04 L7 audit finding that only E3 goal_proximity read z_goal consequentially and dACC was blind.

Cue-triggered wanting / cue-recall (L6): a PERCEIVED cue/object type (with no benefit pulse) retrieves its SD-057 incentive token and nudges z_goal toward that object's stored identity embedding BEFORE consumption -- identity-matched (pulls toward the perceived cue's object) and drive-specific (amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive)). The downstream E3 goal_proximity + MECH-295 approach bridge then raise pre-consummatory approach toward the cued object. Distinct from the benefit-driven seed: no benefit pulse, no token revaluation, weaker (cue_recall_gain) pull.

z_goal written from the incentive-token pointer (L4; amends MECH-230): z_goal is seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored identity embedding (argmax over per-object wanting) rather than from the raw last-contacted z_resource. z_goal keeps its role as E1 conditioning vector and E3 goal_proximity target; only the seed SOURCE changes, making the attractor object-bound and the wanting target dissociable from the liking (last-contacted) target.

Per-object incentive-salience token (L3): each resource identity accrues a slowly-decaying, revaluable base incentive value plus a stored identity embedding; wanting amplitude at recall = base_value * (1 + kappa * drive), with the drive multiplier relocated from the seeding gate onto the stored per-object value and computed per-axis so wanting is drive-specific / identity-matched (specific PIT).

Benefit-to-object-identity binding (L2): at resource contact the benefit pulse is bound to the contacted object's identity (the SD-049 per-type tag) via an associative object->benefit node, rather than written as a raw scalar gate against the current world/resource latent. The amygdala/BLA-analog identity-binding node the legacy substrate lacked (cue_features was a V3 no-op stub).

Object identity is a cross-cutting representational primitive. An object is a token-bound identity representation that persists across time and perceptual gaps, generalising z_object/z_resource into an object-file/binding layer (ARC-006), defined by causal feature-coherence under intervention (MECH-278), and consumed by drive/goal (SD-057), hippocampal planning (MECH-262), and the self/other special-object cases. The four planned object capabilities -- (1) permanence, (2) self-as-object, (3) tools/affordances, (4) others-as-object -- are specialisations of one primitive, not four separate mechanisms.

top_dependency_targets.title: Object-bound incentive-salience layer: insert a per-object incentive layer between the benefit pulse and z_goal. The legacy goal stream wrote a SINGLE z_goal attractor overwritten on every contact, conflating liking (hedonic impact at consumption) with wanting (incentive salience to a cue/object) and goal-location (where) with goal-object (what); wanting target always equalled liking target, so the L9 wanting!=liking dissociation was structurally inexpressible (514l C6=0.0 on all seeds). SD-057 adds (L2 MECH-344) benefit->object-identity binding on the SD-049 per-type tag, (L3 MECH-345) a per-object slow-decay revaluable incentive token with at-recall drive-specific wanting amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive), and (L4 MECH-346) z_goal seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored embedding rather than the raw last-contacted z_resource. v1 = L2+L3+L4 core; L6 cue-recall (MECH-CUEWANT) + L7 dACC-readout-wiring (MECH-CONSUME) deferred to a phase-2 pass within this SD.

source_claims.title: Phasic surprise-burst regulator: a toggleable, event-triggered LC-NE phasic control lever (PhasicSurpriseBurst) that fires a transient softmax-temperature burst on a prediction-error surprise spike and decays it over a few ticks, routed into the E3 select() softmax at agent.select_action() as the PHASIC complement to MECH-313 stochastic_noise_floor (tonic) on the SAME temperature channel -- the substrate that makes MECH-063 sub-claim (ii) (each control axis carries independent tonic baseline AND phasic event-burst degrees of freedom) behaviourally testable without synthetic signals. Reuses the MECH-104 volatility-surprise lit basis (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 phasic mode) but routes to the SELECTION softmax, NOT the ARC-016 commit/de-commit gate that carries the MECH-104 volatility_interrupt claim.

Retrieval-time accessibility gating: which stored traces become reinstatable at a given moment is set by two composable READ-side policy layers, not by storage alone. Line A -- a global, slowly-fluctuating, arousal-coupled reinstatement GAIN (content-blind; sets the threshold on whether ANY stored trace crosses into accessibility; stochastic-resonance flavour). Line B -- a content-selective competitive SUPPRESSION that, given what the global gate admits, inhibits specific competitors to keep retrieval clean. The READ-side sibling of MECH-261's mode-conditioned WRITE-gate family: REE owns the gates but not this retrieval-time gating POLICY.

Cross-modal negotiation currency: a common precision-weighted representation that makes structurally dissimilar sense-specific geometries (smell gradient, sight manifold, touch boundary/contact, hearing temporal-source, proprioception body-state) mutually negotiable inside one shared world model.

Labels as active top-down perceptual-control signals: a self-directed label ('food-gradient', 'danger-gradient', 'novelty-gradient', 'blocked-goal', 'return-to-baseline') is not merely a post-perceptual report but a top-down tuning signal that biases perceptual search and detection -- a perceptual-control intervention, not a description.

Distancing operator: reframing a sticky, high-conflict, self-referential state from first-person ('I am failing') into a model-like system-state or third-person frame ('REE is encountering unresolved prediction-error pressure under current constraints') reduces self-referential collapse and increases model-based inspection during arbitration.

A global-instability / broad control-plane vulnerability axis (a p-factor / general-psychopathology-factor analogue) loads across ALL failure modes: a single broad dimension of control-plane regulatory fragility -- instability in precision/gain/threshold setpoint regulation (ARC-005) rather than any one specific comparator or stream -- raises joint susceptibility to multiple failure modes at once, distinct from and orthogonal to any single-axis failure. This is the axis with no existing REE home; it predicts that a subset of agents/patients carry elevated risk across the whole failure-mode space rather than along one axis.

Diffuse long-range competitive coupling is a generative stability requirement: stable, synergistic, hierarchical cognifold dynamics require signed competitive coupling -- specifically diffuse, long-range competition between distant fields with opposite profiles -- not merely local damping. An all-cooperative (all-positive) routed-field cognifold is unstable: every salient stream reinforces every other, producing runaway resonance / over-synchronisation / loss of modular segregation. Competition is the constructive ingredient that buys stabilisation, segregation, hierarchy, synergy, and subject-specificity.

Substrate-independent cognifold primitives: REE specifies its single cognifold (one interacting state-space, not a modular stack) in a hardware-neutral primitive vocabulary -- persistent state, history-dependent deformation, multi-timescale field dynamics, oscillatory propagation, stochastic transition, attractor transitions, residue-as-deformation-of-the-future-action-landscape, commitment as a real boundary between simulated and released action, and offline reintegration -- so that any FUTURE physical substrate is evaluated by whether it can INSTANTIATE these dynamics, not merely execute modular software. The primitives remain software-expressible now while also being legible as future physical-substrate affordances.

Sense-specific perceptual-manifold adaptor: each sensory modality requires its own adaptor transforming raw stimulus space into a perceptual-manifold (metric) space before shared-world-model entry; senses are not interchangeable raw streams.

Typed signed cognifold coupling: the cognifold represents inter-field coupling as a typed, signed edge -- cognifold_edge = {source, target, sign, gain, precision, gate, timescale, write_authority} -- with competition (sign < 0) as a FIRST-CLASS GENERATIVE coupling mode alongside cooperation (sign > 0) and gated-decoupling, not an emergent by-product of selection softmaxes. Three coupling modes: cooperative (binding, coherent trajectory, shared context), competitive (suppress incompatible trajectories, preserve boundaries, prevent runaway resonance, stop one field absorbing all others), gated-decoupling (isolate simulation / offline integration / unsafe candidates from release authority).

top_dependency_targets.title: Control plane routes precision and modes.

source_claims.title: Context-conditioned weights PROPER -- learned connection weights as a function of context, distinct from context-conditioned GAIN: REE today has the GAIN form of context-conditioning (ARC-044's unifier -- a context-specific multiplicative scalar: MECH-152 terrain_weight scaling E3 harm/goal scoring, ARC-016 precision, MECH-261 mode-conditioned write-CHANNEL gating) which modulates a FIXED transfer function. It does NOT have the WEIGHT form: a substrate where the learned connection weights THEMSELVES are a function of context (a different effective weight set selected/generated per context -- the transfer function changes, not a gain on it). The valuation/gating parameters are static nn.Modules; context enters only through the INPUT (z_world) and through output GAIN, never through the weights. HYPOTHESIS: genuinely context-dependent BEHAVIOUR (not just context-scaled magnitude) requires context to reach the weights -- the learned per-channel selection weight w_chan conditioned on z_world that ARC-108 introduces is the first instance of this WEIGHT form at the gating layer.

Is an EXPLICIT event-level write-eligible state (MECH-368) actually needed, or is the existing combination -- MECH-261 mode-conditioned channel gating + MECH-094 provenance gating + MECH-285 consolidation-priority by V_s residual -- already sufficient to prevent undifferentiated global model updates? This is the falsifier for MECH-368: if a substrate that gates only the channel (mode) and prioritises only at consolidation still avoids catastrophic interference on the online world-model/policy path, MECH-368 earns no keep.

Two-factor (tag-and-capture) write-eligibility: MECH-368's plasticity_eligibility is not a single instantaneous test but a TWO-STAGE process -- a local event sets a transient, input-specific eligibility TAG, and a durable model/policy write is consummated only if that tag CAPTURES a separately-gated plasticity/consolidation-resource signal within a time window. A tagged-eligible event can still fail to write if no capture signal arrives, and an arriving capture signal can rescue a recently-tagged weak event.

Schema-congruence as a consolidation write-weight and routing variable: the degree of fit between an event and the agent's existing schemas modulates how that event is consolidated -- schema-congruent content is consolidated preferentially and routed more directly into the durable/semantic store (a fast vmPFC-gated systems-consolidation route), while schema-incongruent content requires prolonged hippocampal-dependent consolidation or is gated out. Schema-fit is a WRITE-WEIGHT input to consolidation alongside affect (MECH-361), not only a retrieval-time prior.

Retrieval-time accessibility gating: which stored traces become reinstatable at a given moment is set by two composable READ-side policy layers, not by storage alone. Line A -- a global, slowly-fluctuating, arousal-coupled reinstatement GAIN (content-blind; sets the threshold on whether ANY stored trace crosses into accessibility; stochastic-resonance flavour). Line B -- a content-selective competitive SUPPRESSION that, given what the global gate admits, inhibits specific competitors to keep retrieval clean. The READ-side sibling of MECH-261's mode-conditioned WRITE-gate family: REE owns the gates but not this retrieval-time gating POLICY.

Consolidation gated-write-authority: over-frequent rewriting of consolidated memory is a failure mode; the consolidation operator's authority to overwrite is gated by schema-stability / schedule-sensitivity, not run after every interaction.

Contextual memory-allocation gate policy: a control-plane decision stage (context_similarity x temporal_distance interaction, schema_fit, salience, PE, uncertainty, goal_relevance) selecting integrate / partial_overlap / separate over the hippocampal graph.

Labels as active top-down perceptual-control signals: a self-directed label ('food-gradient', 'danger-gradient', 'novelty-gradient', 'blocked-goal', 'return-to-baseline') is not merely a post-perceptual report but a top-down tuning signal that biases perceptual search and detection -- a perceptual-control intervention, not a description.

Event-level write-authority gate: an explicit per-event transition from observed/represented to write-eligible over the DURABLE MODEL-UPDATE path (E1/E2 world-model and policy weights, not only episodic memory), conditioned on f(prediction_error, salience, pathway_state, residue_status, goal_relevance, plasticity_eligibility). The gate decides which individual events within an already-open write channel are licensed to durably deform the model; an event may be salient, real-provenance, and in a write-permitted mode yet still fail the gate. Without it, every prediction error in an open channel writes -- the undifferentiated-global-update / catastrophic-interference failure mode.

Candidate-gradient hippocampal episode schema: enrich the event trace from state -> action -> outcome to state -> candidates-considered -> affective gradients over candidates -> selected action -> outcome -> residue (relief / harm / blocked-agency / safety update), and use the affective gradient as a memory WRITE-WEIGHT and RETRIEVAL-QUERY variable -- high-gradient episodes are preferentially written, and later similar-gradient states retrieve prior action-affect-outcome arcs rather than undifferentiated state-action-outcome tuples.

top_dependency_targets.title: Mode-conditioned write gating: the operating-mode variable from the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) determines which substrates can write to E3, episodic memory, policy updates, and autonomic coupling. Generalises MECH-094 hypothesis tag to a mode-conditioned family of write gates. Operating mode is implemented as a soft probability vector over {external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation}, not a one-hot categorical.

source_claims.title: Foreclosing the SELF's own future reachable-option space carries a decision cost in E3 trajectory scoring, GATED BY FORECAST UNCERTAINTY -- the non-harm, self-directed analog of INV-026 (which scopes foreclosure-of-reachable-state-space as a harm to OTHERS). E3 today scores harm + benefit + goal + residue + the modulatory stack; nothing represents the option-value / reversibility of an action for the agent's OWN reachable futures. REE's irreversibility-awareness is HARM-scoped (residue cannot be erased; No-Go gates; INV-026 foreclosure-of-others); there is no INFORMATION/RESOURCE-scoped analog (don't cheaply foreclose your own options). The claim: an uncertainty-gated reachable-option-preservation cost should change committed action -- preferring the reversible/option-preserving branch MORE when the forecast that justifies foreclosure is UNCERTAIN, and not at all when it is confident (a generalization of DR-12's PE-conditioned E3 confidence from object-rollouts to a foreclosure cost).

Cholinergic TAN-pause plasticity-window gating of selector credit: dopamine should NOT continuously update every recently-active selector component; a striatal cholinergic tonically-active-neuron (TAN) pause should open a NARROW plasticity window around behaviourally-relevant events, so the three-factor learned-gating updates (ARC-108) are admitted only WITHIN the window. Without a window, continuous credit smears across irrelevant recently-active components and degrades the learned gating the conversion attack depends on. The OPENING-side neuromodulatory complement to REE's existing CLOSURE-side plasticity control (MECH-094 waking-gate; INV-074/MECH-333/MECH-334 consolidation/EWC) -- REE today has machinery to stop/consolidate learning but not a phasic gate to OPEN a precise learning window.

Loop-local eligibility traces under a globally-broadcast dopamine signal: even with a SINGLE shared dopaminergic teaching signal (ARC-108 delta_t), the credit traces that decide WHICH synapses/channels the signal updates must remain LOCAL and loop-specific -- effective update = shared delta_t x separate local eligibility trace x loop-specific active synapses -- rather than the current single globally-broadcast credit that updates every recently-active selector component. A too-broad or temporally-smeared eligibility trace would make learned gating appear ineffective (no committed conversion) even when the underlying dopamine learning rule is exactly correct, because the right teaching signal is delivered to the wrong synapses.

Intermediate channel-granularity falsifier -- before the full segregated-loop build (ARC-110), expose the compressed E3 score_bias modulatory channel as SEVERAL separately-learnable finer channels (OFC-devaluation / dACC-conflict / lateral-PFC rule-evidence / vigour / liking) to the learned-gating layer (ARC-108 w_chan), so the learner can discover SEPARATELY that different control functions matter in different states. The current single global w_chan learns one weight over a pre-compressed blend; this tests whether the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is REPRESENTATIONAL COMPRESSION (finer channels convert non-motor influence to committed action) rather than a requirement for full per-loop competition (finer channels do NOT convert, and only ARC-110 segregated loops do). The cheap intermediate rung BETWEEN ARC-108's one global weight vector and ARC-110's full segregated loops -- a V3-tractable falsifier that can pre-empt the V4 loop build.

Context-conditioned weights PROPER -- learned connection weights as a function of context, distinct from context-conditioned GAIN: REE today has the GAIN form of context-conditioning (ARC-044's unifier -- a context-specific multiplicative scalar: MECH-152 terrain_weight scaling E3 harm/goal scoring, ARC-016 precision, MECH-261 mode-conditioned write-CHANNEL gating) which modulates a FIXED transfer function. It does NOT have the WEIGHT form: a substrate where the learned connection weights THEMSELVES are a function of context (a different effective weight set selected/generated per context -- the transfer function changes, not a gain on it). The valuation/gating parameters are static nn.Modules; context enters only through the INPUT (z_world) and through output GAIN, never through the weights. HYPOTHESIS: genuinely context-dependent BEHAVIOUR (not just context-scaled magnitude) requires context to reach the weights -- the learned per-channel selection weight w_chan conditioned on z_world that ARC-108 introduces is the first instance of this WEIGHT form at the gating layer.

Parallel segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops (motor / cognitive-set / motivational): committed-action selection should run through SEPARATE striatal loop channels -- a motor loop, an associative/cognitive-set loop, and a limbic/motivational loop -- each owning its own eligibility-and-gate, arbitrated AFTER within-loop competition, rather than collapsing all channels into ONE shared E3 selection arena where the dACC/lPFC/OFC analogs feed in only as additive biases. HYPOTHESIS (assembly-map A.2 / s.D): the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is partly an ARTEFACT of the single-arena collapse -- F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance because every channel competes in one F-dominated arena; with segregated loops F could dominate only the motor loop and could not drown the limbic 'is this worth committing to' computation, which is a different loop with a different value. Translation target is FUNCTIONAL (the Alexander/DeLong/Strick parallel-loop organisation as a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

D1/D2 striatal population split with asymmetric dopamine gain: the Go (direct/D1) and No-Go (indirect/D2) pathways should be represented as TWO populations with OPPOSITE dopamine sensitivity (DA potentiates D1/Go via LTP, depresses D2/No-Go via LTD), NOT collapsed into one additive scoring scalar. REE today renders Go/No-Go as a scoring SIGN (benefit_eval_head minus harm_eval_head; MECH-449 Go-promote / No-Go-suppress over the eligible set) -- dissociable pathways pre-summed into one cost. The split is REQUIRED to EARN the Parkinson / dyskinesia / Huntington / impulse-control-disorder psychiatric axis per the ARC-106 EARNS criterion.

Unified dopamine substrate -- signed dopaminergic-RPE teaching signal feeding LEARNED gating weights on the E3 selector: the cortico-striatal weights that decide which channel wins committed-selection authority should themselves be LEARNED via three-factor plasticity (Hebbian co-activation x signed dopaminergic RPE) with the D1-LTP / D2-LTD asymmetry, consolidating the currently-scattered RPE / vigor / incentive functions into one substrate and supplying the GPi->lateral-habenula negative-RPE drain. The ARC-107 arbitration layer (MECH-447/448/449 + the authority rescale) is today pure arithmetic with NO learned parameters; F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance (MECH-439) precisely because no learned striatal weighting can re-weight channels through experience. The single highest-leverage missing BG piece and the proposed next attack on MECH-439.

Is the E3 committed-action conversion ceiling CONSTITUTIONAL (the rules by which candidate actions become eligible to win -- eligibility mask, Go/No-Go pressures, conflict-sensitive hold, threshold/widening, recurrent competition, commitment permission, post-commit latch -- are under-specified) rather than PARAMETRIC (upstream signals too weak / modulatory channels too quiet)? Across mechanistically distinct channels (CRF V3-EXQ-654g, OFC V3-EXQ-485h, SD-037 V3-EXQ-625e, dACC V3-EXQ-445h, modulatory V3-EXQ-569g) a formed-and-measurable signal reaches E3 authority yet committed action does not change reliably -- 'signal strength can exist without lawful access to committed action.' The basal-ganglia action-selection bottleneck (direct/Go, indirect/No-Go, hyperdirect-STN conflict-hold, striatal channel competition, pallidal permission-to-commit) is the functional reference; the open question is whether a BG-like selection CONSTITUTION is required BEYOND MECH-439's F-variance-share rebalance / shortlist levers.

Basal-ganglia-like E3 selector constitution: committed-action selection should be governed by an explicit BG-mirroring eligibility-gating CONSTITUTION -- candidate actions pass through an eligibility mask, bounded Go (direct-pathway promotion) and No-Go (indirect-pathway suppression) pressures, a conflict-sensitive hold / threshold-raise / candidate-set widening (hyperdirect-STN), striatal-like parallel channel competition (rather than one scalar monarch), a pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate (rather than bare argmax), and a stable post-commit latch / de-commit -- so that an upstream signal's STRENGTH is necessary but not sufficient: it also needs LAWFUL ACCESS to committed action. The translation target is functional (a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated BG analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

top_dependency_targets.title: Biology-grounding as a standing construction constraint: build REE the agent so each functional component maps to an identified neural substrate at the level of FUNCTION (not homology), with biology as the reference of first resort for underdetermined design forks. Grounding must be load-bearing (a named neural primitive whose defining constraint is validated on a REE falsifier), not decorative naming; divergences from biology are legitimate but must be explicit and tracked, never silent.

source_claims.title: Difficulty-gated proposal-entropy regulator: a stuck-state/impasse detector + a transient gain on the ARC-018/CEM PROPOSAL-generation layer (wider candidate set + within-class CEM sampling temperature), decaying as the impasse clears. Builds MECH-343's substrate_conditional blocker part 2 (the 'stuck-state detector + transient CEM temperature/candidate-count gain + decay not yet designed' piece named in MECH-343's evidence_quality_note); blocker part 1 (modulatory-bias-selection-authority) is already IMPLEMENTED via the 569i top-k shortlist conversion. The detector integrates goal-progress stall + E3 score margin + committed-action-class lock-in + dACC choice_difficulty into a graded stuck_score, GUARDED by goal salience (stuck-WITH-goal, not goal-abandonment); the regulator maps stuck_score to extra CEM candidates + a within-class temperature lift. Scoring, commitment (MECH-090/342) and selection authority (569i/MECH-341) are untouched -- a hard problem widens proposals, not behaviour.

Safety-route inference: under threat, REE can infer a likely route to safety from partial map, cue, gradient, and prior-trajectory evidence rather than requiring safety to be directly visible or navigation-handed; generalises the scalar per-action-class escape credit of SD-059/MECH-358 into an inferred route.

Inferred affordance field: REE can infer affordances not directly perceived by combining current cues, hippocampal traces, E2 action-consequence predictions, CandidateRuleField content, affective gradients, and control-plane precision; these inferred affordances bias E3 candidate trajectories without overwriting perception and remain corrigible by action outcome.

Belief-state hypothesis set: when observations are ambiguous or incomplete, REE maintains a bounded set of competing latent-state hypotheses, each carrying confidence/precision, predicted transitions, goal/antigoal relations, and uncertainty; E3 evaluates candidate trajectories over the hypothesis set rather than over a single collapsed state.

Under partial observability the perceived scene is evidence for state, not identical to state; a valid REE state must integrate observation with memory, temporal context, self-state, cue context, rule context, and uncertainty, and inferred/imagined trajectories must remain provenance-tagged as inferred until enacted and updated by committed outcome evidence.

Inference / belief-state affordance layer: a named integrative function that constructs latent state hypotheses and inferred affordance fields from partial observation, memory, cue traces, candidate rules, affective gradients, uncertainty, and E2 action-consequence rollouts, so E3 selects trajectories under partial observability without requiring direct perception or oracle-like prior knowledge.

Unified autobiographical temporal event substrate: retrospective replay (ARC-007) and prospective simulation (ARC-018) draw on ONE self-tagged event-token store rather than two parallel memory machineries. Autobiographical memory is an identity-indexed event field -- personal events bound to perspective, emotion, residue, and self-state -- not neutral storage; future trajectory generation is forward re-composition of the same event tokens, while replay is their backward reinstatement.

Does stuck-state-GATED proposal entropy outperform BOTH entropy-off and always-high entropy? Main empirical prediction of MECH-343: in a hard-goal/blocked-path environment (matched easy-goal controls), the difficulty-gated-entropy arm should show flexible exploration -- improved goal progress, no harm increase, no random-churn increase, commitment latency that rises during the hard phase then falls after solution discovery -- and should BEAT both the entropy-off arm (proposal rigidity / stuck) and the entropy-always-high arm (disorganised exploration / no narrowing). WORKING QUESTION -- no evidence yet.

difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy (controlled proposal-entropy widening under goal blockage). When goal progress stalls -- repeated failure to improve goal progress, high inter-candidate conflict, low E3 score margin, low committed-action diversity, plateau/stuck-state signal -- WITH goal salience preserved, the agent should transiently INCREASE proposal-generation entropy UPSTREAM of action selection (wider hippocampal/world-model rollout candidate set + higher within-class sampling temperature) while preserving goal/harm/constraint scoring and DELAYING commitment until one candidate clears the E3 score-margin / commitment threshold; entropy then NARROWS once a workable candidate is found -> committed action -> entropy decay. Asserted distinction (preserve this): a hard problem must trigger WIDER INTERNAL PROPOSALS -> more candidate diversity -> longer arbitration -> selective committed action (controlled entropy), NOT 'hard problem -> random behaviour' (noise). WORKING HYPOTHESIS -- no experimental evidence yet; not an established mechanism.

top_dependency_targets.title: Hippocampus generates explicit rollouts and post-commitment viability mapping.

source_claims.title: harm_evaluator_quality_grows_with_z_harm_differentiation
harm_evaluator_bounded_by_z_harm_differentiation
world_goal_evaluator_bounded_by_z_world_differentiation

Should REE distinguish an early over-connected exploratory developmental substrate from a mature sparse/structured substrate -- and is developmental sparsification best modelled as deletion, down-weighting, gating, or residue-tagged de-authorization?

Adaptor-maturity curriculum gate: each sense is admitted to the shared world model when its modality-specific adaptor is mature, ordered by adaptor depth (low-adaptor gradient senses first, deep-adaptor manifold senses later), specialising the staged developmental curriculum.

Subtractive developmental sparsification applies to the affect vector: mature candidate-differentiated affect arbitration (MECH-359) and the candidate-gradient episode store (MECH-361) reach their mature form by pruning an initially over-connected, dense affect/channel substrate, such that mature affect-driven selection requires convergent summation of several weak affective channels rather than a single strong dominant channel.

Modality-heterogeneity / adaptor-depth gradient: senses differ in how much transformation they need before world-model entry -- smell is a near-raw gradient primitive, sight needs a deep perceptual-manifold adaptor; gradient-like (low-adaptor-depth) senses enter earliest developmentally.

Subtractive developmental sparsification: mature sparse/structured memory connectivity emerges by pruning / down-weighting an initially over-connected, dense, near-random ('tabula plena') substrate, not by additively growing connections onto a sparse skeleton; correspondingly, mature recall requires convergent summation of several weak inputs rather than a single strong cue.

Sense-specific perceptual-manifold adaptor: each sensory modality requires its own adaptor transforming raw stimulus space into a perceptual-manifold (metric) space before shared-world-model entry; senses are not interchangeable raw streams.

top_dependency_targets.title: REE requires staged developmental training with explicit curriculum gates.

source_claims.title: Residue-aware social repair: exploiting a cooperating other leaves a persisting regret-residue that spawns a self-state repair-goal (restore commitment/relationship coherence), distinguishing genuine prosocial commitment from mere reciprocity bookkeeping.

Other-model prediction, reciprocity reward, and residue-aware social commitment are three separable functions: an agent can predict cooperative intent without binding it into commitment-altering value, and can value reciprocity without generating repair-residue after exploitation (the A/B/C/D dissociation).

Fast empathy mechanism: other-bound affect is produced by routing the agent's OWN motivational-affective streams (SD-011 suffering, MECH-112 wanting, etc.) through a stable other-model slot -- e.g. other-bound suffering = suffering stream + other-model binding; MECH-183 z_beta leakage is one such attribution-gated binding.

Mirror-coupling gain must be homeostatically regulated inside an operating window; the three social pathologies are its boundaries (low gain = psychopathy/callousness, high gain = empathic overwhelm/paralysis, miscalibrated = burnout/moral injury).

A lightweight LanguageAffectAdaptor parses affect/emotion from user or agent LANGUAGE into the shared world model: a language-interface component that, when literal semantic content is insufficient to recover affect, converts text into PROBABILISTIC affect/emotion hypotheses (treated as uncertain latent-state estimates, NOT categorical emotion truths) and feeds those estimates into REE's wider agent-state and context modelling. It is an input/perception adaptor on the language channel -- distinct from REE's INTERNAL affective representation (Q-007 z_beta dimensions) -- supplying other-agent affect priors to the social/empathy modelling layer.

Language bootstraps from a grounded social ecology, not from grammar: given shared attention, partial observability, coordination pressure, a low-cost channel, and repair, proto-language partially bootstraps from grounded proto-communication. The grammar/LLM scaffold is a turbocharger, never the engine -- the engine is the V5 social ecology.

No empathy module / no empathy scalar: fast empathy must emerge from binding existing motivational-affective streams across self -> object -> other, never as an empathy_enabled flag or empathy_score primitive.

Others-as-object (PILLAR 4 of ARC-080): each other agent j gets its own token-keyed object-file SLOT (z_self_j, z_harm_a_j, drive, commitment chain) -- a special case of the ARC-080 object-file. This pillar is V4 (ARC-010 mirror modelling, ARC-047 SocialGridWorld), gated on MECH-163 multi-step hippocampal planning. Per developmental_needs_register DEV-NEED-021 its prerequisites are object-permanence (PILLAR 1, partial via SD-039 ghost bank) + self-stability (PILLAR 2 self, ARC-081): otherness inference REQUIRES object persistence + a stable self.

top_dependency_targets.title: Social cognition uses mirror modelling and coupling.

source_claims.title: Conditioned-safety cue channel: env-level controllable, observable Pavlovian safety CS added to CausalGridWorld -- an ambient (uniform-when-active) 25-dim field view emitted into world_state (feeds the z_world encoder the SD-051 ConditionedSafetyStore keys on). Can be paired with the MECH-302 relief-completion window during teaching (the store still writes its prototype ONLY on the real event_fired tick -- the pairing is real, not synthesized) and presented CONCURRENTLY with a threat cue at test. Closes the 'no controllable safety cue' substrate gap that forced V3-EXQ-759 to synthesize the Pavlovian pairing off-substrate, making MECH-304's promote-to-active classical-conditioned-inhibition behavioural falsifier runnable. Adds no entity type (NUM_ENTITY_TYPES stays 7); pure environment substrate; no trainable parameters; no MECH-094 interaction at the env level.

Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge: SD-058/MECH-357 supply an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate but its avoidance_efficacy is a GLOBAL SCALAR that only penalises the no-op/freeze class -- compute_action_bias by design 'does NOT compute the escape direction'. V3-EXQ-603h (engaged-but-insufficient, readiness met) showed the consequence: the agent un-freezes but acquires no directed escape (seed-43 scalar efficacy 0.633 -> WORST survival 11.0). Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance needs the LA/BA->NAcc relief/safety action-credit half that positively reinforces a SPECIFIC avoidance response, not only the suppression half. REE owns relief (MECH-302/SD-050) + safety (MECH-303/304/SD-052/SD-051) but they are UNWIRED to avoidance. SD-059 adds the architecture: an affordance-indexed (per-first-action-class) credit table that, when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (relief) or terminates the threat (safety), tags that action as an escape affordance approachable under future threat; MECH-358 is the bridge mechanism.

Relief/safety decomposition: when the fixed escape-affordance bridge is insufficient, is the missing structure relief-only (action-contingent escape credit), safety-only (prospective threat-absence prediction), or both-required -- and should a trainable successor (MECH-375 / MECH-376) train only the missing / weak component first?

Trainable prospective safety predictor P_safety(state, cue, action, context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head predicting threat-ABSENCE / response-produced safety / conditioned inhibition, licensing commitment-release, approach to safety affordances, and recovery after threat. Distinct from z_goal (it predicts the ABSENCE of threat, not the PRESENCE of a goal) and from relief (it is a PROSPECTIVE threat-absence prediction, not an aversive-offset event). It is the trainable + contrastive successor that makes the MECH-303 (contextual passive safety) + MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition) substrate learnable, replacing the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA safety table of the MECH-358 safety half: positive target when a cue / context / action predicts threat absence or response-produced safety; negative target when 'safe' cues are followed by threat recurrence; CONTRASTIVE target to stop safety overgeneralising to stable background features that merely co-occurred with relief. Output supports commitment release, permits approach to safety affordances, stabilises recovery, and prevents persistent defensive mode when threat is genuinely absent.

Trainable relief critic Q_relief(state, action, threat_context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head that predicts expected harm/suffering reduction following an action under threat -- negative-reinforcement credit assignment, distinct from generic reward / wanting. It is the trainable successor to the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA credit table of the MECH-358 relief half, and is downstream of (NOT a duplicate of) the non-trainable MECH-302 / SD-050 relief-completion comparator that merely DETECTS relief on the current state. Q_relief is a function approximator generalising relief-credit across continuous state x action x threat-context, trained on action-contingent drops in z_harm_a: positive target when a directed action under threat is followed by a temporally-close, action-contingent z_harm_a drop not explained by passive environmental drift; negative / extinction target when the expected relief action fails to reduce harm. Feeds E3 as a bounded, threat-gated, extinguishable score-bias toward actions predicted to reduce harm -- never global reward, never fires when safe, never credits no-op / freeze unless explicitly modelling passive safety. MECH-094-safe: simulated relief in hypothesis mode must not train the waking critic unless authorised as play / training.

Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge mechanism (instantiates SD-059): a pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/escape_affordance_bridge.py, sibling to the SD-058/MECH-357 gate) extending the MECH-357 scalar avoidance_efficacy into a per-first-action-class credit table. RELIEF half: a directed action under threat that drops z_harm_a (delta = prev - now > floor) credits relief_affordance[class] (EMA toward 1; MECH-302-consistent). SAFETY half: a directed action after which threat is absent (threat_scale <= 0) credits safety_affordance[class] (MECH-303/304-consistent response-produced safety). Approach bonus: under future threat, a per-candidate NEGATIVE (favoured) E3 score-bias toward credited classes = -clamp(approach_gain * threat_scale * combined_affordance[class], 0, bias_scale); the no-op/freeze class never gets a bonus. Three guards: bias_scale clamp, threat-context gate (zero when safe), per-tick leak.

Emotion-as-anti-collapse architecture: emotion-like systems are a set of GATED, PARTIALLY INDEPENDENT evaluators (is-this-harmful / is-this-safe / did-this-reduce-suffering / am-I-pursuing-something-I-want / did-I-merely-like-the-last-thing / am-I-stuck / am-I-overcommitted / is-this-goal-stale / should-I-explore / should-I-stop / should-I-sleep-and-consolidate / should-I-release-the-policy) whose collective effect is to prevent behaviour from collapsing onto the currently dominant gradient. Affect is therefore the architectural SOURCE of structured behavioural diversity -- not decoration on a rational optimiser and not random exploration noise, but native modulatory control (gates, biases, interrupts, salience shifts, persistence regulators, release conditions, credit-assignment signals) that produces STRUCTURED deviations from naive optimisation. A unifying MAP over REE's already-owned affect machinery, not a new substrate; an optimise-then-bolt-on-safety design fails because these evaluators must be native, not added afterward.

Endogenous parasympathetic recovery / autonomic rebound: an active, offset-triggered, transient acceleration of return-to-baseline for the affective/autonomic stress state, fired by the agent's OWN stressor offset (the z_harm_a derivative going negative -- the MECH-302 SufferingDerivativeComparator signal) with NO conspecific and NO prediction. Shares the effector/update rule of MECH-355 soothing (decay-acceleration on the recovery side: a transient state-scaled multiplier on the MECH-219 z_harm_a recovery_rate + the SD-032e drive_bias leak) but differs by TRIGGER (endogenous offset vs conspecific). The V3-tractable sibling of MECH-355 that closes REE's sympathetic-rich / parasympathetic-poor asymmetry (dense escalation: MECH-219 onset, SD-032e accumulation, SD-037 override, MECH-091 urgency, MECH-279 freeze; thin recovery: only passive recovery_rate + offline-only drive_bias decay). Distinct from passive MECH-219 recovery (active overshoot, not decay), from MECH-302 relief (shared offset trigger, different output -- relief writes a reinforcer, rebound boosts recovery rate), from MECH-303/304 safety (no prediction), and from MECH-355 soothing (endogenous trigger, not social).

top_dependency_targets.title: Relief-completion event reuses goal-achievement / reward-circuit completion machinery. When a comparator on a suffering-stream derivative crosses a downward threshold (sustained suffering-reduction below baseline), the resulting event fires the same downstream tag-and-release pipeline as goal-achievement: MECH-057a (commitment-release / beta-gate-drop), MECH-091 (salient-event phase-reset), and MECH-094 (categorical hypothesis-tag write gate). The polarity of the reinforcement is set at the input -- what counts as the completion is the suffering-derivative crossing, not a reward-onset event -- but the consolidation pipeline is shared. 'Things that just reduced suffering' are tagged in the same approach-attractor structure as 'things liked'.

source_claims.title: Creation ethics / procreative analogy: do not treat all suffering-like capacity as a design failure; creating a suffering-capable agent that cannot consent to existence is a procreative-ethics problem, permissible only under care, bounded adversity, repair, relief, and support for autonomy.
External review gate: before V5 social-mind integration or V6 language/trust/deception/institution work becomes behaviourally live, require external review or at least an external written critique.

Denial-of-sentience audit: at each generation boundary, produce a short audit of why the system is still below a precautionary moral-patient threshold, which component would force re-review, and what would count as a concerning signal.

Combination gate: require review before co-instantiating persistent self-model + autobiographical memory + sustained negative valence + inescapability + social modelling + language/preference signalling.
Welfare budget: experiment-level limits on sustained negative-valence exposure, inescapability, helplessness-like conditions, repeated adverse replay, and persistence of distress-like accumulators.

AI welfare / consciousness framework crosswalk: maintain a standing crosswalk evaluating each higher-version architecture against artificial-consciousness indicators and AI-welfare frameworks, guarding symmetrically against denialism and anthropomorphic overclaiming.
Indicator matrix: score the architecture against candidate consciousness/sentience indicators before V4 proceeds beyond individual-mind integration.

Ethics-as-process: translate the ethics-perimeter intakes into REE's claim-governed loop as governance claims, roadmap metadata, experiment preflights, review-status updates, and release gates -- progressively binding (V3 tag-and-continue -> V4 welfare/continuity -> V5 social/refusal/external-review -> V6 security/release/legal).

Parallel segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops (motor / cognitive-set / motivational): committed-action selection should run through SEPARATE striatal loop channels -- a motor loop, an associative/cognitive-set loop, and a limbic/motivational loop -- each owning its own eligibility-and-gate, arbitrated AFTER within-loop competition, rather than collapsing all channels into ONE shared E3 selection arena where the dACC/lPFC/OFC analogs feed in only as additive biases. structured_curiosity_bonus (frontopolar_uncertainty_driven_exploration_expected_free_energy_analog). Biological substrate: rostrolateral prefrontal exploration bonus (Daw et al. 2006 Nature) operating jointly with striatal novelty (Wittmann et al. 2008 Neuron). Three sub-flavours (MECH-314a/b/c) that the lit-pull recommended NOT to collapse prematurely: striatal novelty (Wittmann anchor), frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity (Daw anchor), learning-progress / intrinsic-motivation curiosity (Schmidhuber/Pathak tradition). Q-044 captures the open question of whether the three sub-flavours are distinct substrates or three readings of one mechanism with different upstream inputs.

Monomodal policy collapse is the equilibrium of a parametric-policy agent without a rule-apprehension layer. Bayesian update and gradient descent revise weights over a hypothesis space they do not invent; without a non-Bayesian rule-creator that proposes discriminative policy modes ('near-hazard -> reef regime; else -> forage regime'), the trainer collapses to the smoothest single regime good-enough across the whole state space. Monostrategy is therefore not a bug of training but the predicted output of an architecture in which only updaters exist and no apprehender does. Falsifiable by the weak-reading rule-apprehension experiment (ARC-062): a gated-policy architecture trained on the same substrate should break the collapse where standard E3 does not.

Computational analog: max-entropy policy regularisation / SAC entropy bonus (Haarnoja et al. 2018). Only the social in-face (ARC-077/MECH-337) is V4-deferred (needs a caregiver-agent substrate absent in V3); the sleep-vs-waking refinement asymmetry is V3 (sleep rescoped to V3 2026-04-20; reuses the MECH-272/273/285 sleep cluster) and is a V3 follow-on within ARC-063, NOT V4. Waking hippocampal search allocates a minority probe budget to top ghost-goal entries, seeding proposals around unresolved but still-wanted anchors instead of relying on pure current-anchor CEM or random probe noise.

Monomodal policy collapse is the equilibrium of a parametric-policy agent without a rule-apprehension layer. Bayesian update and gradient descent revise weights over a hypothesis space they do not invent; without a non-Bayesian rule-creator that proposes discriminative policy modes ('near-hazard -> reef regime; else -> forage regime'), the trainer collapses to the smoothest single regime good-enough across the whole state space. Monostrategy is therefore not a bug of training but the predicted output of an architecture in which only updaters exist and no apprehender does. Falsifiable by the weak-reading rule-apprehension experiment (ARC-062): a gated-policy architecture trained on the same substrate should break the collapse where standard E3 does not.

Hippocampal proposer anchor selection AND anchor-reset: (a) trajectory proposals issued between committed actions anchor on the subset of current latent streams whose regional verisimilitude (per-stream prediction/realization alignment) exceeds threshold; misaligned streams hold their last-verified snapshot (anchor carryover) rather than contaminate the rollout. (b) Active anchors are continuously re-evaluated against an effective verisimilitude V_s_anchor(a, t) = V_s(r, t) - staleness[r] (MECH-284 read-out); if V_s_anchor falls below theta_reset(r) for k consecutive steps the anchor is marked inactive (NOT erased -- dual-trace preservation per Bouton 2004) and a new anchor is sought from the current latent slice. A minority probe channel deliberately inverts the gate for low-verisimilitude / high-PE regions, carrying a strengthened MECH-094 hypothesis tag, and does not update the ARC-018 viability map until realized-experience validation.

Socially-scaffolded rule-population pathway: the third rule-source, peer to ARC-062 (top-down gated-policy apprehension) and ARC-064 (bottom-up behavioural-pattern extraction), and upstream-fed by ARC-065 (behavioural diversity generation). Architectural commitment: in biology the candidate-rule hypothesis space is not invented by the agent alone -- caregivers populate it from outside via scaffolded exposure (Vygotsky ZPD; Wood/Bruner/Ross scaffolding; Csibra & Gergely ostensive cueing / natural pedagogy; Tomasello shared intentionality; joint attention / social referencing). This is the most direct architectural answer to MECH-309: a non-Bayesian rule-creator that does not invent its own hypotheses receives candidate regularities, context-bound to the scaffolding episode, from a caregiver. The pathway fills the ARC-063 CandidateRule field (the 'in' face); MECH-337 is the population mechanism; MECH-338 is the cue-driven context-bound retrieval mechanism (the 'select' face). Registered 2026-05-18 as a structural slot only -- hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull and on a caregiver/teacher-agent substrate that does not yet exist in V3.

E3 maintains a structured latent goal representation (positive attractor in z_goal sub-space, measurable as z_goal_norm > 0) distinct from harm avoidance, enabling hippocampal terrain navigation toward goal states.

The unresolved-goal bank is a content-addressed cue-addressed retrieval system: the current goal/context is the retrieval cue, the SD-039 payload is the stored trace, and rank_ghost_goals() is cued recall. A correct bank must satisfy three structural constraints -- outshining-gated composite cue, dissociable-additive channels, and a non-closeable recoverability term with an explicit-divergence abandon path.

Persistence of an unresolved goal as an active re-probe target is a GATED control/efficacy-detection operation; disengagement is the ungated default. The trace is preserved (no erase -- this matches biology); 'abandonment' is the persistence gate failing to fire, after which the un-gated trace decays in rank and ceases to be re-probed. This RESOLVES ARC-078's C3 by inverting its 'add an explicit abandon path (deliberate divergence)' framing.

behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway (multi-substrate distributed: LC-NE tonic + frontopolar curiosity + striatal novelty + hippocampal trajectory sampling). Architectural commitment: a non-trivial behavioural diversity generation pathway is upstream-of and logically prior to both rule pathways (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension and ARC-064 bottom-up rule-discovery). Without it, neither pathway has anything to weight or cluster -- gradient descent on a parametric policy without diversity pressure collapses to the smoothest single regime, the predicted equilibrium MECH-309 identifies. The biology distributes diversity generation across at least four substrates: LC-NE tonic noise floor, frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity, striatal novelty bonus, and hippocampal trajectory sampling. REE registers this as a foundational architectural slot whose specific child mechanisms (MECH-313 noise-floor, MECH-314 structured-curiosity with three sub-flavours, and the MECH-315-absorbed proposal-diversity channel) are independently testable but jointly load-bearing.
SD-003 counterfactual attribution requires a dedicated harm forward model E2_harm_s(z_harm_s, action) -> z_harm_s_next operating within the sensory-discriminative harm stream.
Self-attribution via counterfactual E2: causal signature = E2(z_t, a_actual) minus E2(z_t, a_counterfactual).

e3_scoring_preserves_trajectory_class_diversity. E3 score aggregation over CEM-supplied candidates must preserve trajectory-class diversity rather than collapse a diverse candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. Without explicit diversity preservation at the scoring step, downstream action selection becomes deterministic regardless of proposal-layer diversity (ARC-065 SP-CEM child), making the whole distributed diversity pathway rate-limited by Layer B. Mechanism options (not yet committed): (1) entropy bonus over candidate first-action classes added to E3 score; (2) class- stratified argmax with within-class proportional sampling; (3) jittered tie-breaking when top-K E3 scores are within epsilon. Final design pending diagnostic data on whether E3 collapse is near-tie or large-gap (see behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan.md Phase P2).

Behavioural diversity is a structural prerequisite for ethical counterfactual evaluation. A system with monomodal policy cannot instantiate the counterfactual evaluation that ethical judgement requires, because the 'could have done otherwise' comparison demands that the agent's candidate trajectory pool contain at least two distinct trajectory classes with distinct harm profiles. The argument is mathematical-by-construction: if P(a|s) is monomodal, the CEM elite pool contains only trajectories beginning with a*, and SD-003's counterfactual E2(z_t, a_cf) for a_cf != a* is never evaluated in the on-policy candidate distribution. (Was proposed 2026-05-15 as INV-074 in behavioral_diversity_acceptance_criteria.md but never registered; the ID was subsequently taken 2026-05-17 by an unrelated plasticity-crystallization invariant. Re-registered under INV-076 with scientific content unchanged.)

Rule-apprehension architectural slot, weak reading: a non-Bayesian rule-creator at the policy layer that proposes discriminative policy modes for the updaters (E3, training loop) to refine. Tests the logical-necessity claim of MECH-309 within the existing V3 substrate without registering the heavier CandidateRule machinery (ARC-063, V4-deferred). Architectural slot, not yet implemented.

stochastic_noise_floor (max_entropy_policy_regularisation_LC_NE_tonic_analog). A floor-level stochastic action-selection noise that prevents complete deterministic collapse of the policy. Biological substrate: locus coeruleus tonic firing producing baseline action-selection variability (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 adaptive-gain model). Computational analog: max-entropy policy regularisation / SAC entropy bonus (Haarnoja et al. 2018). Distinct from MECH-260 dACC anti-recency: MECH-313 is a state-independent noise floor, while MECH-260 is a state-dependent recency penalty. Both can contribute to anti-monostrategy pressure but operate via different mechanisms; whether they collapse into a single substrate or are mutually load-bearing is open (Q-045).

structured_curiosity_bonus (frontopolar_uncertainty_driven_exploration_expected_free_energy_analog). A reward bonus on action-selection that rewards information-gain or uncertainty-reduction, distinct from a state-independent noise floor (MECH-313). Biological substrate: rostrolateral prefrontal exploration bonus (Daw et al. 2006 Nature) operating jointly with striatal novelty (Wittmann et al. 2008 Neuron). Three sub-flavours (MECH-314a/b/c) that the lit-pull recommended NOT to collapse prematurely: striatal novelty (Wittmann anchor), frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity (Daw anchor), learning-progress / intrinsic-motivation curiosity (Schmidhuber/Pathak tradition). Active-inference (Friston 2010/2015 expected free energy) provides the formal-level unification. Q-044 captures the open question of whether the three sub-flavours are distinct substrates or three readings of one mechanism with different upstream inputs.

REE-v3 requires a minimal sleep-phase infrastructure: an SWS-analog phase (bidirectional hippocampus-to-cortex replay for schema/slot consolidation) and a REM-analog phase (causal attribution replay for slot-filling from co-correlational evidence ordering). Without these offline phases, hippocampal attribution mapping cannot converge and context representations remain globally undifferentiated.
The SWS sub-phase of offline mode performs global attractor flattening and residue field denoising (synaptic homeostasis analog), pruning weak noisy traces and restoring signal-to-noise ratio.

Object-bound incentive-salience layer: insert a per-object incentive layer between the benefit pulse and z_goal. The legacy goal stream wrote a SINGLE z_goal attractor overwritten on every contact, conflating liking (hedonic impact at consumption) with wanting (incentive salience to a cue/object) and goal-location (where) with goal-object (what); wanting target always equalled liking target, so the L9 wanting!=liking dissociation was structurally inexpressible (514l C6=0.0 on all seeds). SD-057 adds (L2 MECH-344) benefit->object-identity binding on the SD-049 per-type tag, (L3 MECH-345) a per-object slow-decay revaluable incentive token with at-recall drive-specific wanting amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive), and (L4 MECH-346) z_goal seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored embedding rather than the raw last-contacted z_resource. v1 = L2+L3+L4 core; L6 cue-recall (MECH-CUEWANT) + L7 dACC-readout-wiring (MECH-CONSUME) deferred to a phase-2 pass within this SD.

control_plane.commit_maintenance_release. The R-c readiness signals that gate commitment ENTRY (MECH-090: score_margin decisiveness + nav_competence) must ALSO be able to RELEASE an already-elevated beta latch when execution readiness degrades mid-commitment. The release is a graded, bounded-accumulation drift-to-a-release-bound (conflict-scaled by the deficit magnitude), NOT a one-shot threshold flag; targeted to the active committed motor program (not a global brake); and hysteretic with a reengagement path that guards the premature-abort pole. Object identity is a cross-cutting representational primitive. An object is a token-bound identity representation that persists across time and perceptual gaps, generalising z_object/z_resource into an object-file/binding layer (ARC-006), defined by causal feature-coherence under intervention (MECH-278), and consumed by drive/goal (SD-057), hippocampal planning (MECH-262), and the self/other special-object cases. The four planned object capabilities -- (1) permanence, (2) self-as-object, (3) tools/affordances, (4) others-as-object -- are specialisations of one primitive, not four separate mechanisms.

Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge: SD-058/MECH-357 supply an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate but its avoidance_efficacy is a GLOBAL SCALAR that only penalises the no-op/freeze class -- compute_action_bias by design 'does NOT compute the escape direction'. V3-EXQ-603h (engaged-but-insufficient, readiness met) showed the consequence: the agent un-freezes but acquires no directed escape (seed-43 scalar efficacy 0.633 -> WORST survival 11.0). Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance needs the LA/BA->NAcc relief/safety action-credit half that positively reinforces a SPECIFIC avoidance response, not only the suppression half. REE owns relief (MECH-302/SD-050) + safety (MECH-303/304/SD-052/SD-051) but they are UNWIRED to avoidance. SD-059 adds the architecture: an affordance-indexed (per-first-action-class) credit table that, when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (relief) or terminates the threat (safety), tags that action as an escape affordance approachable under future threat; MECH-358 is the bridge mechanism.

Relief-completion event reuses goal-achievement / reward-circuit completion machinery. When a comparator on a suffering-stream derivative crosses a downward threshold (sustained suffering-reduction below baseline), the resulting event fires the same downstream tag-and-release pipeline as goal-achievement: MECH-057a (commitment-release / beta-gate-drop), MECH-091 (salient-event phase-reset), and MECH-094 (categorical hypothesis-tag write gate). The polarity of the reinforcement is set at the input -- what counts as the completion is the suffering-derivative crossing, not a reward-onset event -- but the consolidation pipeline is shared. 'Things that just reduced suffering' are tagged in the same approach-attractor structure as 'things liked'.
Current-scope boundary statement: REE-v3 is not claimed sentient, conscious, or a moral patient; this statement is re-evaluated at every generation boundary.

F-dominance bounds committed-action diversity: the primary harm/goal score (F) monopolises ~88-89% of E3 committed-selection variance (V3-EXQ-571: 0.886 baseline, 0.894 with the full diversity stack -- the stack does not dent F's share), so modulatory, within-class, and rule-bias diversity channels cannot convert to committed-action diversity while F dominates -- they act only at near-ties. The committed-action-diversity conversion ceiling is therefore a SELECTION-VARIANCE problem (primary-vs-modulatory share), not (only) a candidate-pool geometry problem; a shortlist-then-modulate lever circumvents F locally but may cap committed entropy below the proposer ceiling unless F's variance share is itself rebalanced.

Basal-ganglia-like E3 selector constitution: committed-action selection should be governed by an explicit BG-mirroring eligibility-gating CONSTITUTION -- candidate actions pass through an eligibility mask, bounded Go (direct-pathway promotion) and No-Go (indirect-pathway suppression) pressures, a conflict-sensitive hold / threshold-raise / candidate-set widening (hyperdirect-STN), striatal-like parallel channel competition (rather than one scalar monarch), a pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate (rather than bare argmax), and a stable post-commit latch / de-commit -- so that an upstream signal's STRENGTH is necessary but not sufficient: it also needs LAWFUL ACCESS to committed action. The translation target is functional (a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated BG analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

dACC-analog bias suppression against recency / monostrategy: the dACC module writes a counter-bias that resists repeating the last-rewarded trajectory when long-term value information demands exploration. Candidate explanation of the monostrategy failure observed in fishtank_viz and earlier queue-diversity results.

Parallel segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops (motor / cognitive-set / motivational): committed-action selection should run through SEPARATE striatal loop channels -- a motor loop, an associative/cognitive-set loop, and a limbic/motivational loop -- each owning its own eligibility-and-gate, arbitrated AFTER within-loop competition, rather than collapsing all channels into ONE shared E3 selection arena where the dACC/lPFC/OFC analogs feed in only as additive biases. HYPOTHESIS (assembly-map A.2 / s.D): the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is partly an ARTEFACT of the single-arena collapse -- F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance because every channel competes in one F-dominated arena; with segregated loops F could dominate only the motor loop and could not drown the limbic 'is this worth committing to' computation, which is a different loop with a different value. Translation target is FUNCTIONAL (the Alexander/DeLong/Strick parallel-loop organisation as a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

Residual conversion ceiling requiring rank-preserving F->eligibility demotion: near-tie levers (conflict-graded shortlist / commit-T, MECH-447) CAP committed-action-class entropy BELOW the proposer ceiling because they act only at near-ties while F still decides every non-tie; only REMOVING F from the final committed argmin -- demoting it to a graded ELIGIBILITY envelope (rank-preserving renormalisation against the competing field; divisive-normalisation analog) so a modulatory/diversity channel arbitrates within the F-eligible set -- lifts committed diversity to the proposer ceiling without disinhibiting harmful classes.

Go/No-Go eligibility constitution for committed-action conversion: committed-action diversity is recovered not by any single louder channel but by an explicit eligibility CONSTITUTION -- bounded Go pressure (promote a channel when evidence/value/drive/rule/safety make it eligible) AND bounded No-Go pressure (suppress unsafe / stale / perseverative / irrelevant / low-viability channels) governing which candidates may compete for the pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate -- so that lawful, channel-specific access (not scalar dominance) decides the committed action. The full Go/No-Go eligibility-set governance is what converts when the minimal near-tie lever (MECH-447) does not and isolated F->eligibility demotion (MECH-448) is insufficient alone.

Minimal recurrent settling step over the eligible set: replace the one-shot feed-forward argmin/softmax committed-selection readout with a few rounds of mutual-inhibition (surround-inhibition) updates on the within-eligible _modulatory_accum field BEFORE commit, so the committed action emerges from a bounded recurrent SETTLING competition rather than a single global comparison. A hard argmin over an F-dominated score always returns the F-winner (the conversion ceiling); a settling competition with lateral inhibition can FLIP the selected attractor when a modulatory channel is strong enough, and turns the additive _modulatory_accum BLEND into a competitive winner-take-most. The V3-bounded version of the BG's recurrent settling dynamics; the full learned thalamo-cortico-basal loop is the V4 bet.
Modes are control-plane regimes applied to shared predictive machinery: the precision-to-commitment circuit.
